title.rendered: Best free car games you can play in a browser

content.rendered:
I love a good racing game, but I do not always want to sit through a huge download just to drive for ten minutes on a break. That is where browser car games earn their keep. You open a tab, the game loads, and you are driving in seconds. Over the past year, I have kept a running list of the ones I actually come back to, and every pick here is free.

Most of them run on just about any modern browser, on desktop or mobile, though a couple feel best with a keyboard. A good browser car game does one thing well and loads fast: some are about raw speed, some about fine control, and some are just about switching off for a while. I have mixed those flavours below so there is something here whether you have two minutes or an afternoon. If you would rather play with a native app, I keep a separate list of the best racing games made for iPhone and iPad, but if you just want to drive right now, start here.

1. Slow Roads – Best for calm, scenic driving

Not every driving game is about winning. Slow Roads, built by a solo developer who goes by Anslo, drops you onto an endless road that the game generates as you go, so you never drive the same stretch twice. There is no race and no clock. You pick a vehicle, set the scenery, and cruise.

It runs on Three.js and WebGL, which is why it looks as good as it does in a plain browser tab. You can switch the weather, season, and time of day to match your mood, swap between a coupe, a motorcycle, and a coach, and even hand over to an autopilot when you just want to watch the landscape roll by. It works on desktop and mobile, and it is the one I open when I want to decompress rather than compete. Since its 2022 launch, it has grown into a full 2.x version with sharper vehicles and more settings, but the appeal has not changed: it is active meditation with a steering wheel.

2. PolyTrack – Best for time-trial precision

If you want something with more bite, PolyTrack is where I go. It is a low-poly time-trial racer from a developer called Kodub, openly inspired by the Trackmania series, and it lives and dies on precision. Instead of a pack of rivals, you race the clock and your own ghost: drive a short track, spot where you bled speed, restart in a second, and shave off a few tenths.

The blocky art style is a feature, not a shortcut. It keeps file sizes tiny, so the game loads in seconds and stays smooth even on a modest laptop, while your attention stays on the racing line through each loop, ramp, and hard corner. PolyTrack also ships with a built-in track editor: place road pieces, ramps, and checkpoints, test your creation, then export it as code so other players can try it. Official tracks span summer, winter, and desert themes, and the community has built thousands more. It is the rare browser racer with a genuinely deep skill ceiling.

3. Drive Mad – Best for physics puzzles

Drive Mad is less a race than a puzzle on wheels. It is a physics game where balance matters more than speed, and it gives you just two controls: accelerate and brake. The whole trick is keeping your truck upright through jumps, ramps, wobbly bridges, magnets, and low-gravity sections. One overcorrection and you tip over, and the run ends. There are 250 levels across three worlds, including a snow world and a monster-truck world, so the “just one more” loop runs deep.

It is the kind of pick-up game that builds a serious following, and the numbers back that up: Drive Mad holds a 4.3 out of 5 rating from more than 3.8 million votes, and it is one of the most-played picks in Poki’s free car games collection, which gathers well over 150 of them in one place. Built by the studio Fancade, it rewards short, careful inputs over brute speed, and it turns deceptively hard once the later levels start stacking hazards. If you like a puzzle that punishes panic, this is the one.

4. Drift Hunters – Best for drifting and car tuning

Drift Hunters is the pick for anyone who cares about car culture as much as lap times. It is a 3D drifting game built on the Unity engine, and it has been a browser staple since 2017 for good reason: the driving model rewards genuine skill. You chain drifts to build a score multiplier, and every clean, connected slide is worth more than a messy one.

The depth is in the garage. You start in the iconic AE86 and work toward a lineup of 26 cars, then tune almost everything that matters: turbo pressure, brake balance, camber, offset, ride height, and suspension stiffness, plus paint, rims, and stance. Get the setup wrong and a fast car becomes a handful; get it right and long sweeping corners turn into points machines. It is best played on desktop with a keyboard, where the throttle control it asks for actually lands. If you grew up watching drift videos, this scratches the itch.

5. Madalin Stunt Cars – Best for open-world stunts

When I just want to mess around with supercars, I load the Madalin Stunt Cars series. Instead of tracks, you get a huge open playground packed with ramps, loops, and towers, and a garage of exotics to fling around it. There is no lap counter telling you what to do, which is the point: you set your own challenges, whether that is landing a stupidly long jump or just seeing how fast you can go before physics has an opinion.

The latest entry hands you 34 cars unlocked from the start and drops the focus squarely on stunts and speed. It also has an online multiplayer mode, so you can cruise and show off alongside real players in the same arena. It is pure sandbox fun, the driving-game equivalent of a skate park, and a good one to leave open when you want short bursts of chaos between other things.

6. Smash Karts – Best for multiplayer mayhem

Smash Karts is the one to open when friends are around. It is a 3D multiplayer kart battle where the goal is not to cross a finish line but to blow up everyone else. You spawn into a compact arena, grab weapon pickups from crates, and try to rack up the most eliminations before the round timer runs out. Think of it as bumper cars with rockets.

Matches are short and loud, usually a few minutes each, which makes it perfect for a quick session that somehow turns into an hour. Beyond the standard free-for-all, there are rotating modes and events, plus a deep pile of cosmetics: characters, hats, kart colours, wheels, and celebrations to unlock as you level up. Your progress carries across devices too, so you can start on a laptop and pick it back up on your phone. It is the most social pick on this list by a mile.

7. Drift Boss – Best for a quick one-tap break

Some days you have two minutes, not twenty. Drift Boss is built for exactly that. It is an endless one-button drifting game: a car rolls forward along a narrow, twisting platform, and your only job is to tap at the right moment to drift around each bend without sliding off the edge. Hold too long, and you overshoot; tap too late, and you are gone.

That single mechanic is the whole game, and it is quietly brilliant. Your score is the distance you survive, coins let you unlock new cars and boosters, and the difficulty curve is judged so well that “one more go” becomes a reflex. Built by MarketJS, it plays the same on a phone as on a desktop, since one tap is all it asks for. When I want a five-minute reset without learning anything new, this is what I reach for.

Start your engines

That is my short list for when I want to drive without the wait, from a calm scenic cruise to a physics puzzle, a time-trial grind, and a bit of multiplayer chaos. Which one you reach for really depends on your mood that day: Slow Roads to switch off, PolyTrack or Drift Hunters when you want to get good at something, Smash Karts when there is company. What do you fire up when you just want to get behind the wheel? Let me know in the comments.

FAQs

Are these browser car games really free?

Yes. Every game on this list runs in your browser and is free to play. A few also offer optional paid apps or extras, but the core game costs nothing.

Do I need a powerful PC to play them?

No. Most are built to run on modest hardware. If your computer can play a video smoothly, it can handle games like PolyTrack, Slow Roads, and Drive Mad.

Can I play them on my phone?

Many of them, yes. Slow Roads, Drive Mad, Smash Karts, and Drift Boss all work well in a mobile browser. Drift Hunters is the exception and is best on desktop with a keyboard.

Which one is best for a quick break?

Drift Boss and Drive Mad are the fastest to jump into for a few minutes. For a longer, calmer session, Slow Roads is hard to beat.

title.rendered: ChatGPT will test visual ads during image generation

content.rendered:
OpenAI is adding a visual ad format to ChatGPT that can appear while the app generates an image. The company plans to start a limited U.S. test later this month with an initial group of advertisers. Its October 5 announcement says the ads will be clearly labeled and kept separate from the image ChatGPT is creating.

This is a new placement for ChatGPT’s ad test. Existing ads can appear below text answers; the new format moves sponsored visuals into the image-generation flow. OpenAI says advertising will not influence ChatGPT’s answers, but it has not specified the ad’s exact placement or how often a user might see it.

The ads will appear in the image-making flow

OpenAI describes the format as a way for brands to use images to show product inspiration, how a product is used, or the experience it offers. The first test will run during image generation. That means people may see a sponsored visual while ChatGPT is working on an image request, rather than only after a text answer.

OpenAI says the ad will stay outside the image being generated and will carry a clear label. It also says ads will not shape ChatGPT’s answers. The announcement does not explain how the format will look, how often it could appear, or whether users will get a setting to hide it.

OpenAI has not said which plans will see the format

OpenAI says the test begins later in October in the U.S. with an initial group of advertisers. It has not given an exact start date or said which ChatGPT plans will see the visual ads. The earlier answer-ad test began with Free and Go users in the U.S. Those ChatGPT ads appeared below text answers, but OpenAI has not said whether those are the only plans included in this image-generation test.

There is no broader rollout date yet, either. For now, the change is a limited test. Users outside the U.S. should not expect the new format based on this announcement alone.

OpenAI is also expanding its ad platform

The visual format is one part of OpenAI’s wider advertising update. The company is adding connections with Hightouch, Tealium, and LiveRamp so advertisers can share conversion data, and it is working with independent firms such as DoubleVerify and Integral Ad Science on ad-placement checks. Those changes help advertisers measure campaigns and assess brand suitability; they do not add new controls for ChatGPT users.

OpenAI says the independent reviews will assess its ad safeguards in a controlled setting without exposing private conversations. It has not reported results from those reviews yet, so the checks are still in development.

OpenAI says its ad rules will keep promotions out of sensitive or unsuitable conversations and preserve the separation between ads and answers. The image-generation test will show whether sponsored visuals can fit into a task where people are already asking ChatGPT to make something. For now, OpenAI has confirmed only a limited U.S. test with an initial group of advertisers, not a full rollout.

excerpt.rendered: OpenAI will test a new visual ad format in ChatGPT’s image-generation flow later this month in the U.S. It has not said which plans will see it yet.

title.rendered: Apple reportedly plans two product launch waves in October

content.rendered:
Apple may have two hardware announcement windows this month. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reported that Apple plans to unveil a new home hub, HomePod mini, and Apple TV 4K on October 13. MacRumors now says multiple sources point to another product batch in the final week of October. Apple has not announced an October event or confirmed either rumored lineup.

If those reports hold, October could bring a home-focused reveal followed by a possible Mac launch. The reported schedule looks like this; only one late-October item is confirmed.

The first window is focused on home hardware

The October 13 date comes from Gurman’s reporting on a smart home hub, a new HomePod mini, and an updated Apple TV 4K. His report points to a home-focused launch and a possible event, but Apple has not announced it. The rumored screen-equipped home hub would give Apple a new way to put Home controls and Siri in a shared room.

Earlier reporting had already pointed to a broader home refresh. MacRumors says the updated HomePod mini and Apple TV could retain their current designs while adding faster chips for Siri AI, and the speaker may come in new colors. Those details are unconfirmed, and Apple has not given prices or availability for either product. The hub would be the most visible change because it would add a display to Apple’s home lineup.

The later batch could include Macs

MacRumors says it has heard from multiple sources that Apple plans another launch in the final week of October. The report does not name the products. Its most likely candidates are an OLED MacBook Ultra with a thinner design, a base 14-inch MacBook Pro with an M6 chip, and an iMac with an M6 chip. Each is still a rumor, including the MacBook Ultra name.

One late-October Mac detail is already confirmed. Apple says its Mac Studio with M5 Ultra and 512GB of unified memory is coming in late October, after introducing the new desktop in September. That gives Mac buyers a confirmed availability window, but it does not confirm that Apple plans a second event. Apple’s 2026 product lineup also includes an OLED iPad mini as a possibility this year, though MacRumors says its timing is unclear and does not place it in either reported wave.

The reported product waves would come around the iPhone Duo’s October 23 launch. But the exact schedule, event format, and lineup remain unsettled. For now, treat October 13 and the final-week window as reporting, not dates to plan a purchase around.

excerpt.rendered: Apple’s October plans may include a smart home launch on October 13 and a second batch in the final week. Apple has not confirmed the rumored lineups.

acceptedAnswer.text: To cancel an app purchase, go to Settings > tap on Apple ID > Subscription > select the subscription you want to cancel > tap on Cancel Subscription.

title.rendered: Apple releases third iOS 27.2 developer beta for iPhone

content.rendered:
Apple released the third developer beta of iOS 27.2 on October 5, giving testers a newer build as work on the next iPhone update continues. The build number is 24B5099f. Apple has not posted a feature list for this seed, and early coverage has not identified a change unique to beta 3. For now, this is a new testing build rather than a confirmed feature drop.

What iOS 27.2 already has

The bigger changes in iOS 27.2 arrived in earlier builds. They include a redesigned Health app, Group FaceTime Dual Capture, support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in Siri AI, Apple TV profiles on iPhone, and changes to Podcasts. Apple’s beta notes also describe a new App Tracking Transparency prompt for users in France, Germany, Italy, Poland, and Romania.

Dual Capture can show the front and rear cameras at once during a Group FaceTime call. The Health redesign adds Insights and Longevity sections, while Podcasts gives new episodes a clearer place in the app. These are the changes to watch in the full iOS 27.2 cycle, but they are not beta 3 exclusives.

The first iOS 27.2 beta brought the Health redesign and EU privacy change into testing. The next build exposed code for Apple’s possible AutoLock anti-snatching feature, which could lock a phone after a snatch but is not enabled for users. Apple has not said what beta 3 fixes or whether it changes any of these earlier features.

Why Apple is testing iOS 27.1 and 27.2

The version numbers may look odd: iPhone Duo will run iOS 27.1 when it becomes available on October 23, while testers are already working with 27.2. Apple says 27.1 includes features built for the foldable’s design. The company has not said whether 27.1 will be released as an update for other iPhone models.

Apple’s public beta for iOS 27.2 was already available before this third developer build. Beta 2 appeared on September 21, two weeks before beta 3 arrived, but Apple has not explained the gap or announced when the stable version will arrive. The developer release confirms that testing has moved forward; it does not reveal which fixes are unique to this seed. Developers can use it to check how their apps behave against the next system version. If you rely on your iPhone every day, wait for the final release.

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to buy an iPhone with non-genuine parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

mainEntity.name: Can I reset parts and service history?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Do third-party repairs affect warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unauthorised repairs may void parts of your warranty.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

mainEntity.name: Can AppleCare+ be used with unknown parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple may require replacement with genuine parts before providing coverage; otherwise, the warranty may be void.

mainEntity.name: Are these browser car games really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every game on this list runs in your browser and is free to play. A few also offer optional paid apps or extras, but the core game costs nothing.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a powerful PC to play them?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Most are built to run on modest hardware. If your computer can play a video smoothly, it can handle games like PolyTrack, Slow Roads, and Drive Mad.

mainEntity.name: Can I play them on my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many of them, yes. Slow Roads, Drive Mad, Smash Karts, and Drift Boss all work well in a mobile browser. Drift Hunters is the exception and is best on desktop with a keyboard.

acceptedAnswer.text: Drift Boss and Drive Mad are the fastest to jump into for a few minutes. For a longer, calmer session, Slow Roads is hard to beat.

title.rendered: How to get the Gold Punk skin in Fortnite?

content.rendered:
After months of anticipation, Fortnitemares has finally arrived in Fortnite, bringing several spooky crossovers, game modes, map changes, and other additions. Among the new content is a brand-new skin called Gold Punk. So, what makes this skin special? Well, apart from being a giant golden Jack O’Lantern tearing through the battlefield, the best part is that you can get it for free by purchasing a Fortnite Gift Card.

Wondering how it works? Here’s a complete guide on how to get the Gold Punk Skin in Fortnite.

Here’s how to get the Gold Punk skin in Fortnite

The Gold Punk skin in Fortnite is a free reward to players who purchase and redeem a Fortnite Gift Card between October 2 and October 31, 2026. For those who don’t know, Fortnite Gift Cards are prepaid cards that can be redeemed for V-Bucks on your Epic Games account. Once you redeem a card during the promotion window, the Gold Punk skin will be automatically added to your account. Not only that, but you’ll receive 20% back in Epic Rewards during this season.

However, there are a few things to keep in mind. Fortnite Gift Cards are only available in select regions. You won’t be able to redeem a card from a different region than the one associated with your account. With that said, here’s the complete list of regions where Fortnite Gift Cards are currently available –

  • Australia
  • Austria
  • Belgium
  • Canada
  • Czech Republic
  • Finland
  • France
  • Germany
  • Ireland
  • Italy
  • Japan
  • Mexico
  • New Zealand
  • Norway
  • Poland
  • Portugal
  • Romania
  • Saudi Arabia
  • Spain
  • Sweden
  • Switzerland
  • The Netherlands
  • United Arab Emirates
  • United Kingdom
  • United States of America

If your region isn’t included on the list above, you won’t be able to purchase a Fortnite Gift and claim the Gold Punk outfit. However, that doesn’t mean you’ll miss out forever. There’s a chance Epic Games could bring back the Gold Punk to the Fortnite Item Shop at a later date. So, keep an eye out.

Here’s how to redeem a Fortnite Gift Card

Now that you know how to get the Gold Punk skin, you might be wondering how to redeem the Fortnite Gift Card and claim your reward. Luckily, the process is quite simple and should take a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide:

  1. Head to Epicgames.com/redeem.
  2. Sign in to the Epic Games account linked to your Fortnite account.
  3. Enter the gift card PIN exactly as it appears on the card.
  4. Click on Redeem.

Once the gift card has been successfully redeemed, launch Fortnite and head to your Locker. The Gold Punk skin will now be available for you to equip and use.

Rounding up

The Gold Punk skin is available as a free reward for players who purchase and redeem a Fortnite Gift Card between October 2 and October 31, 2026. For now, the outfit is a limited-time reward for the ongoing Fortnitemares event, which has brought crossovers with franchises such as FNAF, Obsession, and Slender Man.

Once the promotion ends, there’s always a chance that Epic Games could bring Gold Punk back through the Fortnite Item Shop.

  • How to get the Champion Focus FNCS skin in Fortnite
  • How to get the Cyberpunk Edgerunners Lucy skin in Fortnite

It’s time to hit the field in Soccer Zero! This competitive 5v5 soccer game takes inspiration from the popular anime Blue Lock. If you want to compete at the top level, you’ll need the strongest roster of characters, and thankfully, the game’s codes can help you get there with free rewards. So, let’s take a look at all the active Soccer Zero codes you can redeem right now.

All working Soccer Zero codes

How to redeem Soccer Zero codes

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Soccer Zero codes:

  1. Fire up Soccer Zero on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on the Codes option with the Gift icon from the bottom menu.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Soccer Zero codes

Unfortunately, the developers don’t have a fixed release schedule for Soccer Zero codes. Most of the codes are dropped to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Soccer Zero Discord server for announcements.
  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Sell Ores codes, Roll a Fisherman codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

Why are my Soccer Zero codes not working?

Make sure you’ve entered the code exactly as shown in the list above. If the code still doesn’t work, it might’ve expired, or you’ve already redeemed the rewards

What do Soccer Zero codes do?

Soccer Zero can give you multiple in-game rewards, such as Lucky Style Spins, Luckly Flow Spins, and Cash for absolutely free.

title.rendered: How to get Jimothy the Raccoon sidekick for free in Fortnite

content.rendered:
The 2026 internet sensation, Jimothy the Raccoon, has made its way into Fortnite as an unlockable sidekick. You can complete the relatively easy, although hidden, quest titled ‘Extract a Silly Little Guy’ to get this sidekick as a reward.

For those unaware, Jimothy the Raccoon is a uniquely round and small-sized raccoon spotted in Seattle, USA—that went viral earlier this year. The newly added Fortnite sidekick is modeled after this very mammal and is among the cosmetics introduced in the Fortnitemares 2026 event.

Steps to claim Jimothy the Raccoon in Fortnite

Jimothy the Raccoon is the item you unlock after adding the Dumpster Dive Sprite, one of the sprites introduced in the October 1 update, to your collection. This particular sprite enhances the effect of healing items and also provides food items when you jump into certain hiding spots, such as a dumpster.

Below are the main steps involved in the process of finding the Dumpster Dive Sprite and extracting it.

  1. Enter a ranked or unranked Battle Royale match. (Although sprites are also there in modes such as Reload, the BR mode is more suitable for this)
  2. Use cheat codes, open high-tier chests, smash Pumpkin Chests, or leverage other players to get the Dumpster Dive Sprite.
  3. Go to an Extraction Site or use a Portable Extractor to extract the newly acquired sprite.

As soon as you have extracted the Dumpster Dive Sprite, you will have Jimothy the Raccoon sprite pushed into your owned sidekicks catalog. Simultaneously, you will also get access to its sidekick quests, which can be completed to unlock even more free cosmetics.

Ways to find Dumpster Dive Sprite in Fortnite

Using cheat codes of Epic or higher tier

Cheat codes are the most straightforward way you can get the Dumpster Dive Sprite in Fortnite. Given that it’s an Epic-tier sprite, it is recommended to target the cheat codes that are either purple or golden in color. However, rarely, the blue ones (Rare Cheat Codes) can also grant you Epic Sprites.

You can find cheat codes planted throughout the Fortnite map, but there are certain areas that are more densely populated with these items than the others. A few of these noteworthy areas are Heatwave Harbor, Cluster Coast, and Shaken Sanctuary.

Smashing Pumpkin Chests

There is a brand-new way to acquire sprites during the Fortnitemares month, thanks to the inclusion of Pumpkin Chests. You can find them scattered all over the Battle Royale map, including in some of the most notable POIs such as Freddy Fazbear’s Pizzeria, Nightmare Neighborhood, Freaky Fields, Green Hills Zone, Stone Sanctum, and Lifty Lodge.

Unlike other types of chests, Pumpkin Chests are guaranteed to provide one sprite to the player when it is smashed open. However, it must also be noted that while the aforementioned locations are known to have a Pumpkin Chest, they may not spawn in all of those places in every match.

Opening Rare Chests

Although the sprite-giving role has mainly been allotted to cheat codes in Chapter 7 Season 4, the non-standard chests—such as the blue ones—still at times provide a sprite. Apart from the one odd sprite, the blue-colored Rare Chests mostly offer high-value loot to the player.

If you’re going on a chest-hunting spree for the Dumpster Dive Sprite, it would help to focus on the neighborhoods where the blue ones are highly concentrated. Among such locations, the top-most names are Nightmare Neighborhood, Stone Sanctum, Pac-Man Island, Blinky Island, Cluster Coast, and the shape-shifting maze located to the southeast of Stone Sanctum.

Calling out a friend for help

Alternatively, you may also invoke the help of a friendly Fortnite player by finding one in the game’s official Discord server. Afterward, you will have to enter at least two matches together with that player. In the first one, you can take the desired sprite and extract it. In the second one, you can return the sprite to its rightful owner.

Since you have already extracted the sprite once, it is now indexed in your collection. All you need to do after that is visit the Sprites tab in the Override section and recall the sprite using Sprite Dust to be able to use it again.

More Jimothy the Raccoon cosmetics in Fortnite

Unlocking Jimothy the Raccoon sidekick isn’t where it all ends for the viral animal in this game, as there are also three different sidekick rewards attached to a set of quests called ‘Jimothy Quests’.

You can complete these quests by earning Sidekick Points in Fortnite. These points can be accumulated by equipping Jimothy the Raccoon as your sidekick and playing some matches with it. Each time you reach a certain number of these points, you complete one quest. Completing three quests in total unlocks new rewards as follows:

By cashing in on the rising popularity of the viral Jimothy, Fortnite has shown its intent to keep up with what people are talking about at present when it comes to deciding in-game cosmetics. The various major third-party collabs that are timed with film and game releases have long been an indicator of the same. With that said, it will be interesting to look forward to which viral content grabs Fortnite devs’ attention next.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • How to get Pac-Man sidekick in Fortnite
  • How to unlock Panda Team Jr sidekick for free in Fortnite

title.rendered: iOS 27 stuck on ‘Preparing Update’? 7 proven fixes

content.rendered:
As Apple finally rolled out the stable iOS 27 update, you must be excited to install it. During installation, iOS typically moves through Downloading → Preparing Update → Verifying → Installing. The Preparing Update stage can take time, and a slowly moving progress indicator doesn’t necessarily mean something is wrong.

However, if your iPhone is stuck on “Preparing Update…” for an unusually long time, it’s usually a network, storage, or cached update-file issue, not a hardware failure. In this guide, I’ll walk through the fixes I’d try, starting with the safest and easiest ones. I’ll also explain when you should stop waiting and use a computer to update your iPhone.

Why is my iPhone stuck on the “Preparing Update” screen?

When your iPhone shows “Preparing Update”, it basically means your device has already downloaded the iOS update and is now getting it ready to install. It’s like the final stage, so your iPhone needs to organize files, check compatibility, and make sure everything is in place before the actual update begins. 

Now, here’s the catch: sometimes this step takes longer than it should, depending on the size of the update and the number of files on your device. It can be around one hour if you’re upgrading from an older iOS. If your iPhone gets stuck here forever, it usually points to things like: 

  • Slow or unstable internet: Your iPhone might still be trying to verify the update. 
  • Not enough storage: The update needs extra room to unpack and install. 
  • Temporary software glitches: iOS or the Settings app can occasionally become unresponsive.
  • A problematic update file: An interrupted download can leave an update that needs to be downloaded again.
  • Apple’s servers: If too many people are updating at once, your iPhone may have trouble communicating with Apple’s update servers. 

So, if your phone seems frozen on this iOS 27 update screen, don’t panic; it doesn’t mean your iPhone is broken. It just needs a little push to get past this step, and that’s exactly what the fixes below will help with.

1. Give the update some time

This is the step I’d normally try first.

If your iPhone has just moved to “Preparing Update,” don’t restart it immediately. Depending on the update and the amount of data on your iPhone, the process can take longer than expected.

While you’re waiting:

  • Keep your iPhone connected to power.
  • Keep it connected to Wi-Fi.
  • Avoid repeatedly opening and closing the Software Update screen.
  • Don’t force-restart the device unless it genuinely appears to be stuck.

If the iPhone eventually moves past Preparing Update, you don’t need to do anything else.

If it remains there for an unusually long time, continue with the fixes below.

2. Clear your iPhone storage

Insufficient storage is one of the first things I’d check when an iOS update is stuck on Preparing to Update and refuses to progress.

Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage and check the amount of available storage shown at the top.

If your iPhone is almost full, free up some space by removing things you don’t need, such as:

  • Large videos
  • Downloaded movies or TV shows
  • Unused apps
  • Large files
  • Old downloads
  • Duplicate or unwanted photos

You can also enable Offload Unused Apps from the iPhone Storage screen.

After freeing up some storage space, restart the iPhone and check for the update again.

3. Ensure a stable Wi-Fi connection

Your iPhone needs an internet connection to download and verify software updates.

While you can download an iOS update via mobile data, I recommend using a reliable Wi-Fi network. It is wiser, faster, and much easier to update your iPhone over a Wi-Fi connection.

  1. Open the Settings app → Wi-Fi → tap the Wi-Fi name to join.
  2. Choose a known network.
  3. Now, open Safari or an app like YouTube and check whether the internet is working.
    Also, ensure the iPhone is adequately charged (above 20%) or connected to power.

If your Wi-Fi seems slow or unreliable, disconnect from the current network and reconnect to it, or try another Wi-Fi network if one is available. I’d also temporarily disconnect from a VPN or proxy if you’re using one.

4. Reset network settings

If your Wi-Fi works normally but the update continues to get stuck, resetting the network settings is another option. This issue often arises due to conflicting network configurations or faulty internet connectivity during the update process.

By resetting the network settings, you eliminate any potential glitches in your network configuration that may be hindering the update process.

5. Delete the downloaded update file and re-download it

This is one of the most useful fixes if the update has already downloaded but remains stuck on “Preparing Update.” To fix this, re-download the update.

  1. Open the Settings app and tap on General.
  2. Tap on iPhone Storage.
  3. Scroll down and tap Software Update.
  4. Tap on Delete Update.
  5. Confirm by tapping Delete Update again.s
  6. Now, restart your iPhone and download the update again. For this, open the Settings app → General → Software Update → Download and Install.

This time, the OTA update should download, prepare, and install without hiccups. Just ensure Wi-Fi is connected and the iPhone is charged or plugged in.

You may also use this method when the update file was incomplete or corrupted.

6. Force restart your iPhone

If the iPhone is genuinely unresponsive rather than simply taking a long time to prepare the update, you should hard reboot it.  

This will force the iPhone to restart and remove glitches that were hampering the reinstallation of your iOS update.

7. Update iOS using a Mac or Windows PC

If the iPhone continues to get stuck after you’ve tried the above fixes, I’d stop repeatedly attempting the OTA update and switch to a computer.

Learn how to restore your iPhone via Mac or PC. Please note that you will also get an option to Update when you restore.  

Try to update first. If this does not bring any luck, you may proceed with the restoration.

Make the most of your iOS update!

Getting stuck on the “Preparing Update” screen can be annoying, but as you’ve seen, it’s usually easy to fix with the steps mentioned above.

Once you get past it, you’ll be able to enjoy all the latest iOS 27 features like Siri AI, AI-powered photo editing tools, Describe a Shortcut, advanced Safari tools, and Liquid Glass customization to make your iPhone feel brand new. 

So don’t let a stuck update hold you back; try the fixes above and get ready to explore the best of iOS 27!

keyPoints.title: Why is My iPhone Stuck on the “Preparing Update” Screen?
keyPoints.explanation: This stage involves organizing files and checking compatibility after download, but issues like slow internet, insufficient storage, or server congestion can cause delays or freezing.

keyPoints.title: Clear Your iPhone Storage
keyPoints.explanation: Free up space on your iPhone by deleting unnecessary files to prevent storage-related issues from blocking the iOS update process.

keyPoints.title: Ensure Wi-Fi Connectivity
keyPoints.explanation: Use a reliable Wi-Fi connection while updating to ensure the download and verification processes proceed smoothly, avoiding disruptions caused by poor network quality.

keyPoints.title: Reset Network Settings
keyPoints.explanation: Resetting network settings can resolve conflicts or glitches in your network configuration that might hinder the update process.

keyPoints.title: Delete the Downloaded Update File and Re-download It
keyPoints.explanation: If the update is corrupted, delete the existing download in Settings > General > iPhone Storage > Software Update, then restart and re-download to proceed with the update.

title.rendered: iOS 27.0.1 “Unable to Check for Update” on iPhone? Here’s the fix

content.rendered:
Apple released iOS 27.0.1 on September 28, 2026, as a bug-fix update. Apple says it addresses unexpected restarts on some iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max models when Face ID fails, a camera color artifact affecting some 2x photos under specific lighting conditions on those models, and a problem where opening Notification Center and Control Center together could make the touchscreen unresponsive.

So, if you’re trying to install iOS 27.0.1 and your iPhone instead shows an “Update to Check for Update” error, here’s what I would try, starting with the easiest fixes.

Why does it say “Unable to Check for Update” on iOS 27.0.1?

The “Unable to Check for Update” message generally means your iPhone couldn’t successfully communicate with Apple’s servers to look for the latest iOS 27 update.

Here are the most common reasons:

  • Unstable Internet Connection: Your iPhone needs a working internet connection to check for and download the update.
  • Apple Server Overload: iOS 27 is a major update, and a surge in traffic may cause Apple’s servers to slow down or time out. Also, sometimes temporary server-side problems can prevent your iPhone from checking for the latest software.

  • Low Storage Space: Not enough free space can stop the update from downloading or installing.

  • Device Compatibility: Only iPhones 11 and later support iOS 27. Older models won’t be able to download it.
  • Software Glitches: Corrupted update files, temporary iOS glitches, or networking bugs may interfere with the update process.
  • Jailbroken Device: Jailbroken iPhones often face issues downloading official iOS updates.

Other errors you may encounter during the update process include:

  • “Software Update Failed”
  • “Unable to Verify Update”
  • “Unable to Download”
  • “Unable to Download. This update is not available because you are not connected to the internet.”
  • “Unable to Download. This update requires a Wi-Fi network connection to download.”
  • “An error occurred while downloading iOS 27.0.1” 
  • The update gets stuck on Preparing Update or Verifying Update

These issues typically stem from the same update-server and download errors. Understanding the causes makes it easier to apply the right fix. Let’s get started.

Simple fixes to try first

Before moving to advanced solutions, try these quick and effective steps to resolve the iOS 27.0.1 update error.

1. Check your internet connection 

The first thing I check when an iPhone refuses to find an update is the network connection.

  • Go to Settings > Wi-Fi to ensure you’re connected to a reliable network.

  • If your Wi-Fi is not working, try connecting to another network or use cellular data (if applicable). 
  • Restart your router by unplugging it for 30 seconds and plugging it back in.
  • Test your connection by opening Safari and loading a few websites.
  • Avoid downloading large files or streaming while the update is being checked or downloaded.

If your connection is solid but the error persists, continue to the next step.

2. Check Apple’s server status

Sometimes the problem isn’t your iPhone at all—it could be Apple. If Apple’s update servers are experiencing an outage or a temporary problem, your iPhone may be unable to check for updates.

  1. Visit the Apple System Status page using your iPhone or another device.
  2. Look for the iOS update section. A green icon means servers are working; yellow or red means there’s an issue. 
  3. If servers are overloaded, try again during off-peak hours—early morning or late at night usually works best.

3. Restart your iPhone 

Restarting your iPhone often clears minor glitches and resets network requests.

  1. Press and hold one Volume button and the Side button until the slider appears. Then drag the slider to power off your iPhone. 
  2. After restarting, go to Settings > General > Software Update and try again.

Still no luck? Try a force restart depending on your iPhone model to clear a more stubborn temporary software problem.

4. Check iPhone Storage

The actual download size for the iOS 27.0.1 update is just over 1 GB, but your phone needs roughly 15 GB to 25 GB of total free storage space to download and safely unpack temporary installation files

  • You can check available storage in Settings > General > iPhone Storage.
     
  • If you have less than 25GB of free storage, delete any apps, photos, videos, or large, unused files you don’t want to keep.  
  • You can also offload apps (which keep all data but offload the app) by tapping an app in that storage list and selecting Offload App. 

Once you’ve freed up space, try updating again.

Advanced fixes for persistent issues

Still stuck? These deeper fixes should help resolve the issue with the iOS 27.0.1 update.

5. Reset Network Settings

If your internet works normally but the iPhone still can’t communicate with Apple’s update servers, resetting network settings can help.

Keep in mind that this removes saved Wi-Fi passwords and resets network-related settings, so you’ll need to reconnect to your Wi-Fi networks afterward.

  1. Go to Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Network Settings.
  2. Enter your passcode if prompted. 
  3. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and check for updates again.

6. Delete the downloaded iOS update and download it again

If iOS 27.0.1 already appears in your iPhone Storage, the downloaded update file may be incomplete or corrupted.

Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage and look through the list for the iOS update.

If you see the update:

  1. Tap the iOS update.
  2. Tap Delete Update.
  3. Confirm the deletion.
  4. Restart your iPhone.
  5. Go to Settings > General > Software Update.
  6. Download iOS 27.0.1 again.

Apple specifically recommends deleting the update and downloading it again when an iPhone continues to have trouble installing the latest version.

7. Update your iPhone using a Mac or PC

When an over-the-air update refuses to work, I would move to a computer rather than repeatedly trying the same download.

  1. Plug your iPhone into a Mac or a Windows PC with the Apple Devices app or Finder.
    • On a Mac, launch Finder, click your Device in the sidebar, then, under the General tab, press Check for Update.  
    • On Windows, launch Apple Devices, select your Device, then click Check for Update.  
  1. Now click Download and Update, then wait for iOS 27.0.1 to install.  

Ensure your computer has a stable internet connection and is running the latest software.

8. Use recovery mode (only if all else fails)

As a last resort, put your iPhone into recovery mode and restore it. This will erase everything. I’d use it if the iPhone becomes stuck during an update, isn’t recognized by your computer, or repeatedly fails to start normally.

Important: Back up your data to iCloud or your computer beforehand.

  1. Plug your iPhone into your computer.
  2. Quickly press and release Volume Up, then Volume Down, then hold the Side button until the recovery screen appears.
  3. Open Finder on your Mac or the Apple Devices app on your PC.
  4. When you’re given the choice between updating or restoring, try Update first.

If Update doesn’t work, you may eventually need to choose Restore. Then set up your iPhone again and restore your backup.

9. Contact Apple Support

If the same error appears across multiple networks and also occurs when you try updating through a computer, the problem is less likely to be a simple Wi-Fi issue. It’s time to contact Apple Support.

  1. Visit support.apple.com or use the Apple Support app. 
  2. Schedule a call, chat, or Genius Bar appointment.
  3. Explain the issue and mention all the steps you’ve already tried.

They may walk you through additional troubleshooting or recommend a hardware check.

Get iOS 27.0.1 installed without the update error

The “Unable to Check for Update” error in iOS 27.0.1 is annoying, but it’s not permanent. In my experience, I would start with the network connection, restart the device, check storage, and then try another network before moving to more drastic solutions.

The right steps will get you past the hiccup. Then you can enjoy the security patches and AI features introduced in iOS 27. If the issue persists, don’t hesitate to reach out to Apple Support.

Have you managed to fix it? Drop a comment below and help others in the same boat!

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to buy an iPhone with non-genuine parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

mainEntity.name: Can I reset parts and service history?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Do third-party repairs affect warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unauthorised repairs may void parts of your warranty.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

mainEntity.name: Can AppleCare+ be used with unknown parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple may require replacement with genuine parts before providing coverage; otherwise, the warranty may be void.

title.rendered: Apple plans more explicit controls for apps seeking Full Disk Access on Mac

content.rendered:
Apple plans to add more explicit controls before Mac users grant an app Full Disk Access, a permission that can expose files, email, messages, and browsing history. The company says the change is needed as AI agents become more capable and autonomous, but it has not said when the controls will arrive or what they will look like.

In an Apple Developer News post published October 2, Apple said Full Disk Access largely bypasses other privacy protections so backup apps can work. The company warned that some developers use the permission in ways that could expose data without users fully understanding the access they are granting.

Why Full Disk Access is different

Most macOS privacy prompts ask for access to a particular category of data or action. Full Disk Access is broader: Apple says it can expose files, Mail, Messages, and even browsing history. The permission can also affect people beyond the Mac owner. Apple warned that access granted to a communication app may put the privacy of the people a user messages at risk too.

That breadth is why Apple calls it an “extraordinary” level of access. Some backup apps need it to do their job, but a user may not expect a utility or an AI assistant to have a view across personal files and communications. Our guide to moving iPhone backups off a Mac shows one existing use: giving Terminal Full Disk Access to redirect the backup folder.

Apple has not detailed the new controls

Apple says it will make users take a “very explicit” action before granting this level of access and wants people to understand the risks first. The company has not shared a new prompt design, named a macOS release, or given a rollout date. It also has not said whether apps with existing permission will need to ask again.

The announcement is about user consent around a powerful macOS permission, not a ban on AI apps or a statement that every app will lose access. It also is not limited to AI agents: Apple’s warning covers developers that use Full Disk Access broadly, with AI agents as the reason the risks are likely to increase.

That concern is becoming more visible as desktop agents move beyond chat and begin handling local files. For example, Gemini Spark is adding local-file and desktop automation features on Mac. Apple did not name Gemini Spark or any other specific app in its announcement, and the added controls may apply more broadly than agent software.

For Mac users, nothing changes today. Apple has not announced a setting to update or a permission that needs to be reset. Until it says more, users should treat Full Disk Access like a powerful key: grant it only when the app and task call for it, and remove access when it is no longer needed. The main unanswered question is how Apple will make that decision clearer when its new controls arrive.

excerpt.rendered: Apple will add stronger user controls before apps get Full Disk Access on Mac. The company has not shared a release date, interface, or list of affected apps.

title.rendered: Google is cutting Gemini model access for free and AI Plus users starting October 9

content.rendered:
Google is changing which Gemini models people can use with a personal Google account. Starting October 9, users without a Google AI subscription will lose access to Flash and Pro, leaving Flash-Lite. AI Plus subscribers will also lose Pro, but Google says they should receive an email with the date the change takes effect for their account.

The change affects model choice, not a new limit on how many prompts people can send. Gemini already uses separate compute-based usage limits. Those limits depend on prompt complexity, the models or features used, and chat length, so heavier tasks can use more of the same allowance.

Which Gemini models each plan keeps

After the change takes effect, the lineup will look like this:

That means free users will still have a Gemini model for everyday questions, but they will no longer be able to select Flash or Pro. AI Plus keeps Flash, while losing access to Pro. People who use Pro for harder tasks will need an account tier that includes it once their change takes effect.

Model access and usage caps are separate. A free account may still have usage allowance left but no longer be able to choose Flash or Pro, while AI Pro users keep those models and may still hit their plan’s separate cap.

Google’s notice covers Gemini Apps on personal accounts. It does not give a matching schedule for work or school accounts, so those users should not assume that the same dates or model table apply.

AI Plus users will get their own timing

The October 9 date applies to people without an AI subscription. Google says AI Plus users should receive an email explaining when the changes will take effect for them. It has not set one public date for all Plus subscribers, so check your inbox rather than assuming your account changes on October 9.

Google AI Pro and Ultra keep access to the three model families in the table. Google also says Pro and Ultra subscribers can use Deep Think for more intensive parallel reasoning. Each available model will get low, medium, and high effort settings; higher effort can produce more thorough answers, but uses more of the account’s limit. These settings affect models a tier includes; selecting high effort will not restore Pro access to a free or AI Plus account.

Google introduced its current Gemini subscriptions and new AI features at I/O earlier this year. This latest change shifts which models sit inside the free and entry-level paid tiers, while leaving the separate usage-limit system in place. See our Google I/O 2026 announcement guide for the wider plan context.

Once the change reaches an account, free users keep Flash-Lite, AI Plus keeps Flash, and Pro remains available on AI Pro and Ultra. If you rely on a particular model, check which plan your account has and, for AI Plus, wait for Google’s email with the effective date.

title.rendered: India orders Apple to remove Jack Dorsey’s Bitchat from the App Store

content.rendered:
Apple has removed Jack Dorsey’s Bitchat messaging app from the India App Store after a government demand, according to an Apple notice the developer shared on October 3. The notice says India’s Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) requested the removal under Section 69A of the Information Technology Act, claiming the app includes content that is illegal in India. The government’s order and the alleged content were not public in the reports reviewed.

Apple’s notice also says Bitchat will remain available in other App Store territories, while its TestFlight version will no longer be available for testing in India. That cuts off new iPhone downloads and the beta channel. It does not say Apple has deleted copies already installed on users’ phones.

What Indian users can still access

Bitchat’s project describes two ways to send messages: a Bluetooth mesh for nearby offline communication and Nostr relays for internet-based messaging. Removing the App Store listing does not by itself switch off the Bluetooth mode on an existing phone, though it depends on other nearby devices running Bitchat. The status of internet-based features may depend on access to the relays and networks.

The app was also missing from Google Play in India when TechCrunch checked on October 3. That report said it was unclear whether Google had received a separate government direction. Apple, Google, and MeitY had not responded to the publication’s requests for comment at that time, so the confirmed demand in the notice is the one Apple acted on.

If you want a quick explanation of how the app’s offline mode works, see our earlier guide to Jack Dorsey’s Bitchat messaging app.

This follows an earlier attempt to restrict Bitchat

Indian authorities sought to have GitHub remove repositories associated with Bitchat in July. That action used a different legal provision from the Section 69A demand in Apple’s October notice. The earlier dispute centered on the app’s ability to keep nearby users connected during internet shutdowns and the difficulty of tracing its communications, according to the government’s stated rationale as reported at the time.

The timing matters because Bitchat drew attention during shutdowns. TechCrunch reported that demonstrators had turned to Bitchat and Briar during July protests after internet services were suspended. Sensor Tower data cited in the report showed India accounted for about 85% of Bitchat’s worldwide downloads from July 17 to 23, compared with roughly 1% in the previous 30 days.

The Internet Freedom Foundation said the latest removal was unconstitutional, arguing that Section 69A is intended to block unlawful information rather than an app because it can work during shutdowns. That is the group’s legal position, not a court ruling. It also said the government had not made the blocking order or the alleged illegal content public.

For now, the practical change for iPhone users in India is that they cannot get Bitchat through the local App Store or its TestFlight beta. Apple’s notice does not describe an effect on existing installations, and the app’s Bluetooth mesh is designed to work without internet access. The wider questions about the government’s order and the app’s Google Play status remain unanswered.

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to buy an iPhone with non-genuine parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

mainEntity.name: Can I reset parts and service history?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Do third-party repairs affect warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unauthorised repairs may void parts of your warranty.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

mainEntity.name: Can AppleCare+ be used with unknown parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple may require replacement with genuine parts before providing coverage; otherwise, the warranty may be void.

title.rendered: Where to find Freddy Fazbear’s Pizzeria in Fortnite

content.rendered:
Freddy Fazbear Pizza is the setting for the original Five Nights at Freddy’s, the highly successful indie game that spawned an iconic franchise. Courtesy of FNAF’s collab with Fortnite, the latter title has incorporated its own version of the ominous restaurant—named Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria—into the Battle Royale map.

The FNAF-inspired restaurant in Fortnite isn’t exactly a like-for-like recreation but bears significant resemblance to the 2014 game’s premise. Besides storing plenty of chests and even playable arcade machine games, Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria also houses two of the four FNAF-themed boss fights, specifically the ones involving Freddy and Foxy, making the place well worth a visit.

Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria’s location in Fortnite

FNAF fans and Fortnite players who want to check out Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria can head northeast from Nightmare Neighbourhood. After crossing some vegetation, they will find the aforementioned restaurant situated adjacent to the snowy hills. The Pac-Man island is another convenient point of reference; to the southeast of it, you will find the desired destination.

Given that it’s a newly added location and draws from a very popular survival horror game, it is naturally a highly contested spot, and you should expect other players turning up at any time while you are there. On top of that, the fact that it is also a ground for unique boss battles further increases the likelihood of stumbling upon opponents in the FNAF-inspired pizzeria.

What’s inside Freddy Fazbear’s Pizzeria in Fortnite

The FNAF-themed building isn’t really visual fodder but also serves a functional purpose on the Fortnite Override map. That’s because it houses multiple boss encounters, featuring the survival horror game’s characters, that not only reward you with highly rare loot upon emerging victorious but also let you ‘possess’ the defeated foe and play in that guise for the remainder of the match.

For those who don’t have enough V-Bucks to purchase the FNAF Fortnite skins, the above method should undoubtedly be appealing. That alone is quite a strong incentive to visit Freddy Fazbear’s Pizzeria, if the abundance of chests and ammo boxes there isn’t enough to convince someone.

The interior of the pizza restaurant carries an uneasy and nerve-wracking atmosphere and features memorable locations from the original game such as the security office, the Pirate’s Cove, and the show stage. The second of these spots is where you can trigger a fight with Foxy, whereas the third one is where you can engage in a face-off against Freddy.

Wrapping up

Fortnitemares is officially in full swing now, and with it, we have already started seeing major horror IPs make their way into Fortnite. FNAF, being among the first collaborators to introduce fresh content in the game, is currently among the most sought-after ones, as suggested by the popularity of its Item Shop cosmetics at the time of writing.

In the coming days and weeks, more of such attention-grabbing collabs are scheduled to arrive, with some very popular characters from new and old IPs such as Obsession and Hollow Knight yet to come. Suffice it to say, the Halloween season in Fortnite this year has fairly diverse content and enough big partnerships to perhaps drive engagement through the whole month.

  • How to get the Champion Focus FNCS skin in Fortnite

title.rendered: Sell Ores codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Sell Ores Codes on October 06, 2026

Sell Ores lets you automate mining with drones, but upgrades and rare materials still take time to collect. Free coatings, Growth Gems, and time skips can help you push through the next stretch faster. Redeem the codes below before starting a long mining session. Copy them exactly because the game can reject even a small typo.

These rewards can give you a useful boost when you’re trying to improve your mining setup without spending too much time on the early grind. Some resources can also make it easier to unlock upgrades and keep your drones working efficiently. Make sure to redeem the active codes as soon as possible, since Roblox codes can expire without much warning.

All working Sell Ores codes

  • MEGAPETS: Primordial Coating (NEW)
  • FREECOATING NEW: 1 Primordial Coating
  • ADMINMUTATION: 1 Admin Coating Spray
  • FRAGMENTS: 25 Admin Ore Fragments
  • FINALE: Free Rewards
  • SECRETCODE: Free Rewards
  • ROBLOXSERVERS: 24 Hour Time Skip
  • ANOTHERONE: Free Rewards
  • ALMIGHTY: 6 hour time skip
  • SORRYFORDATA: Redeem this code for a 24-hour Time Skip
  • BALANCE: Redeem this code for a 6-hour Time Skip
  • EXPANSION: Redeem this code for 1 Small Growth Gem
  • PETFUSION: Redeem this code for a Growth Gem
  • RELEASE: Redeem this code for free Cash
  • DIGSITE: 1x Devils Growth Gem
  • ROBLOXSERVER: Free Rewards

Expired and unverified Sell Ores codes

–

How to redeem Sell Ores codes

Launch Sell Ores on Roblox, then:

  1. Select the Settings gear in the upper-right corner.
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the Settings menu and open the Codes tab.
  3. Enter a code and select Redeem.

Why your Sell Ores code is not working

  • The code expired or was removed after an update.
  • You typed a letter incorrectly or changed the capitalization.
  • You already claimed the code on your Roblox account.
  • Your server needs to update. Rejoin and try again if a new code is rejected.

Copy and paste the code if possible. If it still fails in a fresh server, treat it as expired and move on to the next one.

Where to find more Sell Ores codes

The developers post codes around updates and game milestones. Check the Sell Ores Roblox page and the official Sell Ores Discord for announcements. This page keeps the rewards and redemption steps together when you want to claim them quickly.

For another simulator, try Roll a Fisherman codes, or browse our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: Roll a Fisherman codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Roll a Fisherman codes on October 05, 2026

Roll a Fisherman is all about building a crew of skilled anglers who can help you bring in better catches as you grow your fishing operation. As you progress, you’ll need stronger fishermen and plenty of resources to unlock upgrades, improve your setup, and make your operation more efficient.

The available Roll a Fisherman codes can provide both Spins and in-game currency, helping you build your crew without having to spend as much time on the initial grind. However, there’s one important requirement to remember: you need to finish the tutorial before you can redeem codes. Once you’ve completed it, head over to the Shop, where you’ll find the hidden code box.

We’ve listed the available codes and their rewards below so you can quickly redeem them and get back to building your fishing operation. Make sure to copy each code exactly as shown, as even a small spelling or capitalization mistake can prevent it from working.

All working Roll a Fisherman codes

  • SEALS: 3 Spins (NEW)
  • FISHING: 2 Spins
  • UPGRADES: 500 Gold
  • GOLD: 300 Gold
  • UPDATE2: 2 Spins
  • UPDATE1: 3 Spins
  • RELEASE: 5K Cash

Expired Roll a Fisherman codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Roll a Fisherman codes

Complete the tutorial before opening the code menu. Then launch Roll a Fisherman on Roblox and follow these steps:

  1. Select Shop (plus icon) at the bottom of the screen.
  2. Scroll to the bottom of the Shop menu.
  3. Enter a code in the Enter a code field and select Redeem.

Why your Roll a Fisherman code is not working

  • You have not finished the tutorial yet.
  • The code expired or was removed after an update.
  • The code has a typo or different capitalization.
  • You already redeemed it on your Roblox account.
  • The game server has not updated. Rejoin and try again.
  • You entered SEAL instead of SEALS, or the other way around.

Copy and paste each string exactly. If the latest spelling still fails, try a fresh server and test the singular SEAL version once.

Where to find more Roll a Fisherman codes

New codes may arrive with game updates and milestones. Check the Roll a Fisherman Roblox page and official Discord server for announcements. Keep this list handy when you want to claim spins and upgrade money before fishing.

For another fishing game, see Rogue Piece Rebirth codes, or browse our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: Fortnite x Hazbin Hotel collab: Skins, release schedule, and more

content.rendered:
The popular dark comedy animation Hazbin Hotel has been confirmed for Fortnite, as part of the horror-themed Fortnitemares event. This collaboration was revealed via the gameplay trailer for the event, which also depicted various other IPs that are collaborating with Epic’s acclaimed online multiplayer title this month.

The forthcoming Hazbin Hotel crossover marks the first time its characters will be coming to Fortnite. Besides this Adult Swim series, several major brands with a similar dark vibe, such as Five Nights at Freddy’s and Nightmare on Elm Street, are also headed to the game for Fortnitemares.

Below, you can find all the skins and release window information about Hazbin Hotel that has surfaced as of yet. As more time elapses and the collab is unveiled fully, the current lineup can change to include more cosmetics and themed items.

Fortnite x Hazbin Hotel skins revealed so far

Through a recent Fortnitemares video, Fortnite gave players their first look at Charlie Morningstar, Vaggie, and Alastor skins. While Charlie is the central protagonist of Hazbin Hotel, Vaggie and Alastor are key characters as well in the story.

In the brief clip, the three characters can be seen standing in formation in a hotel interior. Interestingly, Charlie is then also shown—for a split second—as having transformed into a more sinister form with deer antlers and an eerie green glow, which could be the reactive style associated with her Fortnite skin.

The addition of the Netflix animated series’ notable trio is a considerable boost to Fortnite’s ever-diversifying skins catalog, which has over the years expanded to include real-life celebs, fan-favorite fictional characters, and everything in between.

When is Hazbin Hotel coming to Fortnite?

After kicking off on October 1, Fortnitemares is scheduled to run through the entirety of the month. And since the Hazbin Hotel crossover cosmetics are something being advertised for the month-long Halloween-themed event, you can naturally expect the skins to land in Fortnite at least a few days before October 31, if not sooner.

Apart from the obvious, it is worth keeping in mind that Fortnite has already revealed the collabs coming to the Item Shop through October 8. So, it makes sense to assume the Hazbin Hotel crossover will come at some point after that date. Beyond these educated guesses, any other prediction should be seen as merely speculative.

Rounding up

After the FNAF hype over the past few days, fans are now increasingly drawn towards the impending arrival of Hazbin Hotel in Fortnite. But that might just be the tip of the iceberg, as more players voice their interest in learning more about other highly popular IPs, such as the 2025 mega hit Obsession, that are set to get themed cosmetics of their own in the game.

All in all, Fortnitemares 2026 seems to be packing plenty for Fortnite players to dig their teeth into. Other than skins, over the course of the event, it will be interesting all the ways that the game fuses major features such as sprites and match overrides with the event’s spooky theme and how well the players receive it.

FAQs

Which Hazbin Hotel cosmetics are coming to Fortnite?

As of the time of writing, the Hazbin Hotel collab is only confirmed to feature character skins in Fortnite. However, it’s reasonable to expect relevant back blings and pickaxes to be added to the game as well.

Can I get Hazbin Hotel Fortnite skins for free?

title.rendered: Rogue Piece Rebirth codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Rogue Piece Rebirth Codes on October 06, 2026

Rogue Piece Rebirth turns every upgrade into another fight for levels, better gear, and rare drops. As you progress through the game, you’ll need plenty of resources to strengthen your character and keep up with increasingly difficult challenges. Free Gems, Fragments, chests, and rerolls can give you a useful boost when you’re working toward your next build.

However, not every code is available to every player. Several Rogue Piece Rebirth codes require you to reach level 5,000 or even 10,000 before you can redeem them, so make sure you meet the required level before opening the code menu. If a code doesn’t work, double-check the spelling, capitalization, and any level requirements attached to it.

To make things easier, we’ve listed the available codes below along with their rewards and requirements. Copy each code exactly as shown and redeem it as soon as possible, since Roblox codes can expire without much warning.

All working Rogue Piece Rebirth codes

Currently, there are no active codes available. Developers release new codes during events and updates, so check back soon!

How to redeem Rogue Piece Rebirth codes

The code box is inside the Settings menu. Open Rogue Piece Rebirth on Roblox, then:

  1. Click the Settings button on the left side of the screen.
  2. Scroll to the Misc section.
  3. Enter a code in the code box and press Enter.

Why your Rogue Piece Rebirth code is not working

  • Your character has not reached the code’s minimum level.
  • The code expired after a game update or milestone.
  • A letter, number, or exclamation mark is missing or capitalized differently.
  • You already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You are on an older server that has not received the latest game update.

Copy the code from this list and check its level gate first. If a newly released code still fails, join a fresh server and try it again.

Where to find more Rogue Piece Rebirth codes

New strings tend to arrive with updates, milestones, and compensation drops. Check the Rogue Piece Rebirth Roblox page and the official Rogue Piece Discord for announcements. Bookmark this page if you want the reward list and level gates in one place.

If you want more free rewards, check out Hypershot codes and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: How to get Bounty Hunter Sprite in Fortnite?

content.rendered:
Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 has introduced us to tons of new Sprites, and the Bounty Hunter Sprite is one of the latest additions. This little companion is one you should definitely track down, as it can improve your chances of finding other Sprites across the island. However, getting your hands on one isn’t easy, especially if you don’t know where to look. But there’s no need to sweat, as we’ve prepared a complete guide on the Bounty Hunter Sprite in Fortnite, including its abilities, different variants, and locations where you can easily find it.

Bounty Hunter Sprite: Ability and variants

The Bounty Hunter Sprite increases your chances of finding Sprites whenever you eliminate enemies while it’s equipped. This boost can be useful at any point during a match. For instance, if you’re looking for a specific Sprite to help you recover health or deal damage, the Bounty Hunter Sprite allows you to do so.

However, there’s one important thing to keep in mind: the Bounty Hunter Sprite can only level up when you eliminate opponents while it’s equipped. However, this rule doesn’t apply to the Crown and Klombo variants. Fortnite currently has a total of 20 different Bounty Hunter Sprite variations.

  • Bounty Hunter 8-Bit Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Adventure Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Birthday Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Blinky Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Bush Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Crash Bandicoot Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Crown Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Jackrabbit Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Jonesy Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Killswitch Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Klombo Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Morgana Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Onigiri Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Overshield Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Pond Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Shadow Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Sonic Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Storm Scout Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter Tails Sprite
  • Bounty Hunter X-Ray Sprite

How to get Bounty Hunter Sprite in Fortnite

Now that you know what the Bounty Hunter Sprite can do, the next thing to figure out is where you can find it within the game. Your best option is undoubtedly to search for Legendary and Epic Cheat Codes, as they have the highest chance of dropping this Sprite. If you can’t find either of those, you can also check out Rare Cheat Codes.

Another way to obtain the Bounty Hunter Sprite is by searching for it in Vaults. The Sprite also drops from eliminating other players, but there’s only a 7% chance, which makes it a less reliable method. Finally, you can even team up with another player or a friend and work together to track down the Sprite. The Bounty Hunter Sprite isn’t a rare sprite, so you should be able to find it easily.

FAQs

Where can I find the Bounty Hunter Sprite in Fortnite?

You can find the Bounty Hunter Sprite through Legendary and Epic Cheat Codes. It also drops from Vaults and Rare Chests.

What’s the main ability of the Bounty Hunter Sprite?

The Bounty Hunter increases your odds of finding Sprites when eliminating enemies.

title.rendered: Is Obsession coming to Fortnite? Here’s what we know

content.rendered:
It’s fair to say that Obsession is the internet’s favorite horror movie of 2026, which is why it’s no surprise that Fortnite players are wondering whether Epic Games is planning a crossover soon.

After all, we’ve seen Fortnite team up with all kinds of major franchises under the sun, such as Marvel, DC, Jujutsu Kaisen, John Wick, Cyberpunk 2077, and many more. So, a collaboration with one of 2026’s biggest horror hits wouldn’t exactly come as a shock. So, if you’re wondering whether Obsession is coming to Fortnite, here’s everything we know so far.

Is an Obsession crossover coming to Fortnite?

Well, without wasting your time, it’s true: Obsession is coming to Fortnite! Recently, Epic Games dropped a cinematic trailer for the upcoming Fortnitemares. For the unfamiliar, Fortnitemares is Fortnite’s annual Halloween celebration, bringing spooky game modes, ke skins, crossovers, and a variety of other cosmetics to the game.

At the 0:44 mark in the trailer, you can spot One Wish Willow. Without spoiling the movie for anyone who hasn’t watched it yet, the Willow is one of the most crucial parts of the obsession. Its appearance in the trailer basically confirms that a Fortnite x Obsession crossover is on the way.

Epic Games hasn’t exactly revealed when the crossover will arrive in Fortnite. However, it’s worth noting that Fortnitemares begins on October 1, 2026, at 3 AM PT. So players shouldn’t have to wait long to see what Epic Games has in store.

As for the cosmetics, that’s another unknown as of now. The developer hasn’t revealed what sort of cosmetics will be brought to the table, but it’s likely that a Nikki outfit will be an addition. She’s the movie’s main character, and would make the most sense as an outfit if Epic wants to add an Obsession skin. Other than that, we might also see Obsession-themed pickaxes, back blings, loading screens, and other cosmetics.

Get ready for a spooky October in Fortnite

Obsession x Fortnite isn’t the only crossover that’s being planned for Fortnitemares this time around. The official cinematic trailer also gave us a look at several other franchises and characters, including the likes of Slender Man, Freddy Krueger, and Five Nights at Freddy’s. This is just the beginning.

One of the reliable Fortnite dataminers, HYPEX, has also shared details about several other crossovers that are being planned for Fortnite’s Halloween 2026 lineup. Here’s the complete list

  • FNAF
  • Obsession
  • League of Legends
  • Hello Neighbor
  • Freddy Krueger
  • Slender Man
  • Beetlejuice
  • Black Clover
  • The Purge
  • Ken Carson
  • Ember & Blade
  • 99 Nights In The Forest
  • Chucky Sidekick (Leaked)

Of course, crossovers aren’t the only thing coming to Fortnite in October 2026. Players can also look forward to new Sprites, Halloween decorations, new POIs, including Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza, and several limited-time game modes.

With so much content planned, it’s fair to say that Fortnitemares 2026 is shaping up to be one of the biggest Halloween celebrations the game has ever seen.
