title.rendered: Unable to install the iOS 27.0.1 update on iPhone? Here’s how to fix it!

content.rendered:
Updating an iPhone should be straightforward, but seeing “Unable to Install iOS 27.0.1 Update” after waiting for the download to finish can be frustrating. Sometimes the update doesn’t appear at all; other times, the download completes, but the installation fails.

I’ve found that these update problems usually come down to a few things, like not enough available storage, an unstable Wi-Fi connection, or a problem with Apple’s update servers. The good news is that you don’t need to jump straight to complicated solutions.

In this guide, I’ll walk you through the fixes you should try first, starting with the simplest ones. If the over-the-air (OTA) update still won’t install, I’ll also show you how to update your iPhone using a Mac or Windows PC.

Why can’t my iPhone install iOS 27.0.1?

If your iPhone is showing an “Unable to Install” error on the iOS 27 update page, the cause is usually something preventing the update from being downloaded, verified, or installed correctly.

Here are the most common reasons:

  1. Not enough storage space: Your iPhone needs enough free storage to download and unpack the update. If storage is almost full, installation can fail.
  2. Weak or unstable Wi-Fi: A shaky internet connection can cause the download to pause halfway. Updates require a stable Wi-Fi connection to work smoothly. 
  3. Low battery: If your iPhone isn’t fully charged, it won’t start the update. Apple usually wants at least 50% battery or a charger plugged in. 
  4. Temporary software glitch: A problem with the Settings app or iOS itself can sometimes interfere with the update process.
  5. Apple’s servers are busy: When everyone rushes to download the new update at the same time, Apple’s servers can get overloaded, causing delays or errors. 
  6. Older iPhone issues: Some older iPhones may not support iOS 27 updates, or they may experience additional hiccups during installation. 

How to fix iOS update issues

If you are unable to install the iOS 27.0.1 update, don’t stress. Here are some easy fixes you can try:

1. Essentials to download and install iOS updates

Before troubleshooting anything complicated, I’d check a few basics first.

  • Ensure your iPhone is compatible: You can install iOS 27.0.1 on iPhone SE (2nd and 3rd gen), and iPhone Series 11 or later. 
  • Charge your iPhone: Plug in your iPhone for charging before installing the iOS 27 update.  
  • Connect to a stable Wi-Fi network: While you can download iOS updates over cellular data, I’d recommend connecting to Wi-Fi for faster downloads. Also, ensure you have turned off the VPN on your iPhone or router. 
  • Free up space: Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage and clear out apps, photos, or files you don’t need. Ensure at least 20GB of free space to download and install the update smoothly. 
  • Check the Apple server: Go to the Apple System Status page and verify that all services are available. If you see a “Waiting to update…” message on the update page, the best thing to do is wait a few hours. 

2. Force Quit the Settings App

If the Software Update screen isn’t behaving normally, force-quitting Settings is worth trying.

  1. On an iPhone with Face ID, swipe up from the bottom of the screen and hold. 
    • On an iPhone with a Home button, quickly double-press it. 
  2. Drag the Settings app card all the way up to force quit. 
  3. After a few seconds, open the Settings app > General > Software Update and see if you can install the new iOS update.

3. Restart your iPhone

A restart is one of the first things I’d try before changing any settings.

Temporary software processes can occasionally interfere with an update, and restarting gives iOS a clean start.

To restart your iPhone, turn it off, wait for a few seconds, and turn it back on. 

4. Delete the downloaded iOS update and try again

If iOS 27.0.1 has already downloaded but refuses to install, the update file itself could be the problem. You can delete the downloaded update and let the iPhone download a fresh copy.

Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage. Scroll through the list and look for the downloaded iOS 27.0.1 update.

If it appears:

  1. Tap the iOS update.
  2. Tap Delete Update.
  3. Confirm that you want to remove it.
  4. Restart your iPhone.
  5. Go to Settings > General > Software Update.
  6. Download iOS 27.0.1 again.

This is one of the fixes I’d try before resetting network settings because it specifically addresses a potentially incomplete or corrupted update download.

5. Update iOS via Finder (Mac) or Apple Devices/iTunes (Windows)

If the iOS 27.0.1 OTA update continues to fail, use a computer. This is particularly useful when the iPhone can download the update but can’t complete the installation.

Here’s how you can download and install iOS 27 on your iPhone using Finder on Mac: 

  1. Connect your iPhone to your Mac using an appropriate cable. 
  2. Click Trust if you see it on the computer screen. Tap Trust on the iPhone as well. 
  3. Launch Finder and select your iPhone from the sidebar. 
  4. Now, under General, click on the Check for Updates button.
  5. If a notification for an update appears, click the blue Download and Update button. 

5. Reset network settings

This is a near-certain solution to resolve failed software update issues. Recently, my iPhone update also got stuck. 

I switched to three different Wi-Fi networks, but the iOS update still wasn’t downloading. Finally, I reset the Network Settings, and everything was working as expected. 

Note: This will not delete personal data like apps, photos, videos, songs, etc. However, all Network Settings related to Wi-Fi, Cellular, and such will be erased.

  1. Open iPhone Settings and tap General. 
  2. Tap Transfer or Reset iPhone, then tap Reset. 
  3. Select Reset Network Settings. Enter your passcode and confirm your choice.

Once this is complete, try downloading and installing the update again. It will work. 

In rare cases, if this does not help, reset all settings. This, too, won’t delete personal data. But all settings you have ever changed or added, such as notifications, keyboard, Wi-Fi, location, VPN, etc., will be reset to their default state.

Contact Apple Support

If none of the above solutions work, your iPhone may have a hardware issue. Contact Apple Support or visit an Apple Authorized Service Provider to diagnose and resolve the problem. 

Is your iPhone update frozen? Has it been stuck on the same Update Requested screen for a long time? If so, please see this post, where I show multiple solutions to fix the frozen iPhone issue. 

Get iOS 27.0.1 installed without the error

A “Cannot Download and Install iOS 27.0.1 Update” message can look more serious than it actually is. I’d start by checking your Wi-Fi connection, available storage, battery level, and Apple’s system status before changing anything on the iPhone.

With these steps, you should be able to get past most iOS 27.0.1 installation problems without losing your personal data. If you need more help, drop a comment below, and I’ll get back to you.

keyPoints.title: Common Reasons iOS 26 Update Fails to Install
keyPoints.explanation: Issues like insufficient storage, unstable Wi-Fi, low battery, overloaded servers, or unsupported older iPhones can prevent the update from installing successfully.

keyPoints.title: Preparation Essentials for iOS 26 Update
keyPoints.explanation: Ensure your iPhone is compatible, charged, connected to a stable Wi-Fi, and has enough free space (around 20GB) before attempting the update.

keyPoints.title: Force Quit the Settings App to Fix Update Problems
keyPoints.explanation: If the update won't proceed, force quitting the Settings app can resolve temporary glitches; then, reopen it to retry the update.

keyPoints.title: Restart Your iPhone to Resolve Software Glitches
keyPoints.explanation: Rebooting your iPhone can often fix underlying software issues that block the installation process.

keyPoints.title: Use Finder or iTunes to Update If OTA Fails
keyPoints.explanation: Updating via Finder on Mac or iTunes on Windows provides an alternative method to install iOS 26 if over-the-air updates do not work.

title.rendered: GTA 6 Collector’s Edition: Understanding what has changed in 13 years

content.rendered:
13 years is a long, long time. It’s a span of time that encompasses at least two console generations, several dozen AAA games, and in exceptional cases, just two mainline GTA titles as well.

Similarly, between the rollout of GTA 5 in 2013 and the impending launch of GTA 6 this November, it’s not just the industry that significantly changed but also the franchise itself. If that wasn’t already clear from Rockstar Games’ infamous call to make GTA 6 completely disc-less, the recent reveal of the highly awaited game’s collector’s edition should highlight the same again.

In this article, we will look at the various ways GTA 6’s The Goodtime State—Vice City Collection, coming out on November 19, differs from the collector’s edition of GTA 5, the last major entry in the series. Simultaneously, we will also discuss what’s changed for the better and what’s changed for the worse from a gamer’s point of view.

1. Most prolific collector’s edition in GTA history

It’s a widely agreed opinion that quality always trumps quantity. But the joy of getting more physical merchandise isn’t something to be understated either. Fortunately, GTA 6’s collector’s edition seems to be doing well in both departments, especially in the quantity aspect.

GTA 6 The Goodtime State—Vice City Collection comes with an impressive 11 different merch items, ranging from wearable accessories to stuff you’d find in a bar. That’s way more than what was featured in the equivalent editions of GTA 5 and GTA 4, which contained four and five physical goodies, respectively. The full list of all that the Vice City Collection offers is given below:

  • 6-inch Macca the Gator figurine with built-in storage compartment
  • Macca the Gator magnetic mirror
  • Macca the Gator-inspired poster with map on the flip side
  • GTA 6 Oakley Frogskins sunglasses
  • New Era 9FORTY cap
  • Leonida Keys crossbody bag
  • Chunkee the Manatee glass tumbler
  • Vice City spoon
  • Leonida Keys enamel pin set stored in a themed tin box
  • Vice City blade-shaped keychain
  • GTA 6 stickers

2. There is a catch, even at a steep price

While the GTA 6 collector’s edition doesn’t skimp on the sheer number and variety of physical merchandise, there is one major miss in this special bundle—it doesn’t come with the game. In other words, it is strictly a collection of GTA 6 merchandise and nothing else.

For something that retails at an eye-watering $399.99, which is $100 more than what Xbox Series S launched for, the inclusion of a digital copy of the game seemingly should have been a no-brainer. For comparison, back in 2013, GTA 5’s own collector’s edition launched at $149.99 and included the game, bonus digital content, and five pieces of merchandise.

What that tells you is that, while the count of physical merch in a GTA collector’s edition more or less doubled in the past thirteen years, the price increased by around 167%. On top of that, the actual game also stopped being a guaranteed part of such a bundle.

3. A long-overdue first for GTA

It’s almost the norm for most game developers, especially those in the AAA space, to have an imposing statue or a life-size replica item as the most prominent part of their collector’s edition. Gears of War: E-Day, scheduled for an October 6 release, has a diorama featuring the fan-favorite duo of Marcus and Dom. On the other hand, last year’s Ghost of Tsushima had a life-size recreation of protagonist Atsu’s mask headlining its collector’s edition.

However, despite such prevalence of showpieces across the industry, none of the two GTA collector’s editions created by Rockstar devs had anything of the sort. But that’s finally going to change with the forthcoming collector’s edition.

Thanks to the emergence of the Macca the Gator figurine, GTA 6’s collector’s edition marks the first time in series history that a statue inspired by the game has been officially up for grabs. This lets the franchise tick off something that it had been missing in its collector’s edition for several years.

4. No signature lock-and-key this time

Are a game’s physical collectibles a prized possession meant to be kept in a makeshift safe? Maybe. I don’t have a definitive answer. But, for a long time, it looked like Rockstar Games had its mind made up about this question because, for some reason, it bundled in some kind of secure storage item along with its key in each of the two GTA collector’s editions released so far.

On the one hand, the GTA 5 collector’s edition came with a deposit bag & key. On the other hand, GTA 4’s own version offered a deposit box & key combo. However, that short-lived tradition is now set to end after two iterations, as GTA 6’s collector’s edition has no such equivalent.

Even though this does lead to the disappearance of a unique type of item in these special editions for the franchise, it does free up room and resources for having more suitable goodies incorporated in the bundle instead.

5. Most personality of any GTA collector’s edition

Throughout its history, a GTA game’s collector’s edition items, to a reasonable degree, have looked just like regular items slapped with the brand’s logo. Whether we talk about GTA 4’s deposit box, which only had an engraved GTA logo associating it with the game, or GTA 5’s deposit bag, which had a color logo of the award-winning game, we can all agree that the branding on those objects was quite basic at best.

With the arrival of GTA 6 and its own merch-heavy collector’s edition, Rockstar Games has opted for a new design approach that has enabled each item to stand out as a distinct reminder of its associated game. Either through a generous use of GTA 6 imagery or by sporting a more conspicuous motif, everything from the crossbody bag to the tinted sunglasses carries an unmissable GTA 6 aesthetic identity.

Ultimately, this pivot from minimal branding to an instantly recognizable theme has enhanced the raw appeal of the GTA 6 collector’s edition. As a consequence, this assortment of goodies has a stronger personality compared to any of the items in past collector’s editions in the GTA series.

Final word

GTA 6’s The Goodtime State—Vice City Collection is already up for pre-orders in the US, with dates for other regions including Asia, Latin America, and Australia to follow. But I doubt it’s worth grabbing one for yourself simply based on the absurd 400-dollar price tag the bundle has.

At that price point, which is more than the launch price of a current-gen console, purchasing a bunch of goodies themed around a fictional show that you are yet to grow any interest in seems like a big ask for most fans, even some hardcore ones. Given the limited production, Rockstar Games would likely still sell all of its GTA 6 collector’s edition stock. Though there’s not enough that the developer has done to make this one a highly desirable purchase.

  • 10 Things you can do in GTA 6 that you couldn’t do in GTA 5
  • Every song featured in GTA 6 Extended Look
  • Why GTA 6 needs a first-person mode

title.rendered: Download iPhone 18 Pro burgundy wallpapers: 10 Dark, moody designs in 4K

content.rendered:
The iPhone 18 Pro’s new Burgundy finish has a very different personality from the brighter colors Apple has used before. It sits somewhere between deep wine red, cherry, plum and near black, making it surprisingly easy to pair with a dramatic wallpaper.

I wanted something beyond simply matching the phone’s color. So, I put together this Burgundy-focused wallpaper collection with 10 different moods. Explore the collection and download your favorite deep Burgundy aesthetic for free.

Download burgundy iPhone wallpapers in 4K 

My favorite thing about this collection is that some are minimal and luxurious, while others are intentionally dramatic. Tap the Download link below each wallpaper to save the full-resolution image.

1. Burgundy Liquid Glass 

This is the wallpaper I’d choose if I wanted my Burgundy iPhone to look unmistakably premium.

It uses flowing, glossy surfaces in deep burgundy and almost-black shades, creating the illusion of polished glass moving across the screen. If you like the official iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers with Apple’s Liquid Glass aesthetic, get this one.

Download 

2. Burgundy marble surface 

Instead of glossy 3D shapes, this wallpaper uses a black marble surface threaded with deep Burgundy-red veins and subtle metallic highlights. 

I particularly like how much of the image remains nearly black. The Burgundy sections add just enough color to connect it visually with the iPhone finish without looking overly flashy. 

Download 

3. Burgundy shadow with a crown in the dark 

If I wanted my Lock Screen to have a mysterious, royal feel, this would be one of my first choices. 

A deep Burgundy wall catches a dramatic beam of light while the shadow of a crown stretches across the background. A glossy dark-red sphere sits on a black marble pedestal in the foreground. A great theatrical composition! 

Download 

4. Burgundy abstract 3D wallpaper 

This wallpaper is all about abstract curves, looking similar to the official iOS 27 wallpaper. Smooth Burgundy surfaces fold over one another against a nearly black background, with thin highlights tracing the edges. 

On the iPhone screen, the combination of black negative space and saturated red highlights gives the wallpaper a particularly dramatic look. 

Download 

5. Burgundy architecture that feels like an Apple Store from the future 

Here’s a symmetrical, monumental structure that rises from a reflective black-and-Burgundy floor, surrounded by towering dark walls and subtle red illumination. 

The symmetry is what makes it memorable. Your eye naturally travels toward the central doorway, giving the wallpaper a strong sense of depth. 

Download  

6. Burgundy butterfly to turn your Lock Screen into art 

The Burgundy butterfly wallpaper adds something softer to the collection without abandoning the dark aesthetic. 

The butterfly’s wings combine deep crimson, burgundy and black, with the fine wing details picked out by subtle highlights. It brings a little nature into an otherwise very futuristic collection. 

Download 

Also check out: 20 Stunning Nature Wallpapers for iPhone & Desktop (Free 4K) 

7. Burgundy chrome reflection 

If the other wallpapers feel elaborate, this one deliberately keeps things simple. 

A single glossy Burgundy sphere floats against a pure-black background, with a subtle reflection beneath it. The large areas of empty black space give your screen a minimalist look. 

Download 

8. Burgundy planet from a dark little universe 

A textured Burgundy-red planet sits almost alone in a huge black expanse, surrounded by tiny points of light. I particularly like how the wallpaper doesn’t try to fill the screen. The emptiness is part of the cinematic space design. 

Download 

9. Burgundy rose wallpaper for iPhone 

The Burgundy Rose is the most classic design here, but the dark lighting keeps it from looking like a traditional flower wallpaper. 

The rose is photographed against an almost-black Burgundy background, with tiny water droplets catching the light across the petals. It’s romantic without being overly bright or colorful. 

Download  

10. Burgundy smoke background 

The final wallpaper is the most fluid of the collection. Wisps of translucent Burgundy and crimson smoke twist and curl through an almost completely black background. 

Unlike the hard edges of the Liquid Glass and Chrome designs, this one feels soft and atmospheric.  

Download  

Which burgundy wallpaper should you download? 

Final thoughts 

Burgundy gives the iPhone 18 Pro a bold, luxurious personality, and the right wallpaper can make that finish stand out even more. From glossy Liquid Glass and dark marble to the rose, butterfly, planet, and smoky designs, each wallpaper brings a different mood to the Lock Screen. 

I’d personally switch between them depending on my mood. Some days I’d want something minimal, while other days I’d go for a more dramatic look. 

So, which Burgundy wallpaper would you pick for your iPhone?

title.rendered: Amazon launches faster Fire TV Stick 4K with redesigned remote

content.rendered:
Amazon has launched a new Fire TV Stick 4K with Wi-Fi 6, a slimmer body, and USB power from a TV. The company says it runs faster than the previous Fire TV Stick 4K Select, though it has not published a speed figure or benchmark. A redesigned Fire TV Remote comes in the box, with a standalone version for existing Fire TV players.

A slimmer 4K stick can use TV USB power

The new stick combines 4K streaming with the slim design Amazon introduced on its Fire TV Stick HD earlier this year. It can draw power from a TV’s USB port through the included cable, so a separate power adapter is not needed for the setup Amazon describes. That should reduce cable clutter behind a television and makes the stick easier to carry for travel.

The stick also supports Wi-Fi 6, which Amazon says can help keep it connected when several devices share a network. Amazon has not shared processor details or a measured performance gain, so the faster claim is relative to the older model rather than a published benchmark readers can compare.

The software details vary across Amazon’s regional announcements. The Australia launch pairs the device with Amazon’s new Fire TV experience and Alexa+ Early Access, while the Brazil and Mexico announcements identify Vega OS. Amazon has not announced an India price or release date.

The bundled remote is easier to use by touch

Amazon reshaped the remote so it is easier to orient without looking down: its top is flat while the curved, weighted bottom helps it settle in the hand. Buttons have more distinct shapes, and the home button has a raised, recognizable surface. The star button, previously reserved for Amazon’s higher-end remote, can open a favorite app or a shortcut such as closed captions or Dialogue Boost.

Dedicated power, volume, and mute buttons can control a compatible TV, soundbar, or receiver. Amazon says the remote pairs with Fire TV streaming players launched from 2019 onward, so people with an older stick can buy the remote separately rather than replace the whole player.

Amazon plans to introduce a Fire TV Remote Plus in 2027. It adds an aluminum body, backlit buttons, and Find My Remote, which can make the remote play a sound through a compatible Alexa device. That is a separate planned accessory; it is not included with this Fire TV Stick.

Price and availability depend on the market

Amazon has confirmed local pricing and dates in four markets so far:

  • Australia: A$129 for the stick, shipping from October 1; A$24.95 for the standalone remote, shipping October 22.
  • Japan: ¥11,980 for the stick, on sale from September 30; ¥2,980 for the remote, shipping October 22.
  • Brazil: R$579 for the stick, with preorders from September 30 and delivery from November 2; R$169 for the remote, shipping November 29.
  • Mexico: MXN 1,499 for the stick, available now; MXN 259 for the remote, shipping in late October.

Amazon has not disclosed a broader global rollout or an India launch date, so buyers elsewhere will need to wait for local availability details.

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

title.rendered: ChatGPT adds virtual try-on for clothes and saved shopping finds

content.rendered:
ChatGPT can now create a preview of how clothes or accessories might look on you, then save products to revisit later. The tools are available in ChatGPT on mobile and the web, adding a visual layer to the product search flow.

Try on clothes with a selfie

Eligible clothing and accessory listings now have a Try on button. Select it, then take or upload a selfie to generate a preview with ChatGPT Images. You can also upload a picture of an item in a conversation and ask ChatGPT to show how it might look on you. The try-on builds on ChatGPT’s image tools to place an item into a generated preview.

ChatGPT saves reference photos for future try-ons, so you do not have to upload the same selfie each time. You can replace or delete a photo in Settings > Personalization > Reference photos. That gives users a way to manage the image they have chosen for this feature, though OpenAI’s help information does not describe additional privacy controls specific to try-on photos.

Saved finds live in ChatGPT Library

Tap the bookmark icon on a product to save it to Favorites. You can also create folders in ChatGPT Library to group products, then return to them later. That is useful if you are comparing several items over time instead of buying from the first result.

The virtual preview has limits: OpenAI says it may not match your appearance or the product exactly, and it does not confirm fit or size. Check a merchant’s measurements, product details, and return policy before ordering. The image can help you picture a style, but it cannot tell whether a garment will fit.

ChatGPT is still a shopping search tool

When a question signals shopping intent, ChatGPT can show product images, details, and links to merchants. OpenAI says those results are selected independently and are not ads or influenced by its commercial partnerships. That makes the results a discovery tool: the merchant still controls the listing, price, availability, and return terms. Check its product page before buying, especially if you are comparing size or color options.

ChatGPT uses the request and context such as a budget to choose products, but OpenAI warns that it can misunderstand what you want or leave out relevant options. Some listing labels and review summaries are generated from third-party information and are not guarantees. Treat the carousel as a shortlist to inspect, not a complete or verified comparison of everything for sale.

Some eligible products and merchants also support Instant Checkout, while other purchases take you to the retailer’s site. Try-on and saved finds keep more of product discovery inside ChatGPT, but the merchant still handles the actual purchase. Google’s Gemini and AI Mode checkout test with Flipkart points to the same broader shift toward shopping inside AI assistants.

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

title.rendered: Apple Mail on Mac may lose Microsoft 365 sync as EWS shutdown begins

content.rendered:
Microsoft has started phasing out Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online, putting some Microsoft 365 work accounts at risk of losing sync in Apple Mail and Calendar on Mac. The rollout began on October 1, but it will not affect every organization at once: Microsoft is disabling EWS in stages before shutting it down fully on April 1, 2027.

For now, the change matters mainly to people who use Apple’s built-in Mac apps with a work or school account hosted on Microsoft’s cloud service. It does not affect every Apple Mail account, and it does not apply to companies that run their own Exchange servers.

The Mac apps use a different Exchange connection

Apple’s Mail and Calendar apps on Mac still use EWS to connect to Exchange Online. Microsoft’s retirement therefore affects how those apps sync messages and calendar information with a Microsoft 365 account. If an organization disables EWS for its account, the apps may stop updating even though the account itself still works.

iPhone and iPad use Exchange ActiveSync instead, so the same account may continue syncing in Apple’s mobile Mail and Calendar apps after the Mac connection is affected. The split can be confusing if a message appears on a phone but not on a Mac, or if a calendar change fails to show up on one device.

Why Microsoft is retiring EWS

Microsoft announced the EWS retirement in 2023 and stopped adding features to the service in 2018. It is now moving organizations and third-party apps toward Microsoft Graph and other current options. Microsoft says the shutdown will happen in phases, and it has documented options for organizations that need to keep EWS running beyond the October start.

That gives IT departments time to find which tools still rely on EWS and plan a move. Microsoft recommends checking EWS usage reports and coordinating migrations with app vendors. The transition matters beyond Apple apps: any organization that relies on other older software tied to EWS will need to account for the same deadline.

Apple’s replacement is still in development

Apple says it is working with Microsoft to update Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Notes, and Reminders on Mac to use the Graph API in a future macOS 27 update. Apple has not announced when that update will arrive, so organizations should not assume it is already available as EWS starts shutting down.

If you use a Microsoft 365 account in Apple Mail on Mac, ask your workplace or school’s IT team whether it is affected and what client they recommend during the transition. Coworkers may see the change at different times because each organization’s EWS settings affect the rollout. Apple’s Mac email app guide can help compare alternatives, but check with IT before switching a managed account. Microsoft’s final EWS cutoff is April 1, 2027, and Apple’s Graph support does not have a confirmed release date yet.

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to buy an iPhone with non-genuine parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

mainEntity.name: Can I reset parts and service history?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Do third-party repairs affect warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unauthorised repairs may void parts of your warranty.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

mainEntity.name: Can AppleCare+ be used with unknown parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple may require replacement with genuine parts before providing coverage; otherwise, the warranty may be void.

title.rendered: Hypershot codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Hypershot codes on October 02, 2026

Who doesn’t like a good FPS game? If you’re looking for something to play on Roblox, Hypershot is worth checking out. It’s a title all about fast-paced gunfights, movement, and kill streaks as you go up against other players across various game modes.

However, if you want to dominate the lobby, you’ll need plenty of gems and coins to get your hands on the best weapons. Luckily, we’ve just got the thing to help you out. So, let’s take a look at the complete list of all Hypershot codes that can help you get some free rewards.

All working Hypershot codes

None

Expired or unverified Hypershot codes

NEWUPDATE, 100K, CHRISTMAS2025, CONTRACTS, HAPPYMAY, ONEBILLION, SIXSEVEN, THANKSGIVING

How to redeem Hypershot codes

Now that you know all the active codes, it’s also crucial to know how to redeem them. Luckily, the process is quite simple and only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Hypershot codes:

  1. Open up Hypershot on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on the Rewards icon at the top of the screen.
  4. Paste a working code in the ‘Enter Code Here’ box and click on Redeem.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Hypershot codes

The developers don’t release new Hypershot codes on a fixed schedule. Most new codes appear alongside major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Hypershot Discord server for announcements.
  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Roblox Navy War codes, Fabled Legacy codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

title.rendered: Fortnitemares 2026: Release date, time, and everything we know

content.rendered:
It’s time to get ready for the spooky season! Epic Games has confirmed that Fortnitemares 2026 kicks off on October 1, 2026.

For those unfamiliar with the event, Fortnitemares is Fortnite’s annual Halloween celebration that brings new skins, limited-time game modes, spooky quests, themed map changes, exclusive rewards, and plenty of Halloween surprises. If you’re excited to celebrate Halloween in Fortnite, here’s everything you need to know about the Fortnitemares 2026 release date, start time, and what to expect.

Fortnitemares 2026 Release date and time

Fortnitemares 2026 officially begins on October 1, 2026, as confirmed by Epic Games on X.

Although Epic hasn’t announced an official end date, the event is expected to run throughout October before wrapping up around October 31, which also marks the end of Chapter 7 Season 4: Override.

Before the update goes live, Fortnite servers will go offline for scheduled maintenance. Downtime typically lasts a few hours, after which players should be able to jump into Fortnitemares at approximately 3:00 AM PT. Keep in mind that maintenance can finish earlier or later than expected, so the exact launch time may vary slightly.

What can we expect from Fortnitemares 2026?

Fortnitemares 2026 is shaping up to be one of the biggest Halloween events Fortnite has seen. From exciting crossovers to spooky map updates and returning game modes, there’s plenty for players to look forward to.

Crossovers

Epic Games has released a cinematic trailer teasing several franchises that could join Fortnite during Fortnitemares. Popular Fortnite leaker HYPEX has also highlighted several crossover references spotted in the trailer, including:

  • Five Nights at Freddy’s (FNAF)
  • Obsession
  • League of Legends
  • Hello Neighbor
  • Freddy Krueger
  • Slender Man
  • Beetlejuice
  • Black Clover
  • The Purge
  • Ken Carson
  • Ember & Blade
  • 99 Nights in the Forest
  • Chucky Sidekick (Leaked)

Players can expect themed outfits, back blings, pickaxes, emotes, loading screens, and other cosmetic items inspired by these franchises.

Loot Pool, Sprites, and Map changes

Fortnitemares 2026 will also bring back several fan-favorite Halloween weapons and items. The Pumpkin Launcher, Witch Broom, and other spooky equipment from previous years are expected to return.

Sprites are joining the Halloween festivities too, with new additions including:

  • Pumpkin Sprite
  • Vampire Sprite
  • Phase Dash Sprite
  • More seasonal Sprite variants

The Fortnite island will receive its annual Halloween makeover with decorated POIs featuring pumpkins, cobwebs, spiders, graveyards, fog, and Jack-o’-lanterns.

Leaked information also suggests Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza could arrive as a brand-new point of interest, alongside several other map changes.

Finally, players can once again team up in the returning Horde Rush Limited-Time Mode (LTM), where squads fight waves of Cube Monsters while completing objectives for exclusive rewards.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • Fortnite x FNAF collab: All skins and cosmetics revealed so far
  • All Exotic Weapons in Fortnite and how to get them
  • Birthday Cake in Fortnite: All locations in Battle Royale and OG modes

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Do third-party repairs affect warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unauthorised repairs may void parts of your warranty.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

title.rendered: iPhone stuck at update requested? 8 fixes that actually work

content.rendered:
Waiting to try the latest iOS 27 features only to get stuck on the dreaded “Update Requested” message can be frustrating. I’ve found that this usually means the iPhone has started the update process but hasn’t moved on to downloading or preparing the update yet.

The good news is that you don’t need to jump straight to complicated fixes. In most cases, checking your internet connection, restarting your iPhone, or making sure you have enough storage space can get things moving again. In this guide, I’ll share some reliable fixes to clear the “Update Requested” state and get the update installing smoothly.

What does “Update Requested” mean on iPhone?

When you go to Settings > General > Software Update and tap Download and Install for iOS 27, your iPhone has to communicate with Apple’s update servers before the download and OTA installation can proceed.

The “Update Requested” message means your iPhone has started the update process but hasn’t moved on to the next stage yet. A short delay isn’t necessarily a problem, particularly when the update has just been released and many people are trying to download it.

However, if your iPhone remains stuck on “Update Requested” for an unusually long time and nothing happens, it’s worth troubleshooting the connection, storage, or update file.

Why is my iPhone stuck on update requested? 

There are several possible reasons why iOS 27 isn’t moving past “Update Requested”:

  1. Slow or unstable Wi-Fi: If your connection drops or is slow, your iPhone can’t move forward. 
  2. Busy Apple servers: When everyone rushes to update at the same time, Apple’s servers get overloaded. 
  3. Low storage space: Not enough free space on your iPhone? The update won’t download.
  4. The downloaded update has problems: A partially downloaded or corrupted update may need to be removed and downloaded again.
  5. The update is taking longer than expected: Large iOS releases can take time to download and prepare.
  6. Glitches or bugs: Sometimes, your iPhone just gets stuck due to a random software hiccup.

How to Fix “Update Requested” on iPhone

If your iOS 27 update is stuck, try the solutions below to resolve the issue. I recommend starting with the simplest solutions before resetting any settings.

1. Give the update some time

Before changing anything, give your iPhone a little time.

Major iOS releases can attract a huge number of users at once, and downloading or preparing a large update can take longer than expected. Apple also notes that download time depends on the update size and your internet speed.

Make sure your iPhone is:

  • Connected to a reliable Wi-Fi network.
  • Connected to a charger.
  • Not downloading other large files or content.
  • Connected to Wi-Fi rather than relying on an unstable connection.

Then leave the iPhone alone for a while and check Settings > General > Software Update again.

If it remains stuck indefinitely, move on to the next fix.

2. Force quit the Settings app

The next step is to force close the Settings app. 

  • On iPhones with Face ID: Swipe up from the bottom center and hold to bring up the App Switcher. Find the Settings app and swipe it up to force close. 
  • On iPhones with a Home button: Double-press the Home button to access the App Switcher, then swipe up on the Settings app. 

Wait a few seconds, reopen Settings, and check if the update starts downloading. 

3. Check your Wi-Fi and restart the router

A weak or unstable Wi-Fi connection is one of the first things I would check.

Try these steps to help trigger the iOS 27 download:

  1. Open Settings and tap Wi-Fi.
  2. Make sure you’re connected to the correct Wi-Fi network.
  3. Move closer to your router if the signal is weak.
  4. Restart your Wi-Fi router to refresh the connection.
  5. Try another Wi-Fi network if one is available.
  6. If you use a VPN, temporarily disconnect it and try the update again.

You can also test the Wi-Fi connection by opening Safari and visiting a few websites.

If the internet isn’t working reliably, fix the connection before trying the iOS 27 update again.

4. Restart your iPhone

A simple restart can clear temporary software glitches that may be preventing the update from progressing.

On an iPhone with Face ID:

  1. Press and hold either volume button and the side button together.
  2. When the power-off slider appears, drag it.
  3. Wait about 30 seconds for the iPhone to turn off.
  4. Press and hold the side button until you see the Apple logo.

After the iPhone restarts, go to Settings > General > Software Update and then try downloading iOS 27 again.

If your iPhone is completely frozen or doesn’t respond, you can force restart it instead. Press and quickly release Volume Up, press and quickly release Volume Down, then press and hold the Side button until the Apple logo appears.

5. Delete the iOS update file (If visible)

If iOS 27 has already been partially downloaded, the update file itself could be causing the problem.

You can remove it and start over:

  1. Open iPhone Settings and tap General. 
  2. Tap iPhone Storage. 
  3. Scroll down, and if you see any file named iOS 27, tap it.
  4. From the next screen, tap Delete Update. 
  5. Next, restart your iPhone and follow the steps to download iOS 27 again. 

This method helped me when the update repeatedly refused to download or install.

6. Free Up Storage Space on Your iPhone

If your iPhone lacks sufficient storage, the update might fail to proceed. 

  • Try deleting unused apps, large photos/videos, and offline music to free up at least 15GB of space. 

You can also follow our detailed guide on how to free up space on iPhone. 

7. Reset Network Settings

Network glitches can block the update request from proceeding. Here’s how to reset them:

  1. Open Settings and tap General. 
  2. Tap Transfer or Reset iPhone. 
  3. Tap Reset > Reset Network Settings and proceed. 
  4. After this is complete, try downloading the update again. It will work. 

In the rare case that resetting the network is not enough, reset all settings. The steps are the same as above. Just make sure to select Reset All Settings in step 3.

This will remove saved Wi-Fi passwords and custom network configurations.

8. Update via Mac or Windows PC

If the over-the-air update continues to get stuck on “Update Requested,” updating through a computer can be a useful workaround.

  • On Macs with macOS Catalina or later: Use Finder.
  • On the latest Windows PC: Use the Apple Devices app
  • On older Macs or Windows PCs: Use iTunes.

Connect your iPhone, back it up, and check for updates. For step-by-step instructions, follow our guide on how to update your iPhone using Finder or iTunes.

Signing off

Getting stuck on “Update Requested” while trying to install iOS 27 doesn’t necessarily mean something is seriously wrong with your iPhone. In many cases, the update simply needs more time, a more reliable network connection, or a fresh download.

I’d start with the easiest fixes: check Wi-Fi, connect the iPhone to power, restart it, and try again. If that doesn’t work, delete the iOS 27 update from iPhone Storage and download it again.

If you’re still facing trouble, feel free to drop your questions in the comments, and I’ll be happy to help.

keyPoints.title: Understanding 'Update Requested' on iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: This message indicates that your iPhone is waiting for permission from Apple servers to start downloading the new iOS update.

keyPoints.title: Common causes of the problem
keyPoints.explanation: Issues like slow Wi-Fi, overloaded Apple servers, insufficient storage, or software glitches can cause your iPhone to get stuck on 'Update Requested'.

keyPoints.title: How to fix the issue step-by-step
keyPoints.explanation: Solutions include force quitting the Settings app, checking Wi-Fi and router, restarting the iPhone, deleting update files, freeing up storage, resetting network settings, or updating via iTunes or Finder.

keyPoints.title: Ensuring proper Wi-Fi connection
keyPoints.explanation: Using a stable, fast Wi-Fi connection and restarting the router can help kickstart the download process.

keyPoints.title: Using a computer for update recovery
keyPoints.explanation: When all else fails, updating your iPhone through Finder (Mac with macOS Catalina or later) or iTunes (Windows or older Macs) can resolve stubborn update issues.

title.rendered: Apple’s rumored smart display may use an iMac G4-style stand

content.rendered:
9to5Mac’s summaries of Bloomberg’s September 30 reporting describe a 6-inch square display on a half-dome speaker base and point to an October 13 debut. The tabletop design reportedly recalls the iMac G4, with a metal arm holding the display above its base.

The screen is said to have a gray aluminum finish, rounded corners, and black bezels about a quarter inch wide. The base reportedly has a rubberized bottom and rings of speaker holes. Users may be able to tilt the display forward or back.

The same report says the tabletop model would use USB-C for power and have no built-in battery, so it would need to stay plugged in. It reportedly has no volume or power buttons, plus a front-facing FaceTime camera without a rear camera.

Apple may offer a wall-mounted version

The report also describes a wall-mounted version. It would place a thin, square speaker and microphone base below the display, with USB-C power.

The 6-inch screen is smaller than the roughly 7-inch panel described in an earlier report on Apple’s Home Hub. Apple has not announced the device or confirmed the date or design, so the specifications remain unverified.

excerpt.rendered: Apple may introduce its rumored smart display on October 13. Bloomberg’s report also describes a 6-inch screen, an iMac G4-style stand, and a wall-mounted version.

title.rendered: WhatsApp adds optional parental controls for teen accounts

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is adding optional parental controls that teens and parents can set up together. Parents can choose who sees a teen’s profile photo, limit who can add them to groups, and require a parent-set PIN before certain settings can be loosened.

The controls also add group activity alerts. Parents can be notified when a teen joins or leaves a group, or when a group the teen is in grows meaningfully in size. WhatsApp has not shared a number for what counts as meaningful growth.

Parents can set limits on more features

Parents can choose how their teen uses Channels, whose Status updates the teen can see, and who can view the teen’s Status. They can also pick between Meta AI’s default 13+ experience and a stricter Limited Content option.

These are controls for teen accounts, not a new account type. WhatsApp already offers parent-managed accounts for younger children, which parents can set up with both phones.

Messages remain private

Parents do not get access to a teen’s conversations or calls. WhatsApp says personal messages and calls remain end-to-end encrypted, even when parental controls are on. Families can adjust or turn the controls off at any time.

WhatsApp has not named a rollout date or the first supported regions. The company says it will build the controls step by step, so availability may vary while the feature rolls out. Read the details in WhatsApp’s announcement.

excerpt.rendered: WhatsApp’s new optional controls let parents and teens set privacy, group, Status, Channels, and Meta AI limits together while keeping personal chats private.

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to buy an iPhone with non-genuine parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

mainEntity.name: Can I reset parts and service history?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Do third-party repairs affect warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unauthorised repairs may void parts of your warranty.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

mainEntity.name: Can AppleCare+ be used with unknown parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple may require replacement with genuine parts before providing coverage; otherwise, the warranty may be void.

title.rendered: DoorDash opens a U.S. iOS waitlist for ordering by text

content.rendered:
DoorDash has opened a waitlist for a text-ordering beta for U.S. iOS users. Instead of browsing the app, customers can message a dish, ask for nearby recommendations, or request their usual. DoorDash then searches local menus and suggests a cart.

The beta builds on Ask DoorDash, the assistant already in the app. It can send photos of dishes from a restaurant’s listing, so customers can choose without opening the DoorDash app.

DoorDash says the assistant can account for preferences such as skipping cilantro or adding extra sauce. It can also handle different quantities and dietary requests in a group order. Customers can review the suggested cart and confirm checkout in the message thread.

The beta is still limited

DoorDash says U.S. customers using iOS can apply to join the beta waitlist through its official announcement. The company has not announced when text ordering will become broadly available.

DoorDash also announced separate grocery updates inside its app: shoppers can rebuild a regular basket with one tap and review lower-priced equivalent swaps before checkout. Those tools are separate from the text-ordering beta.

The text flow joins other efforts to move purchases into assistant interfaces. Google is testing a Flipkart checkout in Gemini and AI Mode and has outlined a Universal Cart plan that spans Search, Gemini, YouTube, and Gmail.

excerpt.rendered: U.S. iOS users can join DoorDash’s waitlist for text ordering. The assistant finds meals, builds group orders, and handles checkout in the same message thread.

mainEntity.name: How do I see parts and service history on iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Go to Settings > General > About > Parts and Service History. It will only appear if your iPhone has been repaired before.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to buy an iPhone with non-genuine parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Unknown label means Apple could not verify the part or repair status. The phone may still work, but you should understand what was repaired and consider that the Unknown part might affect trade-in value.

mainEntity.name: Can I reset parts and service history?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This information cannot be erased or changed.

mainEntity.name: Do third-party repairs affect warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unauthorised repairs may void parts of your warranty.

mainEntity.name: Does service history affect resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. iPhones with genuine parts usually sell for more.

mainEntity.name: Can AppleCare+ be used with unknown parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple may require replacement with genuine parts before providing coverage; otherwise, the warranty may be void.

title.rendered: How to change the default search engine in Safari

content.rendered:
Your search engine choice shapes privacy, relevance, and even sustainability. With iOS 27, changing Safari’s default across your Apple devices is simple and puts you in control. No need to install another browser!

Whether you lean toward DuckDuckGo to leave fewer digital trails, use Ecosia to plant trees while browsing, or stick with Google because the results align with real-world work, this guide shows you the exact steps on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. I’ll also cover setting a different engine for Private Browsing, as well as quick fixes when Safari refuses to adhere to your choice.

By the end of this walkthrough, you will be able to control Safari search across all your Apple devices. No surprises—just the engine you picked.

What changing Safari’s search engine actually does (and what it doesn’t)

Before changing the setting, it’s worth knowing what it affects.

When you change Safari’s default search engine, it is used when you type a search query into Safari’s Smart Search field. That choice controls suggestions and the results page you land on.

This doesn’t mean every search feature on your iPhone suddenly switches to the same provider. Spotlight Search, swipe down on an iPhone or iPad, or press Command + Space on a Mac, and Siri continues to use its own blended results, regardless of Safari’s pick.

So, I think of it this way: you’re customizing Safari’s search engine, not the device’s entire search capabilities. Also, changing Safari’s search engine doesn’t turn Safari into a different browser. Your other browsers, such as Chrome or Firefox, have their own search settings.

Supported search engines in Safari

Safari typically includes five main search engine options, although availability can vary by region. You will find them in Safari Settings on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

  • Google: The most popular option with a comprehensive index.
  • DuckDuckGo: Privacy-focused search that does not track your queries or build profiles.
  • Ecosia: Environment-focused engine that uses ad revenue to plant trees.
  • Bing: Microsoft’s search engine with integration across Microsoft services.
  • Yahoo: Long-standing provider with curated content and news.

Each engine has distinct strengths, so choose based on priorities, whether that’s comprehensive results, privacy, environmental impact, or features you prefer. Simple.

Steps to change your default search engine in Safari

Change default search engine on iPhone and iPad

Changing your search engine on iOS is straightforward and takes just a few taps:

  1. Go to Settings → scroll down to Apps → tap on Safari.
  2. Tap on Search Engine under Search → Choose any search engine that fits your preference.

Your changes are saved automatically; there’s no need to tap “Done” or confirm anything. The next time you search in Safari, you will see results from your chosen engine.

Change default search engine on Mac

The process on Mac is equally simple:

  1. Launch the Safari browser.  
  2. From the menu bar at the top, select Safari → navigate to Settings.
  3. Head to the Search tab.
  4. Click the drop-down menu next to the Search engine option to select your choice.

Your selection is applied immediately across all Safari windows and tabs. If the menu is grayed out, check Screen Time or a managed profile.

Note: Alternatively, you can click the search icon from the search bar to switch between different search engines in a single click.

How to use a different search engine in Safari private browsing

This is one of the more useful Safari settings if you don’t want your normal and private searches going through the same search provider. This is perfect if Google’s wide results help day-to-day, and DuckDuckGo’s privacy matters for sensitive topics.

On Mac:

  1. Open the Safari settings as shown above and tap on the Search tab at the top.
  2. Deselect the Also use in Private Browsing checkbox.
  3. Click the dropdown menu next to the Private Browsing search engine and choose your search engine of choice.

When you make this switch, Safari will use the search engine you chose in Private mode the next time you browse the web.

On iPhone/iPad:

  1. Go to Settings → Apps → Safari and toggle off Also Use in Private Browsing.
  2. Now, tap on Private Search Engine. You will see a list of search engines. Tap on the one you want to use for Private Browsing.

Once you have selected your preferred search engine, Safari will automatically use it whenever you open a new Private Browsing tab.

Using different engines with Safari profiles

Safari Profiles, like “Work” and “Personal”, keep contexts separate, but there is a key limitation. The default search engine typically applies across all profiles.

You cannot assign different default engines per profile, although you can search with different engines inside each profile when needed. Quick workaround: keep each engine’s homepage in Favorites and jump as required. This keeps profile-specific browsing tidy while search behavior stays consistent.

Why can’t I change my Search Engine? (Troubleshooting)

If changing the engine is not working, these are the usual culprits and fixes.

The option is greyed out:

This almost always points to Screen Time limits. Annoying, but fixable:

  1. Go to Settings → Screen Time → Content & Privacy Restrictions.
  2. Turn Content & Privacy Restrictions off, or set Web Content to Unrestricted Access.

It’s a managed device:

If your iPhone, iPad, or Mac is managed by a school or company, policies may block changes. Contact your IT team if you need this adjusted.

Regional availability:

Some engines are not available in every country due to local regulations or licensing requirements. The list you see is what is available in your region. If you want another provider, bookmark its homepage and search from there.

Additional tips to improve the Safari experience

Troubleshooting common issues in the Safari browser can be a daunting task. To make things easier, we have compiled some helpful tips and tricks for the best Safari experience. Below are a few other hacks:

  • Safari is regularly updated to fix bugs and add new features, so always install the latest version.  
  • Clearing the Safari cache and cookies on your iPhone and Mac can help you resolve website loading issues, so make sure you clear them periodically.  
  • Extensions and plug-ins can sometimes interfere with Safari. Try disabling them to see if they’re the cause of your issues.  
  • If you’re having issues with webpages loading, try changing your DNS server to a different one.

Should you change Safari’s search engine?

I don’t think there is one search engine that makes sense for everyone. After using different search engines, I would choose based on what I actually care about when searching.

If you want the search experience you’re already familiar with, you might stick with Google. If privacy is more important, consider DuckDuckGo. If you want to try something different, Bing or Ecosia are easy alternatives. The nice thing is that you’re not locked into the decision.

So, test a few engines and notice what works best for you!

FAQs

How can I set a different search engine for Private Browsing in Safari?

On a Mac, open Safari, select Settings, then choose Search, and use the “Private Browsing search engine” dropdown. On your iPhone or iPad, go to Settings > Safari > Private Search Engine, located just below the primary Search Engine setting, and select your preferred option.

Why is the Safari search engine option greyed out on my device?

This usually means Screen Time restrictions are active. Go to Settings, Screen Time, Content & Privacy Restrictions, adjust Web Content or turn the switch off.

Which search engines are available in Safari?

Safari typically offers Google, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Bing, and Yahoo, although availability varies by region.

Does changing the Safari engine affect Spotlight or Siri search results?

No. This only changes Safari’s address bar, while Spotlight and Siri continue to use their own systems.

Can Safari Profiles use different default search engines?

No. The search engine setting applies across all profiles, although you can still visit a different engine’s homepage or use a bookmark within each profile when needed.

Will a school or work device let me change the Safari search engine?

It depends on your organization’s device management policies. Managed devices may block this setting.

How do I fix search suggestions still showing my old engine?

Clear Safari history and website data in Settings, Safari, Clear History and Website Data, then force quit and relaunch Safari. On Mac, Safari’s Clear History feature also works.

mainEntity.name: How can I set a different search engine for Private Browsing in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a Mac, open Safari, select Settings, then choose Search, and use the "Private Browsing search engine" dropdown. On your iPhone or iPad, go to Settings > Safari > Private Search Engine, located just below the primary Search Engine setting, and select your preferred option.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Safari search engine option greyed out on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: This usually means Screen Time restrictions are active. Go to Settings, Screen Time, Content & Privacy Restrictions, adjust Web Content or turn the switch off.

mainEntity.name: Which search engines are available in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safari typically offers Google, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Bing, and Yahoo, although availability varies by region.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the Safari engine affect Spotlight or Siri search results?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This only changes Safari's address bar, while Spotlight and Siri continue to use their own systems.

mainEntity.name: Can Safari Profiles use different default search engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The search engine setting applies across all profiles, although you can still visit a different engine's homepage or use a bookmark within each profile when needed.

mainEntity.name: Will a school or work device let me change the Safari search engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your organization's device management policies. Managed devices may block this setting.

mainEntity.name: How do I fix search suggestions still showing my old engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear Safari history and website data in Settings, Safari, Clear History and Website Data, then force quit and relaunch Safari. On Mac, Safari's Clear History feature also works.

keyPoints.title: How to Change Your Default Safari Search Engine
keyPoints.explanation: You can switch your default search engine on iPhone, iPad, or Mac via Settings or Safari Preferences, and the change applies across all your Safari browsing.

keyPoints.title: What Changing the Search Engine Actually Does
keyPoints.explanation: Altering the default search engine only affects Safari's address bar suggestions and results, not other search features like Spotlight Search or Siri.

keyPoints.title: Supported Search Engines in Safari
keyPoints.explanation: Safari offers Google, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Bing, and Yahoo as search options, with availability depending on region and device.

keyPoints.title: Steps to Customize Search Engine for Private Browsing
keyPoints.explanation: You can set different search engines for regular and private browsing modes on Mac, iPhone, or iPad, enhancing privacy or convenience as needed.

keyPoints.title: Troubleshooting Search Engine Change Issues
keyPoints.explanation: If the option is greyed out, restrictions like Screen Time, device management policies, regional limits, or device management may be preventing changes; adjusting settings or contacting IT can help.

title.rendered: How to hide caller ID on iPhone when making a phone call

content.rendered:
I sometimes want to make a phone call without handing over my phone number, especially when I’m contacting a business, responding to an unfamiliar listing, or simply don’t want the person to call me back. If you are looking for the same, the good news is that iPhone gives a simple way to hide your Caller ID.

This guide explains how to hide your Caller ID on an iPhone running iOS 27, including the settings path, single-call options, carrier limitations, and how to turn Caller ID back on.

Why you may want to hide your caller ID

Hiding your Caller ID masks your phone number, so the person you’re calling sees an incoming call banner or a full-screen call with a “No Caller ID”, “Private,” or “Unknown” label. No name or number will be displayed. Thus, they won’t be able to know who called them. 

People hide Caller ID for several reasons: 

  • Avoiding callbacks 
  • Protecting privacy when contacting businesses 
  • Making surprise or anonymous calls 
  • Preventing your number from being stored or shared 

Whatever your reason, iOS 27 offers built-in tools to hide your number for all outgoing calls or a single call.

Method 1: Hide your caller ID for all calls (iPhone settings)

This is the easiest and most common way to hide your number. Once enabled, every call you make will display “No Caller ID.” 

How to turn off your Caller ID in iOS 27: 

  1. Open the Settings app.
  2. Scroll down and tap Apps > Phone.
  3. Select Show My Caller ID.
  4. Toggle off Show My Caller ID.

When this switch is off, your number stays hidden for all outgoing calls unless you intentionally reveal it (more on that later).

Note: Some carriers don’t allow Caller ID disabling systemwide. If the toggle is missing or grayed out, your carrier may require you to use a code (see Method 2) or contact carrier support.

Method 2: Hide caller ID for a single call

If you want to reveal your number normally but hide it for a single call, iOS supports this via a carrier prefix. It temporarily blocks Caller ID for one outgoing call.

The important part here is that the code isn’t universal. It depends on your country and carrier.

  1. Open the Phone app.
  2. Go to the Keypad. 
  3. Dial *67 following the phone number. Example: *67 555-123-4567 for United States carriers.
  4. Tap the Call button to ring the number.  

The person you’re calling will see No Caller ID, whereas your number is visible to others. 

If you use other US carriers, stay in European countries, or travel to countries such as Australia, South Africa, Canada, or India, the code to hide Caller ID is #31#. For South Korea, it is *23#, and for the United Kingdom and Ireland, it is 141. Check the code for your country here.

This is ideal when: 

  • Calling someone you don’t know 
  • Responding to ads or job listings 
  • Contacting businesses that you don’t want calling back 

Method 3: Ask your carrier to block your number

If you want total privacy without relying on settings or prefixes, your mobile carrier can disable your Caller ID at the account level. Also, this method is the only way if your carrier doesn’t support short codes.

What carrier blocking does 

  • Hides your Caller ID permanently for all outgoing calls 
  • Overrides your iPhone settings 
  • Works even if you switch phones 

Some carriers provide Calling Line Identification Restriction (CLIR) for free; others may charge a small fee. You need to enable this option in the carrier’s official app or on its website.

For Verizon, you will have to sign in to your account. Next, under Block Services or Additional Services, you will find the Caller ID option. From here, you can hide it.

For Sprint, sign in to your carrier account. Next, select your phone, then click Change my service > Set up your phone > Block Caller ID.

Note: AT&T and T-Mobile allow you to use the code or the iPhone Settings app to hide the caller ID.

If the app or website method (or the first two methods) does not work, contact your carrier’s customer care via phone, email, or in-store and ask for help blocking the caller ID.

Limitations: When hiding caller ID won’t work

Even when Caller ID is off, there will still be some instances where your number will show.

Caller ID may still show if you call:

  • Emergency services (911)
  • Toll-free numbers 800, 888, etc.
  • Businesses that use special call-routing systems 
  • Contacts who use apps or services that reveal caller identity 

These systems override privacy settings for safety or verification reasons. 

How to show your caller ID on iPhone

If you want your phone number to show normally: 

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Go to Phone.
  3. Tap Show My Caller ID.
  4. Turn the switch on.

Decide who sees your number!

Hiding Caller ID on an iPhone is fast, easy, and even adaptable to your needs. You can make your calls totally private or hide them for just a single call. And you have multiple options that work reliably. If you liked this guide, check out more comprehensive iPhone tips and tricks.

FAQs

Does hiding the Caller ID hide my number from everyone?

No. It prevents your number from being displayed through normal Caller ID, but your carrier still knows which number placed the call. Certain emergency or specialized services may also handle caller information differently.

Will text messages show my number?

Yes. Caller ID hiding only affects voice calls, not SMS or iMessage.

Does hiding Caller ID work with FaceTime?

No. FaceTime has separate Caller ID controls. You can choose whether your phone number or Apple Account email address is used for FaceTime Caller ID in Settings > Apps > FaceTime.

Is this supported worldwide?

Most countries support Caller ID blocking, but availability varies by carrier.

mainEntity.name: How can I set a different search engine for Private Browsing in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a Mac, open Safari, select Settings, then choose Search, and use the "Private Browsing search engine" dropdown. On your iPhone or iPad, go to Settings > Safari > Private Search Engine, located just below the primary Search Engine setting, and select your preferred option.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Safari search engine option greyed out on my device?

acceptedAnswer.text: This usually means Screen Time restrictions are active. Go to Settings, Screen Time, Content & Privacy Restrictions, adjust Web Content or turn the switch off.

mainEntity.name: Which search engines are available in Safari?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safari typically offers Google, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Bing, and Yahoo, although availability varies by region.

mainEntity.name: Does changing the Safari engine affect Spotlight or Siri search results?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This only changes Safari's address bar, while Spotlight and Siri continue to use their own systems.

mainEntity.name: Can Safari Profiles use different default search engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The search engine setting applies across all profiles, although you can still visit a different engine's homepage or use a bookmark within each profile when needed.

mainEntity.name: Will a school or work device let me change the Safari search engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your organization's device management policies. Managed devices may block this setting.

mainEntity.name: How do I fix search suggestions still showing my old engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear Safari history and website data in Settings, Safari, Clear History and Website Data, then force quit and relaunch Safari. On Mac, Safari's Clear History feature also works.

step.name: Open Settings and go to Phone
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone, scroll down and tap Apps, then select Phone.

itemListElement.text: Launch the Settings app on your iPhone.
Scroll down and tap on Apps.
Find and tap the Phone option from the list.

step.name: Turn off Show My Caller ID
step.text: Tap Show My Caller ID and toggle it off to hide your number on all outgoing calls.

itemListElement.text: Tap on Show My Caller ID.
Turn off the toggle to disable caller ID display for all calls.

step.name: Open the Phone app and go to Keypad
step.text: Launch the Phone app on your iPhone and tap on the Keypad tab at the bottom.

itemListElement.text: Open the Phone app on your iPhone.

step.text: Type *67 followed by the phone number you want to call. For example, *67 555-123-4567.

blockGraphs.question: Does hiding the Caller ID hide my number from everyone?
blockGraphs.answer: No. It prevents your number from being displayed through normal Caller ID, but your carrier still knows which number placed the call. Certain emergency or specialized services may also handle caller information differently.

blockGraphs.question: Will text messages show my number?
blockGraphs.answer: Yes. Caller ID hiding only affects voice calls, not SMS or iMessage.

blockGraphs.question: Does hiding Caller ID work with FaceTime?
blockGraphs.answer: No. FaceTime has separate Caller ID controls. You can choose whether your phone number or Apple Account email address is used for FaceTime Caller ID in Settings > Apps > FaceTime.

blockGraphs.question: Is this supported worldwide?
blockGraphs.answer: Most countries support Caller ID blocking, but availability varies by carrier.

title.rendered: How long does Apple support iPhones: Everything you need to know

content.rendered:
I’ve always considered long-term software support one of the biggest reasons to buy an iPhone. Even an older iPhone can continue receiving major iOS updates years after its launch, which is one reason these devices tend to hold their value so well.

That said, it’s important to consider how long Apple supports each iPhone model when buying an older or refurbished device. In this article, I’ll give you all the details you need to know about Apple’s support for different iPhones, so you know how many years of support to expect for your device.

How long does Apple Support iOS?

Based on Apple’s update history, most iPhones receive six to eight years of iOS support, although Apple does not promise a fixed number of major iOS versions for every iPhone. This is great from a longevity and security standpoint, as it ensures that your device will function optimally for several years.

The latest iOS 27 compatibility list is particularly interesting because Apple still supports the iPhone 11 series, which launched in 2019. That means the iPhone 11 can now run a major iOS release roughly seven years after its original launch.

However, it’s important to note that Apple cannot continue to support devices that are too old, as technology advances rapidly. Older devices lack the technical components such as the processor, available memory, and other hardware capabilities to keep up with the demands of the latest software.

iPhone software support timeline

To make it easier for you, I’ve compiled a table showing Apple’s support for every iPhone model, including its release and discontinuation dates.

Keep in mind that the dates are estimates based on past releases, with an average of 7 years of support. So, they may change in the future as newer devices and iOS versions become available.

What happens when Apple no longer supports your iPhone?

When Apple no longer supports your iPhone, it means the device will no longer receive software updates, including critical security patches and new features. Without these updates, your iPhone becomes increasingly vulnerable to security risks and compatibility issues with apps and services that require newer software versions.

However, the phone doesn’t suddenly stop working. You’ll still be able to use many of the features and apps that already work on the device.

But over time, certain apps may stop working altogether, and you may encounter performance problems with your iPhone as well.

Additionally, if your iPhone encounters hardware issues, you may find it difficult to get repairs or replacements from Apple or authorized service providers as they gradually phase out support for older models. Hence, it’s best to keep your device up-to-date and ensure it’s still supported by Apple.

What are the obsolete and vintage iPhones?

When we consider the question, “How many years does Apple support iPhones in terms of hardware?” here’s what the Apple Support website states:

“Owners of iPhone, iPad, iPod, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple Vision Pro and Beats products may obtain a service and parts from Apple service providers for a minimum of five years* from when Apple last distributed the product for sale.”

This support may extend for up to seven years, depending on parts’ availability.

So, if your iPhone was still being sold by Apple up to 7 years ago, you could most likely get it fixed if you run into any issues. This is where we need to consider Apple’s list of obsolete and vintage iPhones.

Obsolete iPhones are those whose sales were discontinued by Apple more than 7 years ago, and as a result, hardware servicing is no longer available for them. Similarly, there are Vintage iPhones. These are those that have not been sold for more than 5 years (but fewer than 7 years). Apple can still service these devices, provided it has access to the needed parts.

Let’s see which iPhones belong to these categories.

What is the oldest iPhone still supported?

At the time of writing this—in October 2026—Apple still supports iOS 15, which means the iPhone 6S is the oldest device to receive occasional critical security updates. However, this model is also on Apple’s list of obsolete devices, so I recommend upgrading your device. The same applies to the first-generation iPhone SE.

Since Apple has discontinued support for iOS 12, the iPhone 5s, iPhone 6, and 6 Plus no longer receive software updates. Therefore, if you own an iPhone 6 or an older model, upgrading your iPhone is advisable.

Which iPhones are compatible with Apple Intelligence?

In June 2024, Apple announced Apple Intelligence, which is all set to revolutionize how you interact with your iPhone.

This advanced technology requires significant processing power, so it can only work on the latest iPhones. Currently, the iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 series and later are compatible with Apple Intelligence.

Of course, the upcoming iPhone 18 models are also expected to support this new technology.

Signing off

Apple does a great job of offering support for its iPhones. Thanks to this, you know your money is being invested in technology that will serve you well and last. In addition, it makes it worth buying an iPhone that’s a couple of years old—unless you absolutely need the latest and greatest hardware and software experience.

You can save this guide and refer to it whenever you want to check how long your iPhone will be supported. If you have further questions, let us know in the comments below.
