title.rendered: Collect the Alphabet codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Collect the Alphabet Codes on October 01, 2026

If you’re looking for a Roblox game that’s easy to pick up and play, Collect the Alphabet is worth checking out. The premise is simple: collect all 26 letters, build your own display case, and show off your collection while earning money. However, collecting every letter isn’t as easy as it sounds, as you’ll need to open card packs and gather other resources.

To help players, the developers have released several codes that provide free rewards. So, let’s look at all the Collect the Alphabet codes and how to redeem them.

All working Collect the Alphabet codes

  • GREEK24: 4x Mythic Packs (NEW)
  • UPDATE3: 3x Mythic Packs
  • TIME: 1 2x Mutation Luck Potion
  • VOLCANO: 3x Mythic Packs
  • OPCODE: 3x Double Mutation Luck Potions
  • 1MMEMBERS: 1x Mythic Pack
  • ALPHABET2: 4x Mythic Packs
  • RANDOM: 2x Luck Potion
  • MASTER: 3x Mythic Packs
  • 100KMEMBERS: Redeem this code for 3 Mythic Packs

At the moment, these are the only active Collect the Alphabet codes available to redeem. We’ll keep this list updated and add new codes as soon as the developers release them.

Expired Collect the Alphabet codes

5MVISITS, AURA, NUMBERS, SEPTEMBER, SORRY

  • AURA
  • NUMBERS
  • SEPTEMBER
  • 5MVISITS
  • SORRY

How to redeem Collect the Alphabet codes in Roblox

You might now be wondering how to redeem Collect the Alphabet codes. Thankfully, the process is simple. Follow the steps below to claim your rewards:

  1. Open Collect the Alphabet on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Look at the right side of the screen and click the Settings button.
  4. Scroll down to the Codes box, paste a working code, and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed a code, the corresponding rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Collect the Alphabet codes

The development team behind Collect the Alphabet doesn’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new codes. However, be sure to join the official Collect the Alphabet Discord server, as new codes are often announced there first.

Codes are usually released to celebrate major milestones, updates, or events, so keep an eye on the game’s official Roblox page for the latest announcements.

Be sure to bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated with the latest codes as they’re released. If you enjoy shooting games and want more free rewards, check out the latest The Veil codes, Mog or Die codes, and our complete list of Roblox game codes.

FAQs

How do you get more letters in Collect the alphabet?

You can obtain letters by opening different card packs and spending in-game resources. Keep in mind that some letters are rarer than others, so you may need to keep grinding to find them.

How do you earn money in Collect the Alphabet?

You can earn money by collecting and displaying different letters. Obtaining rarer cards will help increase your earnings.

Why can’t I redeem Collect the Alphabet codes?

If a code isn’t working, make sure you’ve entered it correctly and check whether it has expired. There’s also a chance that you’ve already redeemed it.

title.rendered: Birthday Cake in Fortnite: All locations in Battle Royale and OG modes

content.rendered:
The event commemorating Fortnite’s ninth birthday has taken over the game this week, bringing several themed items and quests with it. Among the most prominent of these items are Birthday Cake slices, which you can find across the Fortnite Override map in both Battle Royale and OG modes.

Birthday Cake slices restore health and shields, making them handy consumables during intense matches. At the time of writing, there is also a Fortnite quest that requires you to find and eat a certain number of cake slices, giving you another reason to scour the map for them.

In this article, we cover all the named locations in both Fortnite modes where you can find Birthday Cake slices during the birthday event.

Where to find birthday cake slices in Fortnite Battle Royale

Battle Royale originally had a bug that prevented Birthday Cake slices from spawning on the map, but it has since been fixed. You can now find Birthday Cakes at the seven named locations listed below. There are eight cakes in total, as two can be found in and around Stone Sanctum.

Interestingly, the cakes appear to be spread fairly evenly across the map.

  • Cluster Coast
  • Green Hill Zone
  • Heatwave Harbor
  • Latte Landing
  • Lifty Lodge
  • Stone Sanctum
  • Wonkeeland

Where to find birthday cake slices in Fortnite OG

Compared with Battle Royale, Fortnite OG has a few more locations where you can find Birthday Cake slices. However, the cakes are concentrated in the western, central, and southern parts of the map rather than being evenly distributed.

The following nine points of interest contain Birthday Cakes in OG mode:

  • Fatal Fields
  • Junk Junction
  • Lonely Lodge
  • Loot Lake
  • Paradise Palms
  • Pleasant Park
  • Salty Springs
  • Shifty Shafts
  • Snobby Shores

Keep in mind that Birthday Cakes are limited-time items and will remain available in Fortnite only until October 1. As a result, the locations containing these cakes are likely to be highly contested. Be sure to scan the area for opponents before approaching a cake, and watch your surroundings while your character eats it.

Rounding up

Fortnite’s birthday theme has taken over the game since the beginning of the week, with items such as Balloons, Birthday Presents, and Birthday Cakes becoming part of the gameplay. This refreshing change has influenced how players approach each match and provided more strategic options.

Next Thursday, Epic Games’ multiplayer title will undergo a significant transformation, shifting from a festive atmosphere to a darker setting as Fortnitemares begins. The Halloween-themed event is expected to feature major Fortnite collaborations with horror properties such as Obsession, Child’s Play, It, and Five Nights at Freddy’s, among others.

title.rendered: Fortnite 9th Anniversary: All Birthday 2026 quests and rewards

content.rendered:
Fortnite turned 9 in 2026, and the ongoing birthday-themed event, titled “Fortnite Celebration,” kicked off on Monday, September 21, to mark the occasion. As part of the event, several new quests and intriguing birthday party-inspired consumables have arrived in the game, while the Birthday Sprite is also set to arrive soon.

More importantly, there is a range of new anniversary cosmetics that you can obtain by completing certain tasks in Fortnite matches. Thankfully, none of the tasks are too challenging, so most players should be able to complete them with ease.

Below, we list all the birthday celebration-related quest objectives and their corresponding rewards that are available in the game at the time of writing.

Fortnite Celebration quests and rewards list

The following table lists all the available rewards. Some can be obtained by completing individual tasks during gameplay, while others can be unlocked by reaching quest milestones, such as completing a specific number of tasks.

Fortnite Celebration event duration

As with every event, Fortnite Celebration is available for only a limited time and is scheduled to end on October 1. With around a week remaining, the aforementioned quests should be fairly easy to complete before the event ends.

Once Fortnite Celebration concludes, it will be replaced by Fortnitemares, a Halloween-inspired event. Naturally, the upcoming event will have a horror theme, and Fortnite’s official social media channels have already teased its arrival.

Wrapping up

It wouldn’t be wrong to say that Fortnite’s ninth-anniversary celebrations have taken over multiple aspects of the game. From a dedicated sprite to themed quest rewards, the game currently has “birthday mode” written all over it.

Once the ongoing event wraps up, Fortnitemares could take its place as another all-encompassing Fortnite event. In fact, it is already generating considerable anticipation within the community, with players speculating about which major franchises might appear.

Among the IPs rumored to be involved or previously teased and seemingly well suited to the Halloween-themed season are Obsession, Five Nights at Freddy’s, and It.

excerpt.rendered: Fortnite’s ninth-birthday celebration brings new quests, XP rewards, themed cosmetics, and party-inspired items. Here’s everything you can unlock before the event ends.

mainEntity.name: Can I get the Champion Focus FNCS skin for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not anymore. It was available for free for high-performers in the FNCS Cup until September 20, but it is now only available in exchange for V-Bucks via the Item Shop.

mainEntity.name: How many FNCS skins are available in Fortnite?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are two FNCS skins available for purchase, namely the Champion Focus skin, which came out in September 2026 and the Champion Surf Witch skin from September 2025.

mainEntity.name: Does the FNCS bundle also include the Champion Surf Witch skin?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the FNCS bundle that is in the Item Shop only comes with the Champion Focus skin and its related cosmetics.

acceptedAnswer.text: You can obtain letters by opening different card packs and spending in-game resources. Keep in mind that some letters are rarer than others, so you may need to keep grinding to find them.

mainEntity.name: How do you earn money in Collect the Alphabet?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can earn money by collecting and displaying different letters. Obtaining rarer cards will help increase your earnings.

title.rendered: Roblox Slayers 2 codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Slayers 2 Codes on October 04, 2026

For all the Demon Slayer fans out there, there’s a Roblox game you definitely want to check out: Slayers 2. The game lets you choose your path as either a Slayer or a Demon before sending you into an open world filled with quests, weapons, enemies, and plenty of exploration.

Of course, as you progress, you’ll need plenty of resources to level up and skill up your character. Luckily, there are tons of codes that can give you a head start with free rewards. So, let’s take a look at all the working Slayer 2 codes that can give you cash, ores, free spins, and more.

All the working Slayers 2 codes

  • Roguelike: 35 Spins (NEW)
  • ROGUELIKERACERESET: Resets your race (NEW)
  • M1LL1ON: 50 Spins, 10,000 Wen, and 2x Luck

As of now, these are the only active Slayers 2 codes available to redeem. We’ll make sure to keep this list updated and add any new codes as soon as the developers release them.

Expired Slayers 2 codes

ANIM4L, ARTRESET, BREATHRESET, EVILARTSPINS, POINTSRESET, RELEASE26, SKILLTREERESET, SORRYFORSHUTDOWN, SPINS50

  • EVILARTSPINS
  • SORRYFORSHUTDOWN
  • SORRYFORSHUTDOWN

How to redeem Slayers 2 codes in Roblox

The next big question you might be wondering is: how do you redeem Slayers 2 codes? Well, it’s quite a simple process, and we’ve outlined each step below to help you claim your rewards.

  1. Fire up Slayers 2 on Roblox.
  2. Once you’re on the landing page, look for the code redemption box
  3. Paste a working code, and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Slayers 2 codes

The development team behind Slayers 2 doesn’t have a fixed schedule for dropping codes for the game. However, make sure to join the official Slayers 2 server, as this is the place where new codes are often announced first.

Codes are usually dropped to celebrate major milestones, updates, or events, so keep an eye out on the game’s official page on Roblox for the latest announcements.

Make sure to bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated with the latest codes as they’re released. If you’re into shooting games and want more free rewards, check out the latest The Veil codes, Mog or Die codes, Collect the Alphabet codes and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

FAQs

Why can’t I redeem Slayers 2 codes?

If a Slayers 2 code isn’t working, check if you’ve entered it correctly and that it hasn’t expired. There’s also a chance that you’ve already redeemed the code.

What are Spins used for in Slayers 2?

Spins in Slayers 2 can be used to obtain different rewards and help your character progress.

title.rendered: 30+ iPhone settings you should change after updating to iOS 27

content.rendered:
I’ve been using iOS 27 since it launched, and there are quite a few settings I think you should check after updating your iPhone. Some are completely new, while others have been improved with Apple’s latest software.

From Siri AI and Live Translation to smarter Safari tools, expanded parental controls, and new camera options, these settings can help you get more out of your iPhone. If you’re setting up an iPhone 18 Pro, or planning to get the new iPhone Duo, here are the settings I recommend checking first after updating to iOS 27.

1. Turn on Siri AI

Apple has introduced a new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence. Siri AI can understand more natural requests, use personal context, understand what’s on your screen, and perform actions across apps.

For example, instead of giving Siri a simple command, you can ask it to find information buried in your apps, draft an email, or help you work with content on your iPhone.

Siri AI is available in beta on supported Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhones and is currently rolling out in English. Availability varies by language and region.

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Siri.
  3. Select Try Siri AI (Beta).
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions.

Apple says Siri AI is available on iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16 models and later, including iPhone 18 Pro models and iPhone Duo.

2. Customize Siri’s new voice

iOS 27 also gives Siri AI a more expressive voice experience on supported models.

If you’re using an iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Air, or supported iPhone 17 Pro models, you can adjust Siri’s voice, pace, and expressivity.

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Siri.
  3. Tap Voice.
  4. Choose a voice.
  5. Adjust the Pace and Expressivity slider.

If Siri sounds too robotic or too slow for you, this is worth checking.

3. Enable Live Translation in Messages

Live Translation is one of the most useful iOS 27 features if you regularly communicate with people who speak another language. It works in Messages, Phone, and FaceTime, translating conversations in real time. Apple says the feature runs entirely on-device, although availability varies by language and region.

Use Live Translation in Messages

  1. Open the Messages app and tap the conversation you want to translate.
  2. Tap the person’s name at the top of the screen.
  3. Turn on Automatically Translate.
  4. If iPhone doesn’t automatically detect the language, tap Choose Language.
  5. Select the language you want to translate.
  6. Return to the conversation and start typing. Your message will be translated as you type.

When you send it, the recipient receives both the translated message and your original message. Messages you receive are also translated into your preferred language.

Live Translation in Phone calls

You can also use Live Translation during a phone call.

  1. Start a call in the Phone app.
  2. During the call, tap More.
  3. Tap Live Translation.
  4. Choose the language if it isn’t already selected.
  5. Tap Start Translation.
  6. Both people will hear spoken translations, and you can also read an on-screen transcription.

4. Turn on Call Screening

If unknown callers constantly interrupt me, Call Screening is one of the first Phone settings I’d enable.

With Call Screening, iPhone can ask an unknown caller for their name and reason for calling before I decide whether to answer.

How to set it up

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Apps and select Phone.
  3. Scroll to the Screen Unknown Callers section, then choose your preferred option. I have selected Ask Reason for Calling.
  4. You can also toggle on Unknown Callers.

This is particularly useful if you receive lots of calls from numbers you don’t recognize.

5. Turn on Adaptive Power

Adaptive Power is designed to extend battery life by learning how I use my iPhone and automatically adjusting on days when my usage is higher.

Apple introduced Adaptive Power with iOS 26, and it remains relevant for compatible devices in the current iOS generation. Apple says it learns typical battery usage and adjusts the system to help extend battery life.

To enable it, go to Settings → Battery → Power Mode, then toggle on Adaptive Power.

If battery life matters more to you than squeezing out every bit of performance, I’d leave this enabled.

6. Tweak the Liquid Glass effect

If you don’t like the transparency of Apple’s Liquid Glass interface, you don’t have to live with the default appearance.

To reduce transparency:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Appearance.
  3. Select Liquid Glass.
  4. Adjust the slider to make the interface more or less opaque.

I particularly recommend this if transparent menus or backgrounds make text harder to read.

7. Turn off full-screen screenshot previews

iOS continues to display screenshots as full-screen previews by default.

Personally, I prefer the old temporary thumbnail because I often take several screenshots in quick succession.

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap General.
  3. Tap Screen Capture.
  4. Toggle off Full-Screen Previews.

Apple confirms this setting remains available in iOS 27.

8. Set up automatic Tab organization in Safari

If you usually have dozens of Safari tabs open, iOS 27 can now organize them automatically. Safari’s Topics feature groups your open tabs based on their content, such as Technology, News, or Travel, making them easier to find.

  1. Open Safari and go to the Tab Switcher.
  2. Tap the Filter button at the top.
  3. Tap Organize Tabs.
  4. Select Automatically Create Topics.

Safari will then group your tabs into relevant topics. Tabs that don’t fit a topic will remain separate.

You can also try the Notify Me feature in Safari to get alerts when something changes on a webpage, such as a product becoming available or a price changing.

9. Customize the Action Button

The Action Button remains one of my favorite shortcuts on recent iPhones.

On supported models, it can launch features such as Silent Mode, Camera, Visual Intelligence, Flashlight, Voice Memo, Translate, Magnifier, Shortcuts, and Accessibility.

To customize Action Button:

  1. Open Settings and go to Action Button.
  2. Swipe through the available options and choose the one you use most.

If I were setting up a new iPhone 18 Pro today, I’d definitely revisit this setting rather than leaving it at the default.

10. Customize Camera Control

The iPhone 18 Pro continues to include Camera Control, and iOS 27 gives me more control over how it behaves.

You can access settings such as:

  • Exposure
  • Depth
  • Zoom
  • Cameras
  • Photographic Styles
  • Tone

You can also customize which controls appear and change their order.

  1. Go to Settings → Camera → Camera Control.
  2. Toggle on Camera Adjustments and tap Customize.
  3. Now choose your preferred settings.
  4. Get back and ensure Lock Focus and Exposure is enabled.

Camera Control also provides options to open the native Camera or Instagram Camera with a single click or double-click.

11. Explore the iPhone 18 Pro Camera Controls

If you’ve upgraded to an iPhone 18 Pro or 18 Pro Max, there are several camera settings worth exploring.

The new 48MP Fusion Main camera has a variable aperture with ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8, and ƒ/4.0 options. The Pro models also have 48MP Ultra Wide and Telephoto cameras, with up to 8x optical-quality zoom.

Apple also adds Pro controls for:

  • Aperture
  • Shutter speed
  • White balance
  • Histogram
  • Photographic Styles
  • Customizable default lens

You can also put your favorite camera controls above the viewfinder:

  1. Launch Camera and tap the Camera Controls button.
  2. You will see an Edit option at the top.
  3. Add tools such as Timer, Exposure, Styles, Aspect, or Depth, then drag them into the order you want.

12. Turn on Optimized Battery Charging

Optimized Battery Charging is still worth enabling if you plan to keep your iPhone for several years. It learns your charging routine and reduces the amount of time the battery remains fully charged.

  1. Go to Settings → Battery
  2. Tap Charging and toggle on Optimized Battery Charging.

I have set my Charge Limit at 80% to preserve battery lifespan.

13. Turn off personalized ads

If I want to reduce Apple’s use of my activity for ad personalization, I check this setting.

  1. Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Apple Advertising.
  2. Then turn off Personalized Ads.

Keep in mind that this doesn’t necessarily reduce the number of advertisements you see. It changes how personalized Apple’s ads are.

14. Disable In-App Ratings & Reviews

Those “Rate this app” pop-ups can get annoying.

To stop them:

  1. Open Settings, scroll down, and tap Apps.
  2. Select App Store and toggle off In-App Ratings & Reviews.

I usually turn this off because I prefer leaving reviews when I actually decide to do so.

15. Limit microphone and camera access

I don’t like giving every app unrestricted access to my microphone and camera, so I keep my private moments safe.

  1. Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
  2. Review the apps that have access and disable anything you don’t trust.
  3. Get back and select Camera. Toggle off unnecessary apps.

16. Turn off Lock Screen access to sensitive features

If you’re concerned about someone accessing features while your iPhone is locked, review your Lock Screen access settings.

  1. From Settings, go to Face ID & Passcode.
  2. Enter your passcode to authenticate.
  3. Under Allow Access When Locked, review options such as:
    • Control Center
    • Siri
    • Home Control
    • USB Accessories
    • Reply with Message
    • Wallet

I personally recommend disabling anything you don’t need while the phone is locked.

17. Turn On Find My iPhone

This is one setting I never recommend skipping.

Apple’s Find My app lets you locate your iPhone if it’s misplaced, lost, or stolen. But it only works if Find My iPhone is enabled beforehand. Otherwise, you won’t be able to track your iPhone using Apple’s Find My network.

  1. Go to Settings and tap on your name to access your Apple Account.
  2. Select Find My and tap Find My iPhone.
  3. Turn on:
    • Find My iPhone
    • Find My Network
    • Send Last Location

18. Optimize Storage with High-Efficiency Format

High-quality photos take up a lot of space, and a large collection can quickly strain your iPhone’s storage. Switching to the High-Efficiency format (HEIF/HEVC) reduces file size while maintaining image quality.

  1. Go to Settings → Camera → Formats.
  2. Select High Efficiency.

This is especially useful if you’re taking lots of high-resolution photos and 4K video.

19. Turn off auto-correction

Auto-Correction can be helpful, but I know I’m not the only person who has had an iPhone “correct” a perfectly intentional word.

  1. Go to Settings → General → Keyboard.
  2. Toggle off Auto-Correction if you prefer to control your own typing.

20. Customize dark app icons

If you’re using Dark Mode, I recommend checking your Home Screen customization too.

  1. Touch and hold an empty area on the Home Screen.
  2. Tap Edit icon at the top.
  3. Tap Customize.
  4. Choose Dark.

You can also explore the other appearance options available in iOS 27.

21. Set up Emergency SOS

I hope you never need this setting, but it’s worth configuring before an emergency happens.

Go to Settings → Emergency SOS, then review options such as:

  • Call with Hold and Release
  • Call with 3 Button Presses
  • Call After Severe Crash

Make sure you have set up emergency contacts.

22. Update parental controls

Apple redesigned Screen Time and added several new controls for parents.

Parents can now use Time Allowances for categories such as Entertainment, Games, and Social Media, while Schedules can control which apps are available at particular times.

To access the new controls, open: Settings→ → Family → [Child’s Name].

From there, you can manage options including:

  • Time Allowances
  • Screen Time Schedules
  • Apps & Websites
  • Communication settings
  • Content restrictions
  • Ask to Browse

Apple says the new Screen Time experience requires the relevant family devices to be updated to iOS 27 or the corresponding new operating systems.

23. Turn on Stolen Device Protection

I strongly recommend checking this after setting up a new iPhone.

Stolen Device Protection adds a one-hour delay when you’re away from trusted locations and requires Face ID to change critical details like your Apple ID password. So, no one can change sensitive settings on your iPhone—even if they know your passcode.

  1. Go to Settings → Face ID & Passcode → Stolen Device Protection.
  2. Then turn it on and set a preferred Require Security Delay option.

24. Hide App Store purchases

There’s always one app you once had on your iPhone, but you don’t want your partner to find out you did. In that case, you can replace the Cloud icon next to the App’s name on the App Store with the Download icon.

Once you’re done, no one will ever know that you downloaded the particular app in the past.

  1. Open the App Store.
  2. Tap your profile picture at the top.
  3. Select Apps & Purchase History.
  4. Tap Your Apps and find the app.
  5. Swipe left and tap Hide.

25. Set up Live Voicemail

Live Voicemail lets you see a transcription of what someone is saying while they’re leaving a voicemail. So, you can decide whether to answer immediately.

  1. Go to Settings → Apps → Phone.
  2. Scroll down and toggle on Live Voicemail

This is useful when I don’t recognize the number but still want to know why someone is calling.

26. Lock private apps

If you have sensitive apps on your iPhone, iOS lets you lock them with Face ID to keep them secure from prying eyes.

  1. Touch and hold the app icon on your Home Screen.
  2. Select Require Face ID.

This is particularly useful for banking, messaging, photo, and note-taking apps.

For better security, I choose Hide and Require Face ID. It moves the app to the Hidden folder in the App Library.

27. Turn on Vehicle Motion Cues

If looking at your iPhone in a moving vehicle makes you feel nauseous, try Vehicle Motion Cues.

  1. Go to Settings → Accessibility → Motion → Vehicle Motion Cues.
  2. Select Automatically in Vehicle.
  3. You can also customize their appearance.

The feature displays animated dots along the edges of the screen that correspond with vehicle movement.

28. Set up a Legacy Contact

With Legacy Contact, you can designate a trusted friend or family member to access your data—like photos, videos, notes, and other important information—after you pass away. This ensures your loved ones can preserve cherished memories.

How to set it up:

  1. Open Settings, and go to Apple Account → Sign-In & Security → Legacy Contact.
  2. Tap Add Legacy Contact and choose someone you trust.
  3. Follow the setup process.

29. Turn off App Tracking

I recommend reviewing app tracking permissions after every major iOS update.

Many apps track your activity across websites and other apps to build profiles and serve targeted ads. Disabling tracking stops this data collection, protecting your privacy.

  1. Go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking and toggle off unnecessary apps.
  2. You can disable Allow Apps to Request to Track completely or review individual apps.

30. Review Background App Refresh

Background App Refresh can be useful, but I don’t necessarily need every app updating in the background.

Disabling Background App Refresh saves battery, reduces data usage, and boosts performance by stopping apps from updating when not in use.

  1. Go to Settings → General → Background App Refresh.
  2. Select Background App Refresh.
  3. You can turn it off completely or enable it only for Wi-Fi.

I prefer reviewing the app list and disabling unnecessary ones rather than automatically turning the feature off for everything.

31. Customize Lock Screen controls

iOS lets you replace the default Lock Screen controls with other options.

  1. Touch and hold the Lock Screen.
  2. Tap Customize.
  3. Tap the minus (-) button to remove a control.
  4. Tap + to choose another control.

This can be a convenient place to put shortcuts to the features you use regularly.

32. Enable Screen Distance

Screen Distance can warn you when you hold your iPhone too close to your face for an extended period. It helps reduce eye strain and the risk of myopia.

  1. Go to Settings → Screen Time.
  2. Select Content & Privacy Restrictions.
  3. Tap Screen Distance and toggle it off.

If you’re comfortable with the feature, I’d leave it enabled. If you find the warnings disruptive, you can turn it off here.

33. Enable Reduce Loud Audio

Finally, if you frequently use AirPods or headphones, check your headphone safety settings.

  1. Go to Settings → Sounds & Haptics → Headphone Safety → Reduce Loud Audio.
  2. Then choose a decibel limit.

This can help prevent headphone audio from exceeding the level you’ve selected.

iPhone experience enhanced!

iOS 27 is much more than another visual update. Apple has pushed Siri much further, expanded Apple Intelligence into everyday apps, added useful Safari automation, introduced new parental controls, and made the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera hardware more configurable.

The biggest change for me is that the iPhone is becoming more context-aware. Siri can work with what I’m typing, what’s on my screen, what’s in my camera view, and information inside my apps.

And with iPhone Duo arriving October 23, Apple’s iOS experience is about to extend to a completely new form factor.

If you’ve just installed iOS 27, I wouldn’t change every setting on this list blindly. Instead, go through it once and enable the features that actually fit the way you use your iPhone.

Which iOS 27 feature did you like the most?

keyPoints.title: Enable Live Translation in Messages
keyPoints.explanation: Turn your iPhone into a real-time translator by enabling Live Translation for each conversation, making cross-language chats seamless.

keyPoints.title: Turn On Adaptive Power
keyPoints.explanation: Use AI-powered Adaptive Power to detect high power usage and optimize performance, helping to extend battery life on supported iPhones.

keyPoints.title: Turn On Call Screening
keyPoints.explanation: Set up Call Screening to ask callers for their name and purpose or send unknown numbers directly to voicemail, reducing unwanted calls.

keyPoints.title: Tweak the Liquid Glass Effect
keyPoints.explanation: Reduce transparency effects in the Liquid Glass UI for a cleaner, distraction-free look if you find it distracting.

keyPoints.title: Turn Off Full-Screen Screenshot Previews
keyPoints.explanation: Disable full-screen previews of screenshots in Settings if you prefer to avoid bulky notification views.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Junk Mechanics Codes on October 06, 2026

If you’re a car enthusiast and love the idea of getting your hands dirty under the hood, Junk Mechanics is a Roblox game you can’t miss out on. The title puts you in charge of a garage where you’ll need to find old, beaten-up vehicles that need some serious work. Repair them, bring them back to life, and push them out of the shop to earn money.

Of course, restoring cars won’t be a cheap task, and you’ll need plenty of cash to turn these junkers into something worth showing off. Thankfully, the developers have released multiple codes that give you free cash and other rewards. So, let’s take a look at all the Junk Mechanics codes that can help you build the garage of your dreams.

All working Junk Mechanics codes

  • SMOLUPD: 20,000 Cash (NEW)
  • DELAYMECHANICS2: Premium Auction Keys (NEW)
  • 30KTHANKS: 20,000 Cash (NEW)
  • BIDS!: 80k Cash (NEW)

As of now, these are the only active Junk Mechanics codes available. We’ll keep this updated and add any new redeemable codes as soon as the developers release them.

Expired Junk Mechanics codes

25KTHANKS, 40KTHANKS, 5500THANKS, ANOTADELAY, DELAYMECHANICS, ELCINCO, FOURTHCODINITUNGTUNG, KA-CHOW, NEWUPD, THIRDCODEOK, UPDATE4K

Unfortunately, several Junk Mechanics codes have already expired. This means that you can no longer redeem them for rewards. Here’s a list of all the expired codes

How to redeem Junk Mechanics codes in Roblox

The next big question you might be wondering is: how do you redeem Junk Mechanics codes? Well, it’s quite a simple process, and we’ve outlined each step below to help you claim your rewards –

  1. Fire up Junk Mechanics on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on Shop and scroll all the way down.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Junk Mechanics codes

Unfortunately, developers haven’t established a fixed schedule for releasing new Junk Mechanics codes. However, it’s always a good idea to check out the official Junk Mechanics Discord server, as this is where new codes are often announced.

The developers often drop codes to celebrate new updates, events, or major milestones, so make sure to check out the game’s official page on Roblox for the latest announcements.

Be sure to bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated with the latest codes as they’re released. If you’re into shooting games and want more free rewards, check out the latest The Veil codes, Strikeborn codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

FAQs

Are there codes for Junk Mechanics?

Yes, the developers have released several promotional codes that players can redeem for cash and other in-game bonuses.

Why are my Junk Mechanics codes not working?

If your Junk Mechanics codes aren’t working, check if you’ve entered the code exactly as provided, including any special characters or capital letters. There’s also a chance that the code may have already expired.

How to make cash in Junk Mechanics?

You can easily make cash in Junk Mechanics by finding old vehicles, repairing them, and selling them for a profit.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest BreakDoor Codes on October 01, 2026

BreakDoor is a fast-paced Roblox survival game where eight Humans must work together to defend their base against two powerful Demons. With only 20 minutes on the clock, your team needs to earn cash, stack money machines, reinforce your door, and survive relentless attacks before time runs out.

Upgrading your door from a basic wooden barrier to the mighty Eternal Divine Gate takes plenty of resources, which is where redeemable codes come in handy. The latest BreakDoor codes reward you with free Crystals, Spins, Auto Repair Cards, and other valuable items, helping you unlock better classes, strengthen your defenses, and skip much of the early-game grind.

All working BreakDoor codes

  • ApologizeGift5: 5 Spins (NEW)
  • Freespin555: 5 Spins
  • Nice10000ccu: 2,000 Crystals
  • HappyGame: 3 Auto Repair Trial Cards
  • WELCOMEDOOR: 1,000 Crystals

Crystals unlock classes like Life Wizard and Magnetic Storm Warrior, buy Spins (1 Spin costs 1,000 Crystals), and purchase items like Courage Core and Grudge Ember. Auto Repair Trial Cards automatically repair eligible objectives in your next match, which helps when Demons start evolving.

Expired BreakDoor codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem BreakDoor codes in Roblox

You redeem from the Settings menu, not a shop or lobby button.

  1. Open BreakDoor on Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings (cogwheel) icon at the top left of the screen.
  3. Paste a working code into the Enter code box.
  4. Click Redeem to claim the reward.

title.rendered: Search For The Needle codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Search for the Needle Codes on October 04, 2026

Looking for the latest Search the Needle codes? You’ve come to the right place. Search the Needle is a Roblox game where you search through a giant pile of hay to find a tiny needle before the timer runs out. While it sounds simple, the challenge ramps up quickly.

Thankfully, the developers occasionally release redeemable codes that reward you with free Gems, Luck Boosts, Alien Coins, and other useful items. Below, you’ll find all the latest working Search the Needle codes and how to redeem them.

All working Search the Needle codes

  1. PETS – 200 Gems and 30 min 2X Luck Boost 
  2. ALIEN – 200 Gems and 200 Alien Coins
  • MASTERY: 120 Gems (NEW)

Expired Search the Needle codes

2MILLIONMEMBERS, ALIEN, CLANS, PETS, RANCH, SOON, WEATHER

  • Alien

We’ll move additional codes here once they expire.

How to redeem Search the Needle codes in Roblox

Redeeming codes in Search the Needle only takes a few seconds:

  1. Launch Search the Neddle on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the game to load you into a lobby.
  3. Find the bright blue button on the right side with “Codes” written underneath it.
  4. Click on the box and type the code as we’ve mentioned above.
  5. Click on Redeem.

Once you’ve clicked on Redeem, all the rewards will be added to your in-game inventory and will be ready to use.

Where to find more Search the Needle codes

The developers don’t release new Search the Needle codes on a fixed schedule. Most new codes appear alongside major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Search the Needle Discord server for announcements.
  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Stay Hard Run Codes, Gym League Codes, Hypershot codes and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

title.rendered: I tried the new Screen Time in iOS 27: Here’s what changed and how to use it

content.rendered:
Let’s face it: I spend a lot of time on my iPhone, and simply knowing that isn’t always enough to change my habits. That’s where Apple’s Screen Time feature comes in.

With iOS 27, Apple has redesigned Screen Time, making it much more structured. Instead of relying mainly on individual App Limits and Downtime, I can now organize my usage around Time Allowances and Schedules. That means you can decide how much time you want to spend in certain categories and when those categories should be available.

In this guide, I’ll show you what Screen Time does in iOS 27, how to set it up, and how to use its most useful features on your iPhone or iPad.

What is Screen Time on iPhone?

Screen Time is Apple’s built-in tool for understanding and managing how you use your iPhone and iPad.

This will help you know how much time you spend on your device, the apps and sites you use the most, how frequently you pick up your iPhone, and how many notifications you receive. You can also view daily and weekly reports to understand your usage trends.

But Screen Time isn’t only about statistics. It also gives me tools to control when and how I use apps.

In iOS 27, the main Screen Time controls include:

  • Screen Time Schedule: Create time windows that determine when certain apps and categories are available.
  • Time Allowances: Set how much time you can spend on app categories such as Entertainment, Games, and Social Media.
  • Always Allowed: Choose apps and contacts that remain available regardless of your Screen Time restrictions.
  • Communication Limits: Control who you can communicate with during specific periods.
  • Content & Privacy Restrictions: Restrict content, purchases, apps, and certain settings.
  • Screen Distance: Get an alert when you hold your iPhone too close to your face.
  • Share Across Devices: Sync Screen Time settings, schedules, allowances, and reports across compatible Apple devices.

The biggest change in iOS 27 is that Screen Time now works more like a structured daily schedule rather than simply telling me that I have spent too much time in an app.

Why should you use Screen Time on your iPhone?

I don’t think Screen Time is useful simply because it tells me that I’ve spent three hours on social media. Its real value comes from helping me understand where that time is going and then giving me practical ways to change it.

According to health experts, reducing screen time is essential for maintaining overall health and mental well-being, especially for children and teenagers.

Here are some of the main reasons I use it:

  • Understand your usage patterns: Screen Time shows me which apps and websites consume most of my attention. You can also check pickups and notifications to see how often your iPhone interrupts you.
  • Improve productivity: If social media, games, or entertainment apps constantly distract me, I can use Time Allowances and Schedules to create boundaries around them.
  • Create healthier digital habits: Rather than trying to stop using my iPhone completely, I can create specific periods when certain apps are available and limit how long I use them.
  • Manage family device usage: Screen Time remains useful for parents who want to manage their children’s device usage through Family Sharing.
  • Protect privacy and control content: Content & Privacy Restrictions can be used to restrict certain types of content, purchases, apps, and changes to important settings.
  • Reduce eye strain: Screen Distance can warn you when you hold your iPhone too close to your face for an extended period.

How to set up Screen Time on iPhone and iPad

Apple has changed the setup process slightly in iOS 27. You can now start Screen Time from several different sections of the Screen Time settings.

Turn on Screen Time

  1. Open the Settings app.
  2. Tap Screen Time.
  3. Choose one of these options:
    • Screen Time Schedule
    • Time Allowances
    • Manage Screen Time
  4. Tap Turn On App & Website Activity.

Once App & Website Activity is enabled, Screen Time begins collecting information about your device usage.

Apple also lets me add a Screen Time widget to the Home Screen for quicker access to my usage information.

Create a Screen Time passcode

If you’re using Screen Time to enforce restrictions, I recommend setting a separate passcode. This prevents someone from simply changing the limits you’ve configured.

Here’s how to create one in iOS 27:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Screen Time.
  3. Tap Manage Screen Time.
  4. Select Lock Screen Time Settings.
  5. Type the passcode you want to use for Screen Time and retype it.
  6. Enter your Apple Account’s email address or phone number to reset the passcode if you forget it.
  7. Tap OK to save it.

How to use Screen Time on iPhone and iPad

Once Screen Time is enabled, the redesigned interface gives me several ways to understand and control my usage.

Check your Screen Time summary

The Screen Time summary gives me a quick look at how much I use my devices. Apple’s iOS 27 interface now uses Daily Average as the main entry point for these reports, replacing the older See All App & Website Activity workflow.

To check it:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Screen Time.
  3. Tap Daily Average.
  4. Tap Day to see daily usage or Week to see your weekly summary.
  5. Scroll up and tap the left arrow to view the report of the previous day or week.

You can swipe between summaries to review previous usage, spot apps or activities that consume too much time, and consider setting limits.

The report also includes information about:

  • Total device usage
  • Most-used apps
  • App and website activity
  • Pickups and first used app after pickup
  • Notifications to see which apps send you the most notifications and how often they interrupt you.

I find the Pickups and Notifications sections particularly useful because screen time isn’t always about long sessions. Sometimes the bigger problem is constantly checking the phone for a few seconds at a time.

Set Screen Time Schedules

This is one of the biggest changes I noticed in iOS 27.

A Screen Time Schedule lets you create different time windows and assign Time Allowance categories to them. You can also create schedules for specific days of the week.

To create one:

  1. Go to Screen Time from Settings.
  2. Tap Screen Time Schedule.
  3. Toggle on Schedule.
  4. Enter your Screen Time passcode if prompted.
  5. Tap Add Schedule.
  6. Select the days of the week for the schedule.
  7. Tap the checkmark to save.

You will be prompted to copy the time windows from your existing schedule. Tap Don’t Copy and then Add Time Window. From there, you can customize the time window.

It lets you:

  • Change the name of the time window.
  • Change its start and end times.
  • Select Time Allowance categories.
  • View apps and contacts in Always Allowed.
  • Delete the time window.

For example, I could create a “Work” window from 9 AM to 6 PM and choose only the categories I want available during that period. I could then create an “Evening” window with different allowances.

This gives Screen Time a much more flexible structure than simply setting a blanket restriction for the entire day.

Set Time Allowances for apps and websites

Time Allowances replace much of the role that individual App Limits played in older versions of iOS.

To configure them:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Screen Time.
  3. Tap Time Allowances.
  4. Here, use the plus and minus to adjust how much time you want to spend on your device.

If you want to limit time spent on social media or games while allowing more time for educational or work-related apps, you can set Time Allowances for categories, such as Entertainment, Games, and Social Media.

To do that,

  1. In the Time Allowances screen, tap Manage Categories.
  2. Tap the plus icon at the top, and select the built-in options or Custom to add different types of apps to a category.
  3. Now, choose the schedule and tap Continue.
  4. Increase or decrease an allowance using the slider or the minus (-) and plus (+) controls.
  5. Tap Done to save it.

You’ll receive a notification when you’re close to reaching the limit. Once the time is up, the app will be blocked with a message saying, “You’ve used all your available time allowance.” To extend the time, select Ignore Limit > Enter Screen Time Passcode > Approve for 15 minutes/ an hours / all day. By default, the limit restores every day at midnight.

To change the limit permanently, go to Time Allowances and increase the category timing.

Match Time Allowances to your schedule

iOS 27 also includes a Match Screen Time Schedule option. When enabled, Time Allowances can work with the time windows I’ve created in my schedule.

This means I don’t have to treat every hour of the day the same way. I can have different app categories available at different times during my day.

Apple also lets you see your average daily use for a category and drill down to see the average usage of individual apps inside that category.

Allow apps and contacts at all times

The Always Allowed section lets me keep important apps and contacts available regardless of my Screen Time Schedule or Time Allowances.

This can be useful for apps you need throughout the day or people you may need to contact at any time.

To configure it:

  1. From Screen Time settings, tap Always Allowed.
  2. Tap Add Apps, choose apps, and tap the checkmark.
  3. Next, tap Add People and select Choose From My Contacts from the options. Now, choose contacts and tap the checkmark to save.

To remove an app or contact:

  1. Open Always Allowed.
  2. Tap Edit.
  3. Tap the Remove button next to the app or contact.

Apple specifically notes that Always Allowed can be used for important contacts or apps such as Health, even when other Screen Time restrictions are active.

Enable Content & Privacy Restrictions

Content & Privacy Restrictions are still available in iOS 27 and let me control what can be accessed or changed on an iPhone or iPad.

Content & Privacy Restrictions in Screen Time allow you to manage and limit access to specific content, apps, and privacy settings on your iPhone or iPad.

To enable them:

  1. From Screen Time settings, tap Content & Privacy Restrictions.
  2. Toggle on All Restrictions.
  3. From here, you can reduce or block Siri‘s capabilities, such as Sensitive Topics and Explicit Language.
  4. Configure Books, Movies, TV Shows, and Music, Podcasts, Fitness, to show Explicit or Clean content.

If you want to prevent anyone from making changes in any app/service settings, tap Allow Changes to Settings, select the app or service, and set it to Don’t Allow. Even new apps can’t access the data and features of that app.

I suggest setting Don’t Allow Changes for essential privacy and security apps and services such as Passcode & Face ID, Accounts, Share My Location, etc. So, an unauthorized person can’t make any changes in these settings.

Bonus: You can prevent unwanted in-app purchases with Screen Time. Go to Apps & Websites, select App Store, and set In-app Purchases as Blocked. For more detailed information, go through our guide on how to turn off in-app purchases on iPhone.

Enable Communication Safety

Using Communication Safety, you can filter explicit photos and videos on your or your child’s device. It will detect any nude photos and videos received on your device and provide guidance before showing it.

To turn it on:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Screen Time.
  3. Tap Communication Safety.
  4. Toggle on Communication Safety.
  5. Enter your Screen Time passcode if requested.

Apple has expanded its child-safety protections in iOS 27, but I won’t go deep into the parental-control side here. You can learn about them in my iPhone parental controls guide.

Set communication limits

Communication Limits let me control who I can communicate with during particular periods. They apply to communication on Phone, FaceTime, and Messages. However, you will still receive calls or texts from emergency numbers identified by your carrier.

To configure Communication Limits:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Go to Screen Time and select Allowed Contacts.
  3. Tap During Screen Time.
  4. Choose who you can communicate with. The available options include:
    • Contacts Only
    • Contacts & Groups with at Least One Contact

As I don’t like to receive unknown calls during work hours, I selected Contacts Only.

You can also configure communication for periods when the device is paused:

  1. In Allowed Contacts, tap When Device Paused or Unavailable.
  2. Choose Always Allowed or Everyone.

If someone is blocked by your Communication Limit settings, their call or message won’t go through while that restriction is active. Their name or number can appear in red in your recent calls or messages until the restriction is changed.

Use Screen Distance to protect your vision

Screen Distance isn’t new to iOS 27, but it remains one of the useful Screen Time tools.

It uses the TrueDepth camera on supported iPhones and iPads to detect when you hold the device too close to your face for an extended period.

To enable it:

  1. Open Screen Time and go to Content & Privacy Restrictions.
  2. Tap Screen Distance.
  3. Toggle on Screen Distance.
  4. Enter your Screen Time passcode if prompted.

Now, whenever your iPhone detects that it is too close to your face (less than 12 inches or 30 cm) for a long time, a notification will appear urging you to increase the distance.

Use Screen Time across your Apple devices

One of my favorite parts of the updated Screen Time system is the ability to share usage information and settings across devices.

If you use an iPhone, iPad, and Mac with the same Apple Account, you can synchronize Screen Time settings and reports.

This includes:

  • Screen Time schedules
  • Time Allowances
  • Usage data
  • Screen Time reports

To enable it:

  1. Open Settings on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Screen Time.
  3. Tap Manage Screen Time.
  4. Toggle on Share Across Devices.

Once enabled, Screen Time settings and limits can apply across your compatible Apple devices. If you turn it off, each device maintains its own Screen Time settings.

Keep in mind that Apple requires the relevant devices to be updated to the latest operating systems to use the newest cross-device Screen Time features.

Use the Screen Time widget to check device usage

I don’t always want to open Settings just to see how much time I’ve spent on my iPhone. That’s where the Screen Time widget comes in. It provides a quick overview of your device usage directly from the Home Screen or the Today View.

To add it:

  1. Long-press an empty area of the Home Screen.
  2. Tap the Edit button at the top.
  3. Tap Add Widget.
  4. Search for Screen Time.
  5. Choose your preferred widget size.
  6. Tap Add Widget.
  7. Position it where you want.
  8. Tap Done.

The widget gives me a quick overview of my device activity without opening the Settings app.

How to manage Screen Time for a child

Screen Time for your children can also be managed through Family Sharing on your iPhone or iPad.

Because Apple has substantially expanded and redesigned its parental controls in iOS 27, the exact options available can depend on the child’s account, age, device, and Family Sharing setup.

For the basic setup, open Settings and use the Family and Screen Time controls to select the family member whose Screen Time you want to manage.

Apple’s redesigned parental controls include Time Allowances, Schedules, easier access to usage information, and additional child-safety controls.

How to turn off Screen Time on iPhone and iPad

If you no longer want Screen Time to track your activity, you can turn off App & Website Activity.

Here’s the iOS 27 path:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Screen Time.
  3. Scroll down and select Manage Screen Time.
  4. Tap Turn Off App & Website Activity.
  5. Enter your Screen Time passcode if requested.
  6. Confirm your choice.

If you don’t want to turn off Screen Time completely, you can also disable individual parts of the system.

Turn off a Screen Time Schedule

  1. Open Settings → Screen Time.
  2. Tap Screen Time Schedule.
  3. Toggle off Schedule.

Remove a Time Allowance category

  1. Open Settings → Screen Time.
  2. Tap Time Allowances.
  3. Tap Manage Categories.
  4. Select the category.
  5. Tap Delete [Category Name] Category.

This is different from the older system, where turning off App & Website Activity was the main way to disable the overall Screen Time tracking experience. iOS 27 lets me manage schedules and allowances separately.

Things I learned about Screen Time in iOS 27

After using the updated interface, the main takeaway is that Apple has shifted Screen Time from primarily a usage-reporting and app-limit tool to a more flexible time-management system.

The three settings I would pay the most attention to are:

  • Daily Average: Shows me where my time is actually going.
  • Screen Time Schedule: Lets me decide when different categories should be available.
  • Time Allowances: Lets me decide how much time I can spend in those categories.

If you only want to monitor your usage, the Daily Average report is enough. But if you actually want to change your habits, combining a Schedule with Time Allowances gives you much more control.

Signing off

Screen Time has always been useful for checking how much time I spend on my iPhone, but iOS 27 makes the feature feel considerably more organized. The biggest upgrade isn’t simply a new visual design. It’s the way Apple has separated when I can use certain apps from how long I can use them.

With Schedules, you can create different rules for different parts of your day. With Time Allowances, you can control how much time you spend in categories such as Entertainment, Games, or Social Media. And with Share Across Devices, those settings can follow you across my iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

For anyone trying to reduce distractions without completely abandoning their iPhone, I think the new Screen Time system is worth exploring.

@graph.name: How to Set Up Screen Time on iPhone and iPad
@graph.description: Enable Screen Time on your iPhone or iPad to track app and website usage for better digital wellbeing and control.

step.name: Open Settings
step.text: Open the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad.

step.name: Go to Screen Time
step.text: Scroll down and tap Screen Time to access usage monitoring settings.

step.name: Enable App & Website Activity
step.text: Tap App & Website Activity and select Turn On App & Website Activity to start tracking usage.

itemListElement.text: Select Turn On App & Website Activity.

@graph.name: How to Create Screen Time Passcode
@graph.description: Set a Screen Time passcode on your iPhone or iPad to prevent others from changing usage limits or app restrictions.

step.name: Open Screen Time settings
step.text: Go to Settings and select Screen Time.

step.name: Lock Screen Time settings
step.text: Tap Lock Screen Time Settings to enable passcode protection.

step.name: Set and confirm passcode
step.text: Enter a four-digit passcode and re-type it to confirm. If prompted, provide your Apple ID email address or phone number for recovery, then tap OK to save.

itemListElement.text: Provide Apple ID recovery info if prompted.

@graph.name: How to Check Screen Time Summary
@graph.description: View your Screen Time summary on iPhone or iPad to track daily and weekly usage, app activity, pickups, and notifications.

step.name: Open Screen Time settings
step.text: Open the Settings app and tap Screen Time to access your usage summary.

step.name: View daily average
step.text: Check the quick overview showing your daily average screen time usage.

step.name: Open detailed activity
step.text: Tap See All App & Website Activity to view a detailed breakdown of your device usage.

itemListElement.text: Tap See All App & Website Activity.

step.name: Analyze usage data
step.text: Review daily and weekly reports, app usage breakdown, pickups, and notifications to understand your device habits.

itemListElement.text: See top used apps and categories.

@graph.name: How to Set Daily Time Limits for Apps and Websites
@graph.description: Use Screen Time on your iPhone or iPad to set daily limits for apps and websites, helping you manage usage and reduce distractions.

step.name: Access App Limits in Screen Time
step.text: Open Settings, go to Screen Time, and select App Limits.

step.name: Add a new limit
step.text: Tap Add Limit and enter your Screen Time passcode.

step.name: Select apps, categories, or websites
step.text: Choose app categories, individual apps, or websites. To add a website, scroll down, tap Websites → Add Website, and enter the URL.

itemListElement.text: For websites, tap Websites and add the URL.

step.name: Set time and block option
step.text: Tap Next, set the desired time limit and choose the days. Toggle on Block at End of Limit to make the app or website unusable after the limit.

itemListElement.text: Toggle on Block at End of Limit if desired.

step.name: Save the limit
step.text: Tap Add to save your daily time limit settings.

@graph.name: How to Schedule Time Away from Screen with Downtime
@graph.description: Use Downtime on your iPhone or iPad to schedule specific hours when only essential apps and phone calls are allowed, helping reduce screen time.

step.name: Open Downtime settings
step.text: Go to Settings, tap Screen Time, and select Downtime.

step.name: Enable scheduling
step.text: Toggle on Scheduled and tap Time to set start and end times. Hit Done to save. Example: Schedule Downtime from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM to limit nighttime usage.

itemListElement.text: Tap Time and set start and end hours.

step.name: Customize for specific days
step.text: Tap Customize Days to set different Downtime hours for individual days if needed.

@graph.name: How to Allow Apps and Contacts for All Time
@graph.description: Use the Always Allowed feature in Screen Time to let selected apps and contacts remain accessible at all times, even during Downtime or App Limits.

step.name: Access Always Allowed settings
step.text: Open Settings, navigate to Screen Time, and select Always Allowed.

step.name: Allow or remove apps
step.text: Tap the green plus icon next to the apps you want to allow all the time. To remove, tap the minus icon.

itemListElement.text: Tap the plus icon to allow an app.
Tap the minus icon to remove an app.

step.name: Manage contacts
step.text: Tap Contacts at the top to choose who can reach you during Downtime or App Limits. By default, calls are allowed from Everyone. To limit, select Specific Contacts, choose from My Contacts, pick a contact, and tap Done.

itemListElement.text: Select Specific Contacts to limit calls.
Choose from My Contacts and tap Done.

@graph.name: How to Enable Content & Privacy Restrictions
@graph.description: Turn on Content & Privacy Restrictions in Screen Time to control app access, limit services, and manage allowed changes on your iPhone or iPad.

step.name: Access Content & Privacy Restrictions
step.text: Go to Settings, tap Screen Time, and select Content & Privacy Restrictions.

step.name: Enable restrictions
step.text: Toggle on Content & Privacy Restrictions.

itemListElement.text: Turn on the Content & Privacy Restrictions toggle.

step.name: Configure individual restrictions
step.text: Go through each section and configure restrictions for apps, services, and content. Tap the option you want to change and select Allow Changes or Don't Allow Changes.

itemListElement.text: Select a section like Allowed Apps or Content Restrictions.
Choose Allow Changes or Don't Allow Changes.

@graph.name: How to Enable Communication Safety
@graph.description: Turn on Communication Safety in Screen Time to protect against sensitive content in messages by warning and guiding users before viewing.

step.name: Open Communication Safety settings
step.text: From the Screen Time settings, select Communication Safety.

step.name: Enable Communication Safety
step.text: Toggle on Communication Safety.

step.name: Authenticate with passcode if needed
step.text: Enter the Screen Time passcode if prompted to confirm changes.

itemListElement.text: Enter your Screen Time passcode when asked.

@graph.name: How to Set Communication Limit
@graph.description: Set communication limits in Screen Time to control who can contact you or your child during allowed screen time and downtime on iPhone or iPad.

step.name: Access Communication Limits settings
step.text: Open Screen Time settings and tap Communication Limits.

step.name: Choose limit type
step.text: Pick During Screen Time to set limits for regular use or During Downtime to apply stricter rules for restricted hours.

itemListElement.text: Select During Screen Time for regular limits.
Select During Downtime for restricted hours.

step.name: Select who can contact
step.text: Choose from Everyone, Contacts Only, or Contacts & Groups with at Least One Contact.

itemListElement.text: Select Contacts Only to restrict to saved contacts.
Select Contacts & Groups with at Least One Contact for a balanced option.

step.name: Save settings
step.text: Tap Back in the top left corner to save and apply your communication limits.

step.name: Prevent contact edits
step.text: Toggle off Allow Contact Editing to prevent changes to allowed contacts.

@graph.name: How to Use Screen Distance to Protect Your Vision
@graph.description: Enable Screen Distance in Screen Time to reduce eye strain by prompting you to hold your iPhone or iPad at a healthier viewing distance.

step.name: Open Screen Distance settings
step.text: Go to Settings, tap Screen Time, and select Screen Distance.

step.name: Enable Screen Distance
step.text: Toggle on Screen Distance.

itemListElement.text: Switch on the Screen Distance toggle.

step.name: Authenticate if prompted
step.text: Enter your Screen Time passcode when asked to confirm the setting.

@graph.name: How to Use Screen Time Widget to Check Device Usage at a Glance
@graph.description: Add the Screen Time widget to your iPhone Home Screen to quickly check your device usage without opening the Settings app.

step.name: Enter Home Screen edit mode
step.text: Long-press on the Home Screen and tap the Edit button in the top-left corner.

itemListElement.text: Long-press on any empty area of the Home Screen.
Tap the Edit button in the top-left corner.

step.name: Add the Screen Time widget
step.text: Tap on Add Widget, search for Screen Time, and select it.

step.name: Choose widget size
step.text: Swipe to choose your preferred widget size and tap Add Widget.

itemListElement.text: Swipe to preview different widget sizes.
Tap Add Widget to confirm your choice.

step.name: Place and save widget
step.text: Move the widget to a suitable position on your Home Screen and tap Done.

itemListElement.text: Drag the widget to your desired location.

@graph.name: How to Enable Screen Time on Child’s iPhone
@graph.description: Set up Screen Time on your child's iPhone using Family Sharing to monitor and manage their device usage effectively.

step.name: Access Screen Time settings
step.text: Launch the Settings app on your iPhone or iPad, go to Screen Time, and select Set Up Screen Time for Family.

itemListElement.text: Tap Set Up Screen Time for Family.

step.name: Proceed to create child account
step.text: Tap Continue to proceed with setup.

step.name: Choose account setup method
step.text: Select Create Child Account if your child is under 13, otherwise tap Invite Others and send a request to your child’s Apple ID.

itemListElement.text: Select Create Child Account for children under 13.
Tap Invite Others for children 13 or older.

step.name: Enter child’s details
step.text: Enter your child’s name and birthday, then tap Verify You’re an Adult.

step.name: Verify payment method
step.text: Provide consent using your payment method for verification purposes.

step.name: Complete setup
step.text: Follow the on-screen prompts to finish enabling Screen Time on your child’s Apple ID. Then, use the new Apple ID to set up their iPhone.

itemListElement.text: Use the new Apple ID to set up the child's device.

@graph.name: How to Turn Off Screen Time on iPhone and iPad
@graph.description: Learn how to disable Screen Time on your iPhone or iPad to stop tracking and limiting app and website activity.

step.name: Open Screen Time settings
step.text: Go to Settings on your iPhone or iPad, then tap Screen Time.

step.name: Disable Screen Time activity tracking
step.text: Scroll down and tap Turn Off App & Website Activity.

itemListElement.text: Scroll down in the Screen Time settings.
Tap Turn Off App & Website Activity.

step.name: Enter passcode and confirm
step.text: If prompted, enter your Screen Time passcode and confirm by selecting Turn Off App & Website Activity.

itemListElement.text: Enter your Screen Time passcode if asked.
Select Turn Off App & Website Activity to confirm.

keyPoints.title: What is Screen Time on iPhone?
keyPoints.explanation: Screen Time is a built-in feature on iPhone and iPad that tracks device usage, including app categories, notifications, and device pickups, providing daily and weekly reports.

keyPoints.title: Benefits of Using Screen Time
keyPoints.explanation: Screen Time helps understand usage patterns, improve productivity, promote digital well-being, manage children's device use, protect privacy, and encourage healthier sleep habits.

keyPoints.title: Setting Up Screen Time
keyPoints.explanation: To set up Screen Time, enable it in Settings, create a passcode for restrictions, and customize settings for app limits, Downtime, content restrictions, and more.

keyPoints.title: Using Screen Time Features
keyPoints.explanation: Check usage summaries, set time limits for apps/websites, schedule Downtime, allow certain apps, enable privacy restrictions, and use features like Screen Distance to protect eyesight.

keyPoints.title: Managing Screen Time for Children
keyPoints.explanation: Parents can enable Screen Time on kids' devices via Family Sharing, create child accounts, set limits, restrict content, and monitor activity remotely.

title.rendered: Command An Army codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Command an Army Codes on October 06, 2026

Looking for a strategy game to play on Roblox? Well, it’s time to give Command An Army a shot! In this game, you’ll be responsible for building and managing your own army, recruiting troops, and battling against other players.

However, if you want to build a powerful medieval army that’s capable of taking down hordes of enemies, you’ll need plenty of units and gems to recruit them. Luckily, the developers have released tons of codes that can reward you with free gems. So, let’s take a look at all the Command An Army codes you need to redeem right now.

All working Command An Army codes

  • GUILDFIX: 5,000 Gems and 10 Skill Crystals (NEW)
  • LAESTRYGONIAN: 700 Gems and 2 Skill Crystals (NEW)
  • UPDATE3: 700 Gems and 2 Skill Crystals (NEW)
  • MONGOLS: 1,000 Gems and 2 Skill Crystals (NEW)
  • SKILLTREE: 5 Skill Crystals (NEW)
  • OCTOBER3 NEW: 1,000 Gems
  • SATURDAY NEW: 1,000 Gems
  • RANKED: 300 Gems
  • GUILD: 300 Gems
  • PARRY: 300 Gems
  • RAPIER: 300 Gems
  • OPTIMIZE: 700 Gems
  • WAR: Redeem this code for 500 Gems
  • RELEASE: Redeem this code for 500 Gems

As of now, these are the only active Command An Army codes available. We’ll keep this updated and add any new redeemable codes as soon as the developers release them.

Expired Command An Army codes

10KGOAL, BUGFIX, COMMANDER, CONQUER, CONQUEST, D0GGY103, LEBALANCE, SHIELDBREAKER, SORRY

Unfortunately, several Command An Army codes have already expired. This means that you can no longer redeem them for rewards. Here’s a list of all the expired codes:

How to redeem Command An Army codes

The next big question you might be wondering is: how do you redeem Command An Army codes? Well, it’s quite a simple process, and we’ve outlined each step below to help you claim your rewards –

  1. Fire up Command An Army on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Look at the right side of the screen and click the “Codes” button.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Command An Army codes

Unfortunately, developers haven’t established a fixed schedule for releasing new Command An Army codes. However, it’s always a good idea to check out the official Command An Army Discord server, as this is where new codes are often announced.

The developers often drop codes to celebrate new updates, events, or major milestones, so make sure to check out the game’s official page on Roblox for the latest announcements.

Be sure to bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated with the latest codes as they’re released. If you’re into shooting games and want more free rewards, check out the latest The Veil codes, Mog or Die codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

FAQs

What are Command An Army codes used for?

Players can use Command An Army codes to claim gems, which can be used to recruit various units and take over battlefields.

Is Command An Army free to play?

Yes! Command An Army is a free-to-play game on Roblox.

How to redeem Command An Army Codes?

Command An Army codes can be redeemed through the in-game code redemption menu. You need to enter an active code and click on the redeem button.

title.rendered: Meta unveils camera-free Ray-Bans and a pocket-sized Muse Charm

content.rendered:
Meta introduced its first camera-free smart glasses in its Connect 2026 announcement. The Ray-Ban Meta Audio starts at $349 in the U.S. and ships October 13. Meta also showed the pocket-sized Muse Charm, a device for talking with its AI agent, in its official Connect roundup, alongside its new Meta VR Glasses.

Ray-Ban Meta Audio keeps AI and drops the camera

The Audio model is built for music, podcasts, calls, and hands-free Meta AI use. Meta says the 43-gram glasses can run for up to 12 hours on one charge, with up to 48 more hours from the included case. Preorders opened at $349 in the U.S., and shipping starts October 13.

Meta also says its personal AI agent Muse is coming to its AI glasses. The company has not given a model-by-model rollout date.

Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 gets longer battery life

Meta’s camera-equipped Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 adds a customizable action button and up to nine hours of battery life. It keeps the 12-megapixel camera and 3K video recording. The glasses are available now, starting at $449.

Muse Charm gives its AI a pocket-sized home

The pocket-sized device uses a real-time voice model so users can talk with Muse. Meta says it will share more details later this year. Axios reports that Meta plans to make the Charm available by December, but the company has not announced a price.

Meta has also introduced a separate Muse Voice Transcribe tool for Mac, which types speech into apps in real time. That speech-to-text model is different from the personal Muse agent the Charm is built around.

Meta VR Glasses are due in 2027

Meta’s new VR Glasses weigh about 100 grams and use 5K micro-OLED displays. A separate pocketable puck handles the computing, battery, and storage, so the headset itself stays light. Meta says the glasses will cost $1,299.99 USD when they launch in spring 2027.

excerpt.rendered: Meta’s first camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses cost $349, while Muse Charm brings its AI agent to a pocket-sized device. Its new VR glasses arrive in 2027.

title.rendered: OpenAI says ChatGPT’s Siri integration dramatically underperformed

content.rendered:
OpenAI says its ChatGPT integration in Apple’s Siri fell short of its user-growth expectations. A September 22 court brief says the company cut its forecast for incremental logged-in weekly active users in January 2025 and described the integration as "persistently underperforming" in March 2026.

The filing hides the usage figures

The ChatGPT extension went live in December 2024, but it was off by default. Users had to opt in through Siri or Settings, as OpenAI’s brief explains. iGeeksBlog’s guide to enabling ChatGPT in Siri walks through that setup.

OpenAI says the feature was "off to a slow start" in January 2025 and that it lowered its forecast for incremental logged-in weekly active users. The filing does not disclose the forecast, how far the integration missed it, or how many people used it. It also redacts what OpenAI told Apple in March 2026.

OpenAI says the Apple deal was non-exclusive

The brief supports OpenAI’s request for summary judgment in an antitrust case brought by X Corp. and SpaceXAI LLC, formerly xAI. The plaintiffs alleged that Apple’s ChatGPT deal restricted competition. Apple has since been dismissed from the case.

OpenAI says it asked Apple for a mutual two-year exclusivity period, but Apple refused. The signed agreement let Apple add other services with similar features. OpenAI argues the Siri integration’s low usage could not have kept rival chatbots from reaching a meaningful number of users. The court has not ruled on that argument.

The filing covers the Siri extension’s performance through March 2026. Apple’s newer Siri app offers another way to choose ChatGPT during a Siri conversation, but OpenAI has not provided usage figures for that later experience.

title.rendered: Birthday Sprite in Fortnite: What it does and when it is coming out

content.rendered:
To mark the occasion of Fortnite’s ninth anniversary, Birthday Sprite is strongly rumored to be released in the game in the near future. There are birthday quests in the game’s Battle Royale and OG modes already in place; now with a sprite on the way as well, the special event is set to go into full swing.

Birthday cakes, presents, balloons, and more have started appearing in Fortnite matches, as the game celebrates its nine-year milestone. Soon, the Birthday Sprite will also enter the mix, as first reported by popular leaker Shiina. As we inch closer to getting this new sprite addition, here’s every key detail about it, including its ability and expected release timeline.

What does the Birthday Sprite in Fortnite do?

Per the leak shared by HYPEX, with the Birthday Sprite equipped, you have a boosted chance of getting a Birthday Cake by opening chests. The latter is another recent inclusion in the game, which restores health and shield when you consume it.

By leveling up the Birthday Sprite, you can further increase the effectiveness of the aforementioned ability. On top of that, once you have maxed out the sprite, you also have a chance of getting a Birthday Cake from eliminating enemies during a match.

Thanks to the arrival of this Fortnite sprite, players will now have one more healing item that they can claim from chests. At its max level, this Rare-tier item can come in handy in the aftermath of each tough kill, given that it can immediately provide a Birthday Cake to restore any lost health or shield.

Birthday Sprite release date

According to the same source that revealed its ability, the Birthday Sprite is scheduled to release in Fortnite Override on Saturday, September 26. Notably, this content drop will deviate from the game’s usual sprite additions that take place on Thursdays.

While you may reasonably think that rolling out a sprite on a Saturday is strange, it isn’t really the first time the Fortnite devs have followed this strategy this season. In August, they shipped the Storm Scout Sprite on the sixth day of the week as well.

Based on the fact that the Birthday Sprite’s launch coincides with the Power Hour, a time during which the spawn rate of sprites that are hard to come by is boosted, it could consequently shoot up the acquisition rate of this forthcoming sprite on its first day in the game.

Wrapping up

Courtesy of the ongoing birthday celebration event in Fortnite, there are several other items in the game having a similar theme as the Birthday Sprite. While some of these items are simply cosmetics such as the “9th Birthday Sprite” Spray, others considerably influence the gameplay, such as the Balloon item that lets you temporarily float in the air each time you press jump.

With only a few days to go before the Birthday Sprite finally lands, it will be interesting to see how the other anniversary-related items are received by players in the meantime. Further, it will also be worth checking out how the newly leaked sprite fares compared to others and how popular it gets once it’s available in Fortnite.
