title.rendered: Fortnite x Persona 5 Crossover: Release date, skins and more

content.rendered:
It’s time to mark your calendars, gamers, as Epic Games has revealed that the Fortnite x Persona 5 crossover is set to arrive on September 25, 2026! This is a collaboration you definitely don’t want to miss, especially if you’re a fan of the series, as it’s expected to bring iconic characters like Joker and Ann Takamaki to the battle royale.

So, if you’re excited, here’s everything you need to know about the Fortnite Persona 5 crossover, including its release date, time, skins, and other cosmetics.

Fortnite x Persona 5: Release date and time

As we said earlier, the Fortnite x Persona 5 crossover is set to arrive on September 25, 2026, as confirmed by Epic Games on Twitter with a cinematic trailer. Like the previous Fortnite collaborations, the crossover is expected to go live with the Item Shop reset at 5:00 PM PT. If you’re wondering what time that will be in your region, here’s a table to help you:

What’s coming with the Fortnite x Persona 5 Crossover?

As of now, Epic Games hasn’t confirmed which skins and cosmetics players can expect to see with the upcoming Fortnite x Persona 5 crossover.

However, the cinematic teaser released by the developer hints at the arrival of Ann, Joker, and Morgana in the game. Additionally, even dataminers have stepped in and shared details about some of the cosmetics that could arrive –

  • Joker – Phantom Thief / Dancing in Starlight
  • Ann Takamaki – Panther / Dancing in Starlight
  • Morgana Sidekick
  • Morgana Bus vehicle skin

It’s always important to take leaks with a grain of salt. There’s always a chance Epic Games could still make changes to the cosmetics or characters before the crossover officially launches.

What’s interesting is that the developer has already released the Morgana Sprite with the latest Fortnite Chapter 4 Season 7 Override update. It also added the Crash Bandicoot Sprite, Pond Sprite, and even the Blinky Sprite.

You might also like:

  • Fortnite x Kingdom Hearts collab
  • Fortnite x Ironmouse crossover

title.rendered: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 with faster output and lower costs

content.rendered:
Anthropic has released Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in its Claude 5.5 family. The company says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work while costing 40% less than Opus 5 to run on typical workloads.

The launch brings changes for developers and subscribers. Opus 5.5 has lower API rates and faster output, while paid Claude plans are getting higher usage limits. Anthropic also says the model is stronger at long-running coding and computer-use tasks and communicates more clearly.

Opus 5.5 focuses on coding and long-running work

Anthropic says Opus 5.5 leads Opus 5 on its benchmarks for coding, computer use, and knowledge work. These are tasks where a model may need to work through several steps and use tools. One early tester completed a 680,000-line code migration in less than a day, according to Anthropic’s launch announcement. That is a company-selected example, not an independent test.

The company also says Opus 5.5 is more resistant to prompt-injection attacks, which try to make a model ignore its instructions, and less likely than recent models to take hard-to-reverse actions. Anthropic says its writing is clearer, puts key information up front, and is easier to follow during long work sessions. These are Anthropic’s own model and safety claims.

For developers, the Claude Platform model page lists a 1-million-token context window, a maximum output of 128,000 tokens, and the API model ID claude-opus-5-5.

API token prices are down 20%, while typical workload costs fall 40%

The 40% figure refers to total costs on typical workloads, not a 40% cut in each token price. Claude Opus 5.5 API rates are $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, down from $5 and $25 for Opus 5. Cache reads are $0.20 per million tokens, compared with $0.50 for Opus 5.

Anthropic says lower prices combine with fewer tokens per task to reduce typical workload costs. It also says Opus 5.5 generates output more than 30% faster than Opus 5. The savings will vary by task and API usage; Anthropic’s 40% estimate is not a discount on a Claude subscription.

Subscribers get higher five-hour usage limits

Anthropic is increasing the five-hour usage limits for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. It is also giving subscribers a rate-limit reset they can save and use later when they need it. These account limits are separate from the API prices, so the model’s lower token rates do not mean Claude subscription fees are dropping.

Opus 5.5 is available across Claude and cloud platforms

Users can select Opus 5.5 in Claude’s model picker. Developers can access it through the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS. Access and pricing can vary by provider.

The launch follows Claude Fable 5.1, Anthropic’s previous model for long-running coding and knowledge work. Our Claude icons guide shows where to find the model picker in the app. Anthropic says Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 will follow in the coming weeks.

title.rendered: New Mac mini models drop the removable SSD module

content.rendered:
Apple’s M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini models, which went on sale September 22, no longer have a removable SSD module. Expand Mac mini says it opened both computers and found the NAND storage soldered directly to each logic board. Owners cannot swap an internal module to add capacity after purchase.

M6 and M5 Pro use soldered storage

The teardown vendor says the new models have no SSD slot, so its aftermarket modules will not fit. Expand Mac mini sells replacement modules, which gives it a commercial interest in upgradeability; its report is also based on opening both machines and sharing photos of the boards.

Apple’s parts support table lists a used SSD module for the 2024 Mac mini but not for the M6 or M5 Pro. That table shows which used Apple parts are supported; it does not prove how storage is attached. The teardown provides the physical evidence, while Apple’s list confirms the old module is no longer a supported replacement part for these models.

The M4 generation brought back upgradeable storage

The M4 Mac mini brought back a separate SSD module after the M1, M2, and M3 models used soldered storage. That module was proprietary, not a standard M.2 drive, and aftermarket replacements made it possible to increase capacity after purchase. Expand Mac mini says its M4 and M4 Pro modules remain supported, but they will not fit the M6 or M5 Pro.

Readers comparing the generations can see our M6 vs. M4 Mac mini breakdown. The key difference for storage is simple: the M4 has a replaceable module, while the new models have NAND chips soldered to the board.

Choose storage before you order

Apple’s Mac mini specifications list the $899 M6 with 256GB of storage by default and options up to 2TB. The $1,699 M5 Pro starts at 512GB and can be configured up to 8TB. With no module to replace later, buyers should choose a capacity that can handle their files and projects as they grow.

An external Thunderbolt SSD can hold photo libraries, video projects, and other large files, but it does not increase the Mac mini’s internal capacity. The change applies to the M6 and M5 Pro; owners of the 2024 M4 and M4 Pro models keep their existing upgrade path.

excerpt.rendered: The new M6 and M5 Pro Mac mini models lose the removable SSD module found in the 2024 M4. Buyers should choose their internal storage before ordering.

title.rendered: Apple has reportedly put its AI pendant on hold

content.rendered:
Apple has postponed work on a camera-equipped AI pendant, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports. The wearable was intended to give Siri visual context through a camera, but Apple has not announced the device or explained the pause.

How Apple’s AI pendant was supposed to work

The reported design could be worn as a necklace, clipped to clothing, or placed elsewhere on the body. Its camera would gather visual information for Siri, giving the assistant context about what the wearer is looking at.

Earlier reporting described an AirTag-sized pendant that would work with the iPhone and Siri. Bloomberg’s latest report does not confirm that size or explain what processing would happen on the pendant versus the iPhone. Apple has also not shared details such as the camera’s resolution, activation controls, or whether it would capture images continuously.

That leaves basic privacy questions unanswered: when the camera would capture images, how the wearer would know it was active, and what would happen to the visual data. Those details matter for a camera designed to be worn throughout the day, but they are not in Bloomberg’s report.

Siri can already answer questions about an iPhone camera view

The idea overlaps with Siri mode in the iOS 27 Camera app, which lets owners of compatible iPhones ask about objects in view, identify something, search for similar images, or request an action. It requires an Apple Intelligence-compatible model, including iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max or iPhone 16 and later. Users point the phone at an object and ask Siri a question, then can ask follow-ups without leaving Camera. A camera on a pendant could offer a more hands-free way to provide visual context, though Bloomberg has not described how it would activate or frame the camera.

The iPhone feature does not confirm Apple is continuing work on the pendant, and there is no reported connection between the two projects. It is simply a current example of Apple bringing visual context to Siri through a camera.

The project is postponed, not officially canceled

Bloomberg gives no reason for the pause and offers no new timeline. The report does not say when Apple might revisit the project. “Postponed” describes the current status; it is not a cancellation announcement or a promise that the device will eventually launch.

title.rendered: Apple is reportedly testing a screenless fitness tracker to rival Whoop

content.rendered:
Apple is prototyping a screenless fitness band aimed at rivaling Whoop, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports. Apple has explored the category for several months and now has prototypes, but it has not decided whether to sell one.

What Apple’s reported fitness band looks like

The prototypes reportedly pair a thin fabric band with a sensor-equipped computing module. The screenless design would put health and activity tracking first, without the display, apps, and notifications found on Apple Watch.

Bloomberg has not reported what the sensors measure. There is no confirmed list of tracked health metrics, and Apple has not shared details about how the band would work with iPhone, Apple Health, or Apple Watch. That leaves the device’s day-to-day features unclear.

It would play a different role from Apple Watch

The reported target is the dedicated fitness-tracker category, where Whoop and Fitbit Air compete. WHOOP’s U.S. One membership costs $199 per year and includes sleep, strain, and recovery insights with coaching. Its sleep tools track all four sleep stages and estimate how much rest members need after training. Higher tiers add health alerts and real-time stress tracking. The app turns ongoing measurements into guidance for sleep and training, while users check trends on a phone rather than a watch face. WHOOP also syncs data with Apple Health and lists more than 14 days of battery life for its current band, two details Bloomberg has not reported for Apple’s prototype. Apple Watch, meanwhile, combines health tracking with apps and notifications, giving it a broader role.

Apple’s Series 12 health features show the broader role of its smartwatch. Gurman has not said whether the new band would replace any Apple Watch features or require its own subscription, so the two products’ relationship is still unknown.

Apple has not committed to shipping it

Gurman describes the project as an early “technology investigation,” not a product development commitment. Apple has not approved the band as a product. The report says a release, if Apple moves forward, likely would not happen before 2028. That is a conditional outlook, not a launch window.

Apple has not announced a price or release date, and the project could still be canceled. For now, the report shows Apple testing a new kind of wearable, not preparing a product for sale.

Update: Verified the latest Encounters SMASH Battles Codes on October 01, 2026

Looking for a fun fighting game to play on Roblox? Well, it’s time to jump into Encounters SMASH Battles! This is a fast-paced battle game that lets you go head-to-head with other players using champions, special abilities, and deadly attacks. Your main goal is to knock your opponents out of the arena, but who says you can’t look good while doing it?

Luckily, the developers have released several codes that allow you to unlock free skins, emotes, crates, and more. So, let’s take a look at all the Encounters SMASH Battles codes you need to redeem right now.

All working Encounters SMASH Battles codes

  • summer: 3 Summer Skin Summons (NEW)
  • conga: Conga Emote
  • gullible: Gullible Title after redeeming 100 times
  • crate: Crate
  • ancient crate: Ancient Crate
  • locoforcoco: Again? Title

As of now, these are the only active Encounters SMASH Battles codes available. We’ll keep this updated and add any new redeemable codes as soon as the developers release them.

Expired or unverified Encounters SMASH Battles codes

JULY4TH

How to redeem Encounters SMASH Battles codes

The next big question you might be wondering is: how do you redeem Encounters SMASH Battles codes? Well, it’s quite a simple process, and we’ve outlined each step below to help you claim your rewards –

  1. Fire up Encounters SMASH Battles on Roblox
  2. Wait for the lobby to load
  3. Find the Store button with a purple shopping cart icon on the left side of the screen
  4. Scroll to the bottom, locate the Codes tab, and click on it

title.rendered: Mog or Die codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Mog or Die Codes on October 06, 2026

There’s no shortage of absurd Roblox games, but the one you definitely can’t miss out on is Mog or Die. What’s the game about? Well, looksmaxxing, of course. You’ll be drinking milk to increase your height, smashing your face with a hammer, collecting water to lower body fat, and all sorts of ridiculous things to mog other players.

In order to aura farm in this game, you’ll need plenty of Lucky Spins, MogPoints, and other boosts to increase your stats. Luckily, the developers have released several free codes that can help you get these items without spending a dime. So, let’s take a look at all the Mog or Die codes you need to redeem right now.

All working Mog or Die codes

  • TYFOR15KLIKE: 6 Lucky Spins (NEW)
  • TYFOR30KLIKES: 5,000 MogPoints and 2 Progress for 60 minutes (NEW)
  • UPDATE3: 2 Progress for 60 minutes (NEW)
  • freeclavegg NEW: 1 Cleggvicular Egg

As of now, these are the only active Mog or Die codes available. We’ll keep this updated and add any new redeemable codes as soon as the developers release them.

Expired Mog or Die codes

EXTRACODE, TYFOR1.5KLIKES, TYFOR300LIKES, UPDATE2

How to redeem Mog or Die codes

The next big question you might be wondering is: how do you redeem Mog or Die codes? Well, it’s quite a simple process, and we’ve outlined each step below to help you claim your rewards –

  1. Fire up Mog or Die on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on the pink “#” icon on the top-left of the screen.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Mog or Die codes

Unfortunately, developers haven’t established a fixed schedule for releasing new Mog or Die codes. However, it’s always a good idea to check out the official Mog or Die Discord server, as this is where new codes are often announced.

The developers often drop codes to celebrate new updates, events, or major milestones, so make sure to check out the game’s official page on Roblox for the latest announcements.

Be sure to bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated with the latest codes as they’re released. If you’re into shooting games and want more free rewards, check out the latest The Veil codes, Strikeborn codes, Command An Army codes and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: Blinky Sprite in Fortnite: The easiest and quickest method to claim it

content.rendered:
Blinky Sprite is one of the three new sprites introduced in Fortnite in Thursday’s update. It takes inspiration from the namesake character in the Pac-Man series and offers players yet another video game character-based sprite to add to their collection.

The Blinky Sprite in Fortnite is the latest development in the collaborative efforts between Epic Games’ multiplayer title and Pac-Man, one of the most enduring franchises in all of gaming. Besides the sprite, we have also received other themed cosmetics in the Shop, such as the Pac-Man sidekick.

While most of the Legendary-tier sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 require extensive searching across the Battle Royale map, the Blinky Sprite stands out as an exception. In this article, you can learn how to get hold of this item without scouring the in-game world, in the easiest and quickest manner possible.

How to get the Blinky Sprite in Fortnite easily

After the new update last week, Pac-Man villains, namely Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde have started appearing in Battle Royale. These bosses can be found in Blinky Island, Pinky Island, Pac-Man Island, and near the maze that lies in north-east to Sunken Shores. What’s worth noting here about these bosses is that they drop a guaranteed Blinky Sprite upon being defeated.

Your best bet for easily encountering one of the aforementioned bosses is going to any of the three islands themed around Pac-Man. That’s because you can find these characters quickly, with little to no effort, on these islands. To avoid being surprised, you may want to keep in mind that a Pac-Man ghost marker is shown on the screen whenever a boss is close.

After you trigger a fight with the villain, the strategy is straightforward and only slightly challenging. You should focus on being on the move while shooting the enemy down, as these Pac-Man ghosts move briskly and deal considerable damage upon contact. Since this particular boss doesn’t have a head, you can just shoot at it without paying attention to where your hits are exactly landing.

As soon as you deal major damage to the ghost and bring its health meter down significantly, it will change form and start retreating. At this point, you must finish it off, so that it drops Blinky Sprite and other loot.

Other ways of getting the Blinky Sprite in Fortnite

Apart from claiming this sprite as loot from a defeated boss, you can obviously obtain it using other ways as well. All such traditional ways of getting the Blinky Sprite are explained below.

1. Legendary or Epic Cheat Codes

Cheat codes are key for completing your sprite collection in Fortnite Override. While the blue cheat codes (Rare Cheat Codes) are the most common, they are commonly not the source for spawning Legendary-level sprites like the Blinky Sprite.

Instead, there are enough Epic Cheat Codes in the map that have some chance of giving a higher-tier item as reward. If you’re in luck, you may also come across a Legendary Cheat Code, which is the likeliest to provide this Pac-Man-themed sprite.

For those having trouble finding cheat code, a Cheat Code Locator can also help. These gizmos, introduced this season, can be purchased with Sprite Dust at the Extraction Sites or be obtained by using Lobby Hacks in Fortnite.

2. Rare chests

Although standard chests may only offer you weapons as loot, high-tier chests such as a Rare Chest can also throw sprites into the mix. These chests, hence, have a chance of roping in the Blinky Sprite.

Fortunately, a Rare Chest or two can be found across all three Pac-Man islands. So, if you want to avoid attracting attention that comes with firing at an NPC, you would want to search the island for these chests and open them before heading anywhere to pick a fight with the Pac-Man boss.

3. Taking the help of another player

If you already have a Fortnite friend—you can find one in the game’s official Discord—there is also the option of simply borrowing the Blinky Sprite to index it in your collection. All you have to do is join the same match as that player, then have him drop the sprite for you so that you can extract it. Following that, you can similarly join another match with him to return the sprite.

Afterward, you can go to the Override tab where, from under the Sprites tab, you can recall the Blinky Sprite by spending some Sprite Dust.

Blinky Sprite ability and usage

Compared to the rest of the sprites in the Fortnite Override season, Blinky is among the more effective ones as it grants you a cloak, which makes you almost invisible to the eye, for a brief time once you’ve taken a certain amount of damage. As expected, this proves useful when you’re in the thick of intense battles and can help you startle the enemy.

For each level of progress, the duration for which the cloak is active will be increased. So, at level 5, expect gaining a strong upper hand during any fight, so long as you have the Blinky Sprite equipped.

Wrapping up

In a short time, Blinky Sprite has emerged as one of the more sought-after sprites in Fortnite. That’s mainly thanks to how effective it is in combat and how convenient it is to obtain in every match.

As a result, Blinky Sprite has joined the list of some of the most popular sprites in the game, despite its Legendary-tier status. Moreover, it is also among the most powerful sprites, alongside a few others such as X-Ray Sprite and Tails Sprite. In other words, having this recently added sprite equipped can certainly influence how far you go in a given Battle Royale match.

title.rendered: How to fix macOS 27 Golden Gate battery drain issue: 14 ways that actually help

content.rendered:
If your MacBook suddenly started losing battery much faster after installing macOS 27 Golden Gate, I wouldn’t immediately assume that the battery itself has gone bad.

I started looking into the issue after seeing multiple user reports about post-update battery drain on Mac. A major macOS upgrade can temporarily make a Mac work much harder in the background, while genuine bugs, incompatible apps, excessive display activity, or sleep/wake problems can create much more serious drain.

So, before you start changing random settings, I’ll share the reasons behind the macOS Golden Gate battery drain issue and provide solutions to fix it.

Is macOS 27 Golden Gate causing battery drain?

With the release of macOS 27 Golden Gate, many users have reported unusual battery drain. Online forums like Reddit are flooded with complaints about Mac batteries depleting faster than expected. One MacBook Pro owner reported losing almost all of the battery while the Mac was closed in a bag.

The average battery life of a MacBook after a full charge ranges from 10 to 12 hours. However, after the update, many users experienced a 2-3% battery drop in a few minutes and significant lag in their MacBook Air. So, macOS Golden Gate is blamed for reduced battery life.

While macOS updates often bring new features and improvements, they can sometimes introduce bugs or changes that impact battery performance. Some common complaints include rapid power loss during normal use, excessive drain in sleep mode, and apps consuming more power than before.

However, Apple typically addresses such issues by pushing fixes in the next update. On the other hand, macOS is not always at fault. After installing macOS 27, several other factors might contribute to the battery drain issue.

Why is my MacBook battery draining so fast after macOS 27?

macOS 27 can cause temporary battery drain, but that doesn’t mean it’s permanently reducing your MacBook’s battery life.

Here are the most common possibilities:

  • Post-update indexing: Spotlight and other system services may be busy after installation.
  • Photos processing: Your Mac may be analyzing or organizing your photo library in the background.
  • iCloud synchronization: Large amounts of data may need to sync again after the upgrade.
  • Power-hungry apps: Browsers, video editors, virtual machines, games, cloud-storage apps, and other demanding software can consume significant energy.
  • Third-party compatibility: Apps and drivers that haven’t been updated for macOS 27 may behave unexpectedly.
  • Liquid Glass rendering: macOS 27 gives users more refined visual effects and a transparent appearance. But the dynamic animations can consume battery.
  • Apple Intelligence activity: New AI features introduce additional on-device processing.
  • Battery degradation: An older battery naturally provides less runtime.
  • Sleep/wake problems: A Mac that repeatedly wakes instead of remaining asleep can lose a large amount of battery.

All these processes can temporarily increase CPU activity and battery consumption.

Apple also says that an Apple-silicon Mac can recalibrate its maximum battery capacity after a software update. During this process, the Mac may temporarily run on battery power even while connected to AC power.

However, there is a difference between temporary post-update activity and abnormal battery drain. If your MacBook continues losing charge rapidly several days after installing macOS 27, becomes unusually hot, or loses a large amount of battery while sleeping, it needs troubleshooting.

14 Ways to fix macOS 27 battery drain Issue

Try these simple and effective solutions to fix battery drain issues on macOS 27 and improve your Mac’s battery life. Work through the methods below to find what’s causing the excessive battery usage.

1. Give your Mac time to finish post-update tasks

If you installed macOS 27 recently, don’t immediately assume something is broken.

Your Mac may spend considerable time processing files, rebuilding search indexes, analyzing photos, syncing iCloud data, and completing other background tasks. This can make the Mac feel warmer than usual and cause faster battery drain.

I recommend leaving your Mac connected to power and allowing it to sit for a few hours. If you have a large SSD, a large Photos library, or a lot of iCloud data, the process can take longer.

You can also open Activity Monitor → CPU and look for unusually active background processes.

The important thing is to compare battery performance after the background work settles, rather than judging macOS 27 based on the first few hours after installation.

2. Check Activity Monitor before changing anything

This is the first diagnostic step I’d recommend.

Instead of guessing which setting is draining your battery, let macOS show you.

  1. Open Activity Monitor.
  2. Select the Energy tab.
  3. Click Energy Impact to sort the list. Look at the apps consuming the most energy.
  4. Check the 12 hr Power column for the average energy impact of apps over the previous 12 hours or since startup.
  5. Pay attention to the Preventing Sleep column to know which app is preventing the Mac from sleeping.

If you find an application consistently at the top of the Energy list, select it, then click the close icon at the top and quit it normally. Now check whether battery usage improves. This is much more useful than simply closing random apps.

3. Check your Mac’s Battery Health

Before blaming Golden Gate, check your battery’s physical condition. Apple explains that battery capacity naturally decreases as the battery chemically ages.

  1. Go to Apple menu → System Settings → Battery.
  2. Go to General → Select About.
  3. Scroll to the bottom in the About menu and hit System Report.
  4. As the new window appears, choose Power.
  5. Here, under Health Information, you will find detailed information about your MacBook’s battery cycle count, battery health, and maximum capacity.
  6. Pay attention to the Condition parameter. You’ll see any one of the following:
    • Normal: Your MacBook battery is doing fine.
    • Replace Soon: The battery is working, but holds less charging capacity than before.
    • Replace Now: The battery is completely degraded and must be replaced urgently.
    • Service Battery: The battery is not authentic or poses harm to the system. It must be replaced as soon as possible.

If your battery is already significantly degraded, a macOS upgrade may simply make the reduced runtime more noticeable. So, based on the alert, you must act accordingly.

Note: On average, a Mac can swiftly go through 1000 charge cycles. This should also give you some idea about your MacBook’s battery condition.

4. Turn On Low Power Mode

If I need to stretch battery life while working away from a charger, Low Power Mode is one of the first settings I use.

  1. Open System Settings and go to Battery.
  2. Click the drop down next to On battery and select Low Power Mode.

It limits background activities and optimizes device performance to maximize battery life.

I wouldn’t leave my Mac permanently in Low Power Mode because it slightly affects certain functionalities such as automatic updates or email fetch frequency. Instead, use it when you’re traveling, working away from a charger, or troubleshooting unusually high energy consumption.

5. Reduce Liquid Glass transparency

One of the notable visual changes in macOS 27 is that Apple gives you more control over Liquid Glass.

If your Mac appears to be using unusually high graphics resources after the upgrade, reducing the transparency is worth testing.

  1. Go to System Settings → Appearance
  2. Look for the Liquid Glass appearance control and move it toward the more opaque/tinted setting.

For a more opaque appearance, open System Settings → Accessibility → Display and toggle on Reduce Transparency.

I find this solution ideal when Activity Monitor shows unusually high WindowServer activity or your Mac is struggling with the interface.

6. Reduce Display Brightness

The display is still one of the easiest things to control when you need more battery life. If you’re working indoors, you usually don’t need the screen at maximum brightness.

To reduce brightness:

  1. Open Control Center.
  2. Select Display.
  3. Move the brightness slider lower.

You can also configure display-related behavior through System Settings → Displays. Consider enabling dark mode whenever possible, as it uses less energy compared to light mode.

Also, ensure you don’t use Live wallpaper on your Mac, as they can consume much power to show the animation. With these display customizations in place, your MacBook will optimize energy and consume less battery effectively.

7. Check Login Items and Background Activity

Some apps continue running background processes even when you’re not actively using them. Moreover, if you have several startup apps, they can contribute to unnecessary battery consumption when your MacBook restarts.

This is particularly common with cloud-storage apps, VPN software, security tools, creative software, communication apps, menu-bar utilities, and hardware drivers.

To fix this issue, you should remove some of these apps and extensions.

  1. Go to System Settings and select General from the left pane.
  2. Scroll down and click Login Items & Extensions.
  3. Select the app you don’t want and click the minus sign below.
  4. You can also toggle off apps under Allow in the Background section.

However, be cautious and don’t disable the necessary system software or essential utilities required for the device’s operation.

By disabling the redundant startup apps, your MacBook can conserve battery for longer periods without compromising functionality. It may look like a simple adjustment, but it will help you manage your MacBook’s power in the long run.

8. Update your third-party apps

This step is particularly important with macOS 27.

Golden Gate is the first macOS release that supports Apple-silicon Macs only, and the release introduces compatibility changes that developers need to account for. Apple also says macOS 27 is the final general-purpose macOS release supporting Rosetta 2 for Intel-based Mac apps.

Early compatibility reports already show why checking your apps matters.

Therefore:

  1. Open the App Store and install available updates.
  2. Open apps that have their own update mechanism and check for updates.
  3. Update VPN and security software.
  4. Update external-display utilities.
  5. Update audio, storage, and peripheral drivers.

If your battery problem started immediately after a particular app launched an update, that app is worth investigating first.

9. Check for energy-hungry browser tabs

Open browser tabs consume a surprising amount of memory and processing power, especially when they contain dynamic content, such as ads or auto-refreshing feeds.

This is especially true if you leave YouTube, Google Docs, web-based AI tools, social media feeds, etc., open.

Here’s how you can address this issue:

  1. In browsers like Chrome or Brave, click the hamburger menu and select More Tools.
  2. Click Task Manager to see which tabs are consuming the most resources.
  3. Select the tab and click End Process.

If you want to revisit a webpage later, bookmark it instead of leaving the tab open. Also, make it a habit to close tabs you’re no longer actively using. This will free up system resources and reduce strain on your Mac’s battery.

Tip: Chrome browsers are known to significantly impact Mac battery life. Try switching to Safari. It has a built-in feature called Tab Purging, which suspends inactive tabs automatically.

10. Disconnect unused accessories and external displays

Bluetooth accessories and connected devices can all affect power consumption when constantly syncing or engaged in high-energy operations, such as transferring large files.

If you’re troubleshooting battery drain, temporarily disconnect everything you don’t need. Pay particular attention to external monitors.

A MacBook connected to multiple displays may use more graphics resources than it does with the built-in display alone. If your Mac gets hot and drains quickly while connected to a monitor, disconnect the monitor for a while and compare the results.

The same applies to:

  • USB hubs
  • External SSDs
  • Docking stations
  • Webcams
  • Audio interfaces
  • Thunderbolt accessories

You don’t have to permanently stop using them.

  1. Access Bluetooth settings on your Mac.
  2. Now, you can either turn off Bluetooth or disconnect any paired devices.

If you’re using add-ons like AirPods, unpair them when you’re finished. This will avoid automatic pairing when such devices are near your Mac.

Moreover, if you’re fond of using Bluetooth accessories like a mouse or keyboard, disconnect them when not in use. We often tend to leave devices connected, which can cause them to run out of battery, including both the Mac and its accessories.

11. Check Location Services

Location Services can allow apps to periodically determine your Mac’s location.

  1. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services.
  2. Here, disable location access for apps that don’t need it, or turn off Location Services entirely when it’s not required.

I wouldn’t recommend disabling Location Services system-wide unless you have a specific reason. Instead, remove access from apps that don’t genuinely need it.

12. Restart your Mac

It’s simple, but don’t overlook it.

After a major operating-system upgrade, restarting can clear temporary processes and give system services a clean start.

  1. Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your screen.
  2. Select Restart from the drop down menu.
  3. Confirm by clicking Restart again in the dialog box.

I especially recommend trying this if:

  • The Mac is unusually hot while idle.
  • Activity Monitor shows an unexpected process using lots of CPU.
  • The interface is lagging.
  • Battery drain started immediately after an update.
  • An app continues consuming energy after you quit it.

If the problem disappears after restarting but returns later, that’s a useful clue that a background process or application may be involved.

13. Install the latest macOS 27 update

This is one of the most important steps because macOS 27 is still very new.

Apple’s official macOS 27 update page says its updates improve stability, performance, and compatibility and recommends them for all macOS 27 users.

  1. Go to Apple menu → System Settings → General → Software Update
  2. Install any stable update offered there.

However, I would not install a developer or public beta simply because you’re experiencing battery drain. Beta software can introduce additional bugs and make troubleshooting more difficult.

Stick to the latest stable release unless you specifically understand the risks of beta software.

14. Run Apple Diagnostics

If you’ve tried the software fixes and your Mac still loses battery unusually quickly, check for a hardware problem.

Apple Diagnostics can help identify problems with components such as the battery, especially when it isn’t behaving normally.

Because macOS 27 supports Apple-silicon Macs, don’t blindly follow old Intel-Mac instructions that tell you to hold the D key.

On an Apple-silicon Mac:

  1. Shut down your Mac.
  2. Press and hold the power button.
  3. Continue holding it until the startup options appear.
  4. Follow the instructions for Apple Diagnostics.

If Diagnostics reports a hardware problem, software tweaks aren’t going to fix the underlying issue.

How to fix macOS 27 overnight battery drain problem

Overnight battery drain deserves its own section because it can be much more frustrating than normal battery drain.

If your MacBook has 70–80% battery before you close the lid and wakes up with a dramatically lower percentage several hours later, I would investigate the sleep behavior rather than simply turning off Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

1. Check Activity Monitor’s Preventing Sleep column

Open Activity Monitor → Energy and look at the Preventing Sleep column.

Apple specifically provides this column to show whether an application is preventing your Mac from sleeping.

If you find an app marked Yes, close it and see whether the overnight drain improves.

This is particularly useful for:

  • Backup software
  • Cloud-storage applications
  • Media servers
  • Virtual machines
  • Download managers
  • External-device utilities
  • VPN software

2. Check Battery usage

macOS provides battery-usage information through System Settings → Battery. You can review battery use over the previous 24 hours or 10 days on supported Macs.

Look for an unusual period where the battery dropped sharply.

If the graph shows a major decline while the Mac should have been sleeping, investigate what was running around that time.

3. Disconnect accessories before sleeping

For one night, try closing the MacBook with:

  • External displays disconnected
  • USB hubs disconnected
  • External drives disconnected
  • Dongles removed
  • Nonessential peripherals disconnected

If overnight battery drain suddenly improves, reconnect the accessories one at a time to identify the culprit.

4. Check for apps that keep running

Before closing the lid, look at Activity Monitor.

If you see a process consuming significant CPU or Energy Impact even though you’re not using the Mac, quit the associated application and monitor the result.

You don’t need to force-quit every application every night. The goal is to identify the process that is actually causing the problem.

5. Don’t put a hot MacBook in a bag

This is especially important if you’re seeing sleep-related problems.

One recent macOS 27 user reported that their MacBook became extremely hot while closed inside a bag after repeatedly waking during sleep. Again, that’s an individual report, not evidence that every MacBook running Golden Gate behaves this way.

If your MacBook feels unusually warm before you put it away, give it time to cool down first.

If you repeatedly find the Mac hot inside your bag after sleep, don’t ignore it.

What to do if your Mac gets hot while sleeping

A warm Mac after a demanding workload isn’t necessarily a problem.

A MacBook that becomes very hot while supposedly asleep is different.

I’d troubleshoot it in this order:

  • Check Activity Monitor → Energy.
  • Look for apps marked Preventing Sleep.
  • Disconnect external monitors and accessories.
  • Quit cloud-syncing, backup, and virtualization software.
  • Restart the Mac.
  • Install the latest stable macOS 27 update.
  • Test sleep again.
  • If the problem continues, run Apple Diagnostics and contact Apple Support.

Don’t immediately start changing low-level pmset settings or force-enable an alternative hibernation mode.

Those Terminal commands are advanced power-management configurations, and they aren’t the first thing I’d recommend for an average Mac user troubleshooting Golden Gate.

Should you reinstall macOS 27?

Not as your first solution.

A reinstall is a much bigger step than changing a battery setting or updating an application.

I’d consider reinstalling macOS 27 only if:

  • The problem survives several restarts.
  • The latest stable macOS 27 update doesn’t help.
  • Activity Monitor doesn’t identify an obvious culprit.
  • Multiple system components are behaving strangely.
  • Apple Support recommends reinstalling macOS.
  • You suspect damaged system files.

Before reinstalling macOS, make a complete backup using Time Machine or another trusted backup solution.

Also remember that reinstalling macOS won’t repair a physically degraded battery.

If Battery Health says Service Recommended, deal with the battery rather than repeatedly reinstalling the operating system. Apple says that status means the battery’s ability to hold charge is lower than when new or that it isn’t functioning normally.

What about downgrading from macOS 27?

If Golden Gate has broken an application or workflow you depend on, reverting to an earlier macOS version may be an option, but I wouldn’t recommend treating it as the first battery-drain fix.

First, determine whether the problem is actually caused by macOS 27.

If a third-party application is responsible, updating or removing that application is much simpler than wiping the Mac.

Also remember that macOS 27 is the first macOS release to drop support for Intel Macs, while Apple-silicon Macs remain the supported hardware platform.

Say goodbye to macOS 27 battery drain!

If your MacBook battery started draining quickly after installing macOS 27 Golden Gate, don’t panic and don’t start changing every power setting at once.

The first thing I’d do is give the Mac some time to finish its post-update work. Then I’d open Activity Monitor → Energy and find out what’s actually consuming power.

Most importantly, don’t assume every battery complaint is a macOS bug. A major software update, an incompatible application, a background process, and an aging battery can all produce very similar symptoms.

And because macOS 27 Golden Gate is still in its first days of public availability, the situation is likely to change as Apple releases additional point updates.

keyPoints.title: macOS Tahoe Battery Drain Reports
keyPoints.explanation: Many users have experienced faster battery drain and reduced runtime after updating to macOS Tahoe, with reports of significant power loss and lag.

keyPoints.title: Common Causes of Battery Drain on Mac
keyPoints.explanation: Post-update issues, app incompatibilities, display settings, battery health, intensive app usage, and overheating contribute to fast battery drain.

keyPoints.title: Free Up Mac Resources
keyPoints.explanation: Closing resource-heavy apps through Activity Monitor can help conserve battery by reducing RAM and CPU usage.

keyPoints.title: Check Battery Health Status
keyPoints.explanation: Monitoring the battery condition via System Report helps determine if the battery needs replacement or is degrading.

keyPoints.title: Optimize Display & Lock Screen Settings
keyPoints.explanation: Lowering brightness, enabling automatic adjustments, and reducing unnecessary notifications or inactive display time can extend battery life.

title.rendered: How to get the Cyberpunk Edgerunners Lucy skin in Fortnite

content.rendered:
One of Cyberpunk Edgerunners’ memorable characters, Lucy, has joined the lineup of Fortnite skins. This comes as part of the online multiplayer game’s season-long collab with the Cyberpunk 2077 IP, of which Edgerunners is a spin-off anime adaptation.

The Lucy skin, as well as the other Cyberpunk Edgerunners-inspired cosmetics, is only available in the Fortnite Item Shop until September 26 by 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET. It is priced at 1,500 V-Bucks and is also available as part of the Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle, which is selling for 2,300 V-Bucks.

Steps to get the Lucy skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab
  2. Then, scroll to the “Cyberpunk Edgerunners” section and select the Lucyna Kushinada skin
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

With the purchase of the Lucy skin, you will also get the Rebecca Plushie back bling for free. By the way, the latter can also be bought individually from the in-game store.

All Cyberpunk Edgerunners and Cyberpunk 2077 cosmetics in Fortnite

At the time of writing, items themed around both Cyberpunk Edgerunners anime and the Cyberpunk 2077 game are up for grabs in the Item Shop. Moreover, there is also a bundle that contains cosmetics based on the latter, which is going for 2,800 V-Bucks. You can check out all the items available as part of this combined promotion below.

1. Lucyna Kushinada

Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
Also includes: Rebecca Plushie back bling
Also available with: Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle

2. Adam Smasher

Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
Also includes: Adam Smasher’s Shoulder Cannon back bling
Also available with: Purchase of Cyberpunk 2077 on Epic Games Store

3. Johnny Silverhand

Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
Also includes: Johnny’s Duffel Bag back bling
Also available with: Night City Denizens Bundle

4. V

Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
Also includes: Flathead back bling
Also available with: Night City Denizens Bundle

5. Rebecca Plushie (back bling)

Price: 400 V-Bucks
Also available with: Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle

6. Adam Smasher’s Shoulder Cannon (back bling)

Exclusively available with: Adam Smasher skin

7. Johnny Silverhand’s Duffel Bag (back bling)

Available with: Johnny Silverhand skin, Night City Denizens Bundle

8. Flathead (back bling)

Available with: V skin, Night City Denizens Bundle

9. Lucy’s Monowire (pickaxe)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle

10. Mantis Blades (pickaxe)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: Night City Denizens Bundle

11. Silverhand’s Katana (pickaxe)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: Night City Denizens Bundle

12. Johnny Silverhand’s Guitar (pickaxe and back bling)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available with: Night City Denizens Bundle

13. Lucy’s Float (emote)

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle

14. Edgerunners Glitch (wrap)

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle

15. Night City Lights (wrap)

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: Night City Denizens Bundle

16. I Really Want To Stay At Your House (jam track)

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also available with: Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle

17. Cyberpunk Quadra Turbo-R

Price: 1,800 V-Bucks

Rounding up

The ongoing promo, headlined by the Lucy skin, isn’t the only collaboration between Fortnite and CDPR’s Cyberpunk franchise. There are also other influences of the dystopian IP that can be seen in the game.

Since last week’s update, you can bump into Adam Smasher within the Battle Royale map. On top of that, there is also a new Mythic weapon that comes from the Cyberpunk Edgerunners series, which is called Rebecca’s Guns.

With a second season of Cyberpunk Edgerunners in the pipeline for October, it may be safe to assume cosmetics themed around the show will also make their way into Epic’s live-service game. However, it will be interesting to see which main characters among Weak Kingsley, D, Roman Carax, and Talia Yang are rolled out as part of this anticipated Fortnite collab.

FAQs

Can I get the Lucy skin in Fortnite for free?

No, not anymore. However, till September 19, the Lucy skin could have been unlocked by ranking high in the Cyberpunk Edgerunners Cup in Fortnite.

Besides Lucy, which other Cyberpunk characters are there in Fortnite?

Apart from Lucy, you have a choice among V, Johnny Silverhand, and Adam Smasher.

Is there a Fortnite bundle that contains both Cyberpunk 2077 and Cyberpunk Edgerunners characters?

As of now, no such combined bundles exist. There is the Night City Denizens Bundle, which features Cyberpunk 2077-inspired characters exclusively (minus Adam Smasher), whereas the Cyberpunk Edgerunners Bundle only packs items inspired by the namesake series.

title.rendered: The Veil codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest The Veil Codes on October 01, 2026

The Veil is a Roblox game that throws you into a horde-based PvE and PvP MMORPG where you’ll have to take the fight against deadly creatures while also fending off other players who will stop at nothing to hunt you down. One of the most important features in the game is Race Rerolls, which allow you to roll for different base stats and shape your character.

Luckily, the developers have released several codes that can be redeemed for Race Rerolls and various other cosmetics. So, let’s take a look at all the active The Veil codes and get you ready to enter the labyrinth.

All working The Veil codes

  • LASTONE: 5 Race Rerolls (NEW)
  • EMERGENCY: 3 Race Rolls (NEW)
  • UPDATEFINALLY: 5 Race Rerolls, 1000 Silver, and 1000 Ichor
  • SORRY4SHUTDOWN: 3 Race Rerolls
  • VERITYBOMB: 3x race rerolls
  • RELEASE: 6x race rerolls and 1 party hat
  • UPDATE FINALLY: 5 Race Rerolls, 1k Silver, and 1k Ichor
  • SORRY4SHUTDOWN3: 3x race rerolls

Expired or unverified The Veil codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem The Veil codes in Roblox

The next big question is: how do you redeem The Veil codes? Well, it’s quite a simple process, and we’ve outlined each step below to help you claim your rewards –

  1. Fire up The Veil on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Tap on the Shop button below the Health and Sanity bars.
  4. Select the Codes tab on the left side.
  5. Paste a working code
  6. Click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed a code, the rewards will automatically be added to your inventory in the game.

Where to find more The Veil codes

The developers haven’t established a fixed schedule for releasing new The Veil codes. However, make sure to be active on the official The Veil Discord server, as this is where new codes are often announced.

The developers can also drop codes to celebrate new updates, events, or major milestones, so make sure to check out the game’s official page on Roblox for the latest announcements.

Be sure to bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated with the latest The Veil codes as they’re released. If you’re into shooting games and want more free rewards, check out the latest Beat the Anime Boss codes, Build and Kill Zombies codes, Command An Army codes and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

FAQs

What are Race Rerolls in The Veil?

Race Rerolls allow you to switch your character’s race and roll for different stats. They allow you to create a character that works for your playstyle.

How to redeem codes in The Veil?

Open the game and look for the shop tab below the Health and Sanity bars. Choose codes and paste a working code.

Is The Veil a PvP or PvE game?

The Veil brings both PvP and PvE aspects. Not only can you find hordes of enemies, but you can also face off against other players.

title.rendered: Strikeborn codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Strikeborn Codes on October 01, 2026

Strikeborn is a brand-new Roblox battlegrounds game where you’ll need to polish your skills and fight other players. However, winning won’t be an easy task, as you’ll need to master combat, timing, and movement to gain an upper hand over your opponents. To celebrate the title’s Early Access launch, the developers have released a bunch of free redeemable codes that can help you reroll abilities and unlock new emotes.

So, let’s take a look at all the active Strikeborn codes and get you ready to dominate the arena.

All working Strikeborn codes

  • 15KLIKES: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • SBUPDATE1: Free Rewards (NEW)

Keep in mind that Strikeborn is still in Early Access. The developers are testing the game and refining its progression. Due to this, some of the rewards you can redeem right now might not port over to the final build of the game.

Expired or unverified Strikeborn codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Strikeborn codes in Roblox

The next big question is: how do you redeem Strikeborn codes? Well, it’s quite a simple process, and we’ve outlined each step below to help you claim your rewards –

  1. Fire up Strikeborn on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Tap on the Shop button at the top of the screen.
  4. Select the Codes tab on the right side.
  5. Paste a working code
  6. Click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed a code, the rewards will automatically be added to your inventory in the game.

Where to find more Strikeborn codes

Since Strikeborn is a new game, the developers haven’t established a fixed schedule for releasing new codes. However, make sure to be active on the official Strikeborn Discord server, as this is where new codes are often announced.

The developers can also drop codes to celebrate new updates, events, or major milestones, so make sure to check out the game’s official page on Roblox for the latest announcements.

Be sure to bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated with the latest codes as they’re released. If you’re into shooting games and want more free rewards, check out the latest Beat the Anime Boss codes, Stay Hard Run codes, Command An Army codes and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

FAQs

Is Strikeborn still in Early Access?

Yes, Strikeborn is in Early Access as the developers continue to work on the game, refine its abilities, progression system, and other gameplay features.

Is Strikeborn free to play?

As of now, Strikeborn requires a 400 Robux pass to access the game while it’s in Early Access. However, the game is expected to go free-to-play once it launches.

Is Strikeborn a multiplayer game?

Yes, Strikeborn is a multiplayer game that can be enjoyed with your friends and other online players.

title.rendered: iPhone users on iOS 27 can no longer downgrade to iOS 26

content.rendered:
If you updated to iOS 27 and were hoping to go back, that window has just closed.

Apple stopped signing iOS 26.6.2 on September 21, which means iPhones running iOS 27 can no longer be downgraded to iOS 26 through official means. The change was spotted by Aaron Perris on X.

What no longer signing means

Every time you install iOS, even via Finder or IPSW, your iPhone checks with Apple to confirm that version is still authorized. Apple calls this signing.

Apple keeps that list short on purpose. Older releases often contain security flaws that newer updates have patched, so blocking downgrades keeps more devices on protected builds. Once a version is unsigned, you can’t install it anymore, even if you have the file saved.

With iOS 26.6.2 now unsigned, iOS 27 is the only iPhone restore path Apple allows.

What about iOS 26.7?

Apple released iOS 26.7 last week, and that might sound like an alternative way back. It’s not, at least not for iPhones on iOS 27.

Apple hasn’t published an official iPhone restore image for iOS 26.7, unlike iPadOS 26.7. If you’re still on iOS 26, you can get 26.7 as an over-the-air update. If you’re already on iOS 27, there’s no IPSW to restore with, so you can’t use 26.7 to downgrade either.

In practice, iPhone users on iOS 27 are now forward-only until the next iOS 27 update.

Should you worry?

This is Apple’s normal pattern. The company typically stops signing the previous release a week or two after a major version lands. iOS 27 started rolling out widely in mid-September, so the timing tracks.

If you’re on iOS 27 and running into bugs, the better path is to wait for the next patch or report issues and try the usual fixes for iOS 27 rather than counting on a downgrade. And if you’re still on iOS 26 and on the fence, know that updating to iOS 27 locks you in once this signing window closes.

If you need the old method for reference, our guide on how to downgrade iOS on iPhone explains how signing and restores worked when a downgrade was still possible.

excerpt.rendered: Apple has stopped signing iOS 26.6.2. iPhone users on iOS 27 can no longer officially downgrade to iOS 26, and iOS 26.7 won’t help.

mainEntity.name: Is Strikeborn a multiplayer game?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Strikeborn is a multiplayer game that can be enjoyed with your friends and other online players.

title.rendered: WhatsApp now lets Apple Watch users react with any emoji

content.rendered:
You can finally react to WhatsApp messages on your Apple Watch with any emoji, not just six presets.

WhatsApp has started rolling out full emoji reactions on watchOS, as reported by WABetaInfo. Reactions from the Watch now look just like reactions from your iPhone.

What changed

When WhatsApp launched its full Apple Watch app in November 2025, the Watch finally got proper support for reading chats, sending voice messages, and seeing call notifications without relying on plain system notifications. Emoji reactions came with it, but you were limited to six choices. Anything else meant pulling out your iPhone.

Now that limit is gone. If you long-press a message on the Watch, you’ll still see those six quick reactions first. But there’s now a button to open the complete picker.

That picker shows:

  • your recently used emoji at the top
  • the full watchOS emoji library split into categories
  • a scrollable list designed for the small screen

WABetaInfo says WhatsApp organizes the library into 8 categories: Smileys, Nature, Food, Activity, Travel, Objects, Symbols, and Flags. Tap a category to expand it, pick anything, and the reaction appears in the chat the same way it does from an iPhone.

On iPhone you tap the + in the reaction tray to get every emoji. The Watch version brings the same flexibility, just with a vertical scroll instead of tabs.

Rolling out now, but not to everyone yet

WABetaInfo notes this is a gradual rollout. Even though the feature is officially live, it may take a few weeks before you see the category button on your Watch. WhatsApp hasn’t listed it in the App Store changelog yet, which is normal for its staged releases.

If you don’t see it, make sure your iPhone and Watch apps are updated and check again later. There’s nothing to enable in Settings, it appears automatically when your account gets it.

For anyone who lives on the Watch for quick replies, this closes a small but annoying gap. Reactions are the fastest way to acknowledge a message without typing, and on a tiny screen knowing how to use WhatsApp on Apple Watch properly matters more than on the phone. The same long-press to react flow you use on iPhone now carries over to your wrist without compromise.

title.rendered: iOS 27.2 beta 2 reveals more about iPhone’s Anti-Snatching feature

content.rendered:
Apple is still building an iPhone feature that can lock your phone automatically if someone snatches it from your hand, and code in the latest beta shows how careful it is trying to be about false alarms.

New references spotted in iOS 27.2 beta 2 point to an internal system called “AutoLock” that watches for signals a theft may have just happened. Apple hasn’t announced the feature, and it isn’t turned on for users in this beta.

The new beta adds more detail about what triggers it and what stops it from firing by mistake.

What iOS 27.2 beta 2 reveals

AutoLock can look at several signals together to decide an iPhone may have been taken:

  • a sharp acceleration consistent with being snatched
  • a paired Apple Watch becoming unreachable or losing connectivity
  • prolonged loss of network connectivity
  • the device staying unlocked beyond a set interval

None of these alone locks the phone. The code describes a voting system: theft signals can request a lock, but safeguards can veto it.

Those veto signals are meant to avoid false positives:

  • a successful Face ID or Touch ID check after the motion
  • certain foreground app activities that look like theft motion but aren’t, like gaming or workout apps
  • being in a familiar location or on a familiar Wi-Fi network, similar to how Stolen Device Protection relaxes restrictions at home or work
  • a backoff mechanism that temporarily suppresses extra locks after repeated triggers

That familiar-place check is already familiar to iPhone owners. If you have Stolen Device Protection enabled, your iPhone already adds extra steps when you’re away from trusted places, and AutoLock appears to reuse that same idea.

Still in testing, not live yet

Apple has enabled the underlying AutoLock service in the background in iOS 27.2 beta 2, but the component that would actually lock the display is still disabled. That lets Apple test behavior without accidentally locking testers’ phones.

It also means you won’t find a toggle for this in Settings yet. The references only show progress, not a launch date. Apple could still change how it works, rename it, or hold it for a later iOS 27.x update.

The need is clear. Apple’s current protections like Find My, Activation Lock, and Stolen Device Protection help after a theft, but they don’t help much if a thief grabs an already-unlocked iPhone. Android already has a Theft Detection Lock that uses motion to lock the screen for the same reason. Apple’s version, if it ships, would aim for the same moment: the seconds right after a grab.

For now, the best available protection remains what shipped with iOS 27’s existing security features, and Apple hasn’t said when AutoLock will become user-facing.

title.rendered: Bitrig adds iPhone Duo support with Interactive 3D simulator

content.rendered:
Bitrig now lets you build and test apps for Apple’s upcoming foldable right inside its AI coding platform, with a 3D simulator you can fold, tilt, and rotate like the real phone.

The update arrived on September 19, just a week after Apple released Xcode 27.1 beta 1 with iPhone Duo support. Bitrig detailed the changes on its official blog.

What Bitrig’s 3D simulator does

Standard iPhone simulators show a flat device. Bitrig’s take is interactive. You can grab the virtual iPhone Duo, fold it closed, open it flat, leave it half-folded, turn it around, and set it down in different poses. Your app responds in real time as you move it.

That matters because Duo has more than one way to be used. Bitrig says the phone can sit like a laptop on a table, stand like a tent on a nightstand, or work folded shut on its outer display. Developers need to see how layouts break in each position.

How developers can use the new Duo features

Bitrig points to four specific SwiftUI tools Apple introduced for the foldable:

  • Try every pose. Test open, closed, and partially folded in both portrait and landscape. The 3D view lets you drag and rotate to check adaptive layouts.
  • Respond to the hinge. Use onHingeChange to trigger animations as the phone folds, like Apple’s window-like unfold effect on the outer display. Bitrig streams live hinge data as you fold.
  • Build hands-free experiences. Use ArrangementView to put video on the top half and controls on the bottom when Duo is propped on a table. Bitrig also reminds developers to support landscape for outer-display use.
  • Use both displays at once. Add CameraCaptureAccessory to show useful content on the outer screen while the inner screen handles the main camera view.

For most native SwiftUI apps, Bitrig says standard navigation and toolbars already adapt to Duo, but the new APIs help take advantage of the extra space.

From vibe-coding app to full Xcode workflow

Bitrig started in 2025 as an iPhone app that turned text or voice prompts into SwiftUI apps running inside Bitrig itself. Since then it added a Mac app with full Xcode toolchain access, an integrated simulator, on-device testing, and export to Xcode or TestFlight and the App Store.

With this Duo update, Bitrig also helps manage multiple Xcode versions. You can build against the Xcode 27.1 beta to prepare a Duo-ready app and switch back to Xcode 27 for regular updates.

Apple’s iPhone Duo doesn’t ship until October 23, with preorders starting October 16 and pricing from $1,999, but the developer tools are already live. Bitrig is also hosting a Bitrig Hacks: iPhone Duo Edition meetup in San Francisco on September 26 to get developers experimenting early.

If you’re curious what the hardware actually offers, Apple’s first foldable packs a 7.6-inch inner OLED and a 5.4-inch outer display with an A20 Pro chip and the same A20 Pro driving the iPhone 18 Pro lineup.

title.rendered: How to get Pac-Man sidekick in Fortnite

content.rendered:
After years of anticipation, Pac-Man has finally made his way into Fortnite. However, instead of arriving as a skin, the iconic arcade character is joining the game as a Sidekick! This means that Pac-Man will follow you around during matches and react to everything happening around you. With that said, let’s take a look at how you can get the Pac-Man Sidekick in Fortnite.

Here’s how to unlock the Pac-Man sidekick in Fortnite

The Pac-Man Sidekick arrived in Fortnite after the Item Shop reset on September 18, 2026, as part of the Pac-Man Bundle. Here’s a complete step-by-step guide on how to unlock the Pac-Man Sidekick in Fortnite –

  1. Open Fortnite on your console, mobile, or PC
  2. Head to the Item Shop tab
  3. Choose the Pac-Man Sidekick (1,500 V-Bucks)
  4. Hold the purchase button until the progress circle fills up

Once you’ve completed the purchase, head to the Fortnite Locker and equip Pac-Man as your Sidekick. The Sidekick features the character’s classic bright yellow design with red boots and brown gloves, which makes it a fun addition to any collection. You can also earn additional rewards by building up enough Sidekick Points while using Pac-Man Sidekick.

All Pac-Man Cosmetics Available in Fortnite

While you can purchase the Pac-Man Sidekick separately, it’s actually a part of the Pac-Man Bundle, which costs 2,200 V-Bucks. Although it’s the more expensive option, the bundle includes tons of Pac-Man-themed cosmetics that are worth checking out, especially if you’re a die-hard fan of the iconic arcade character. Let’s take a look at all the cosmetics included in the bundle –

The Pac-Man Bundle will be available to purchase in the Item Shop until September 25, 2026, at 8 PM ET. However, before spending your V-Bucks, keep in mind that the Lil Wayne skin is also available in Fortnite, so choose your purchase accordingly.

  • How to get Master Chief in Fortnite
  • How to get Shadow the Hedgehog skin in Fortnite
  • How to get Jimothy the Raccoon sidekick for free in Fortnite

title.rendered: Siri AI is finally here in iOS 27, but there’s a catch you need to know

content.rendered:
For years, I felt Siri was becoming the forgotten assistant on my iPhone. I could use it to set an alarm, send messages, or get the weather, but the second I needed something more than that, I would use ChatGPT or any other AI tool.

That changes with iOS 27. Apple has finally delivered its long-awaited Siri AI, transforming Siri from a traditional voice assistant into a much more capable AI assistant that can understand personal context, search the web, see what’s on your screen, work across apps, and maintain conversations.

Here’s everything you need to know about Siri AI in iOS 27.

Siri AI is finally here, but it’s still a beta

Apple released iOS 27 to the public on September 14, 2026. The update is compatible with iPhone 11 and newer, but Siri AI has more demanding hardware requirements.

You need an Apple Intelligence-compatible iPhone, starting with the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16 series, and later models. It’s also available on compatible iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods, CarPlay, and Vision Pro models.

And if you’ve installed iOS 27 but can’t find the new Siri, don’t assume something is broken. Apple is using a waitlist-based rollout.

To enable Siri AI on your iPhone:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Siri.
  3. Select Try Siri AI (Beta).
  4. Tap Join Waitlist > Continue.

Access isn’t necessarily immediate. Some users have received Siri AI within minutes, while others have reported waiting hours or even days.

What makes Siri AI different?

The public release of iOS 27 makes Siri AI much broader than the earlier Siri preview suggested. Using the latest Apple Intelligence, Apple has rebuilt Siri around three major capabilities:

  • Personal Context Understanding
  • Broad World Knowledge
  • Onscreen Awareness

These capabilities work together rather than functioning as isolated features. Let’s understand in detail.

1. Siri can finally understand your personal context

One of the biggest changes is Siri’s ability to understand information stored across your Apple apps.

Apple has rebuilt the search system behind Siri using a semantic index. Instead of simply matching keywords, Siri can understand the meaning of information found in apps such as:

  • Mail
  • Messages
  • Photos
  • Notes
  • Reminders
  • Calendar
  • Files

That means you can ask questions in a much more natural way. For example: “What was that movie my brother told me to watch last week?” or “What’s the confirmation number for my upcoming flight?”

I have also tried asking Siri to find photos from a particular event, locate information from an old email, or figure out what I need to do tomorrow based on information stored across my apps. This is what it’s like to have an assistant who knows everything about your digital life.

2. Siri now has broader world knowledge

Siri isn’t limited to information stored on your iPhone. The new assistant can search the web to answer questions that require current or broader knowledge.

You can ask it about recipes, travel planning, homework, gardening, DIY projects, calculations, local business information, and other everyday research tasks.

The important difference is that Siri can combine this broader knowledge with information from your device. So instead of asking one assistant for information and then manually giving another assistant your personal details, Siri is designed to bring those pieces together.

3. Siri can understand what’s on your screen

Siri AI also gains on-screen awareness. If you’re looking at an image, webpage, document, or selected piece of text, you can ask Siri about it without copying the information into another app.

For example, you can:

  • Summarize an article.
  • Explain selected text.
  • Translate something you’re looking at.
  • Ask about an image.
  • Analyze information in a document.
  • Ask follow-up questions about selected content.

This works across supported apps, making Siri considerably more useful when you’re already doing something on your iPhone.

The new Search or Ask Siri interface

Apple has also changed how Siri looks and feels on iPhone.

The new Search or Ask interface replaces the traditional Spotlight search experience and is accessible by swiping down from the middle of the display.

You can:

  • Type your request.
  • Speak to Siri.
  • Use the side button.
  • Say “Siri” or “Hey Siri.”
  • Upload an image or document.
  • Continue an existing conversation.

When Siri is processing a request, a new animation appears around the interface. Responses can appear as concise information in the Dynamic Island area.

If you need more information, you can swipe down on the response and continue the conversation. There’s also a + button that lets you attach files and images to a conversation.

Some responses also use rich information cards. For example, weather and Calendar requests can display information in a more visual format rather than returning only a block of text.

Siri finally gets its own app

For the first time, Siri has a dedicated app. The Siri app gives you a place to start new conversations and revisit previous ones.

It includes a card-based history of recent Siri conversations, along with options to:

  • Search previous conversations.
  • Pin conversations.
  • Continue an earlier discussion.
  • Access conversations across compatible Apple devices.

I like that Siri conversations can sync across Apple’s ecosystem, meaning I can start something on one device and revisit it elsewhere. This is a major departure from the old Siri experience, where most interactions felt temporary.

Write with Siri is much more powerful

Apple has also integrated Siri deeply into text editing.

Write with Siri works anywhere you can type.

You can ask Siri to:

  • Write something from scratch.
  • Rewrite text.
  • Change the tone.
  • Shorten text.
  • Expand an idea.
  • Turn bullet points into paragraphs.
  • Proofread grammar.
  • Fix spelling.
  • Give feedback on your writing.

For example: “Make this email sound more professional.” or “Turn these bullet points into a paragraph.” I tried asking: “How does this email sound?” Siri then provided feedback on my writing.

The interesting part is that Siri can even adapt my writing style when generating text in Mail and Messages, making its suggestions feel more personalized. Apple has also added automatic proofreading for spelling and grammar as you type.

Must read: How to Rewrite Existing Text with Siri AI

Visual Intelligence and Siri now work together

Apple has made a major change to Visual Intelligence in iOS 27.

Instead of treating it primarily as a Camera Control feature, Apple has moved Visual Intelligence into the Camera app through a new Siri Mode. You can swipe to Siri Mode, point your camera at something, take a picture, and ask Siri about what you’re seeing.

Camera Control can still be used to access Visual Intelligence on supported iPhones. The integration with Siri makes Visual Intelligence considerably more useful because Siri can now search the web and answer follow-up questions directly.

What can Visual Intelligence do?

Apple has added several new capabilities.

  • Get nutritional information: Point your camera at food, and Siri can provide nutritional insights and information about what you’re eating.
  • Split a restaurant bill: In supported regions, you can photograph a restaurant bill and ask Siri to work out what each person owes.
  • Import multiple Calendar events: Photograph a schedule or list and Siri can identify multiple events and add them to Calendar or Reminders.
  • Import contacts: Take a picture of a business card and Siri can extract the information and create a contact.
  • Add membership cards to Wallet: A photo of a barcode from a supported membership card or pass can be converted into a Wallet pass.
  • Read labels and ingredients: You can click laundry-care labels and ask Siri to explain the instructions. Siri can also read ingredient lists and help identify potential allergens.
  • Understand confusing signs: You can photograph a parking sign and ask Siri to explain what it means.

This is where Siri AI starts to feel much closer to the multimodal AI assistants that have become popular over the last few years.

Siri gets a new voice on newer iPhones

Siri’s voice is also getting an upgrade, but this feature depends on newer hardware.

The iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, and iPhone Air have Apple’s more powerful on-device Apple Intelligence model.

On these devices, you can customize Siri’s voice emotions.

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap on Siri and select Voice.
  3. Change the Pace slider to control how fast or slow Siri talks.
  4. Adjust the Expressivity slider to change the emotional tone and personality.

The newer on-device model can also improve system-wide dictation. Apple says Siri’s improved natural-language understanding makes dictation better at handling spelling, punctuation, capitalization, and transcription accuracy.

Because dictation is built into the keyboard, these

Privacy remains a major part of Siri AI

Siri AI uses a combination of on-device processing and Private Cloud Compute. When a request requires more processing power, Apple can send the necessary workload to Private Cloud Compute rather than processing everything directly on the iPhone.

Apple says data sent to Private Cloud Compute isn’t accessible to Apple or third parties.

The company has also expanded Private Cloud Compute infrastructure, including Apple Intelligence workloads running on Google Cloud using NVIDIA hardware.

iOS 27.2 expands Siri AI to five new languages

Apple has already started expanding Siri AI beyond English.

The first iOS 27.2 beta, released on September 16, adds Siri AI support for:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Apple had previously indicated that these additional languages would arrive around October, so the iOS 27.2 beta provides an early look at the expansion.

Siri AI availability varies by region

At the launch of iOS 27, Siri AI supports English in:

  • Australia
  • Canada
  • Ireland
  • India
  • New Zealand
  • South Africa
  • United Kingdom
  • United States

Apple is expanding language support through subsequent updates.

There are also regional restrictions. Siri AI and the new Apple Intelligence features are not available in China, while Siri AI was not initially available on iPhone and iPad in the European Union.

The future of Siri has finally arrived

Siri’s biggest problem was that it struggled with requests that required context, reasoning, multiple steps, or information from several sources.

iOS 27 addresses those weaknesses with Personal Context Understanding, Broad World Knowledge, Onscreen Awareness, App Actions, Visual Intelligence, Write with Siri, a dedicated Siri app, and a completely redesigned Siri interface.

And Apple is already moving beyond the initial release. The iOS 27.2 beta’s expansion shows that Siri AI’s rollout is only beginning. The question is how quickly Apple and third-party developers can turn this new Siri foundation into an assistant that people genuinely rely on every day.

Have you joined the Siri AI waitlist yet? Which new Siri feature are you most excited to try? Let me know in the comments.
