title.rendered: How to Update Your AirPods to the Latest Firmware Version

content.rendered:
Updating your AirPods, AirPods Pro, and AirPods Max is essential to ensure you enjoy the latest features and improvements. Apple typically rolls out firmware updates automatically over the air, but you can force an update manually if necessary.

In this guide, I’ll explain how to update your AirPods firmware and check whether they’re running the latest version.

Table of Contents
  • How to Update Firmware on AirPods
  • How to Update AirPods Max Firmware
  • How to Check Your AirPods Firmware Version
    • Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on iPhone or iPad
    • Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on Mac
  • What Is the Latest AirPods Firmware Version?
  • Signing off…

How to Update Firmware on AirPods

In most cases, AirPods and AirPods Pro firmware updates happen automatically in the background without any notification. The updates are pushed over-the-air (OTA) when the AirPods are placed for charging or within the Bluetooth range of the associated iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

But in case you notice that AirPods are not updated as expected, you can manually force an update using the following steps:

  1. Place the AirPods in their charging case and connect the case to a power outlet using a Lightning cable or a Wireless charger.
  2. Make sure that your iPhone, iPad or Mac is connected to Wi-Fi and has more than 50% battery charge. Also, make sure Bluetooth is on and Low Power mode is off.
  3. Leave your iPhone, iPad, or Mac nearby. Make sure the case’s lid remains closed during the process.

It should complete the firmware update in the background, as there is no specific option to manually trigger it. After about 10 minutes, check whether your AirPods firmware has been updated. The latest AirPods firmware version will be found later in the post.

Note If you don’t own an Apple device, you can’t update your AirPods.

How to Update AirPods Max Firmware

Updating AirPods Max is similar to updating AirPods, but there are slight differences in the process. These over-ear headphones don’t need a charging case.

  1. Ensure the paired iPhone, iPad, or Mac is 50% charged and has Wi-Fi and Bluetooth enabled.
  2. If you have an iPhone or iPad, plug the charging cable into the AirPods Max, connect it to the power outlet, and keep it close to your device.
  3. If you have a Mac, plug the charging cable into the AirPods Max and connect them to your Mac.

Now wait for 30 minutes, then check your AirPods Max firmware version.

How to Check Your AirPods Firmware Version

After you complete the update, checking the current firmware version of your AirPods can help you confirm whether they are up to date. Here’s how to check it on your connected iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on iPhone or iPad

To check your AirPods firmware on your iPhone or iPad, be sure to update your iOS or iPadOS to the latest version. Then do the following:

  1. Go to Settings and select Bluetooth.
  2. Select the info (i) button next to the AirPods.
  3. You can see the version of your AirPods under the About section.

Find Your AirPods Firmware Version on Mac

First, make sure your Mac runs the latest macOS, then do the following.

  1. Click on the Apple icon in the top-left corner of your screen and select System Settings.
  2. Click on Bluetooth from the left panel.
  3. Locate your AirPods in the list, then click the info (i) icon next to them.
  4. Check the Version displayed in the information window.

What Is the Latest AirPods Firmware Version?

Apple often updates the firmware of the AirPods models to enhance connectivity, sound quality, and battery performance, fix bugs, and occasionally introduce new features like Spatial audio, head gestures, etc.

The recent 9A348 update for the AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2 brings support for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate features. You get a redesigned AirPods interface, an Adaptive mode slider, custom EQ controls, and compatibility with Apple’s new Siri AI.

Additionally, AirPods Pro 3 get support for Precision Finding via Apple Watch and GymKit for syncing heart rate data. The prior 8B25 update set the stage for integrating Live Translation in the European Union in iOS 26.2.

So, you must check and update your AirPods to get the best experience.

Here are the latest firmware versions:

  • AirPods Pro (3rd generation): 9A348
  • AirPods Pro (2nd generation) with MagSafe Charging Case (Lightning and USB-C): 9A348
  • AirPods Pro (1st generation): 6F21
  • AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation: 9A348
  • AirPods 4: 9A348
  • AirPods (2nd and 3rd generation): 6F21
  • AirPods Max 2: 9A348
  • AirPods Max (USB-C): 7E108
  • AirPods Max (Lightning): 6F25
  • AirPods (1st generation): 6.8.8

For the latest details on firmware updates, be sure to visit Apple’s official website.

Signing off…

Keeping your AirPods up to date ensures that you get the best possible performance and access to new features. While the process is designed to happen automatically, knowing how to check and confirm the latest firmware is useful.

  • How to change AirPods settings on iPhone or iPad
  • How to Prevent iPhone from Auto-Switching Audio from AirPods to Your Car

keyPoints.title: Automatic Firmware Updates for AirPods
keyPoints.explanation: Most AirPods and AirPods Pro firmware updates happen automatically over-the-air when they are charging or near your connected device, without notifications.

keyPoints.title: Manual Firmware Update Process
keyPoints.explanation: To manually update your AirPods, place them in their charging case, connect the case to power, ensure your device has Wi-Fi and sufficient battery, and leave them near each other for about 10 minutes.

keyPoints.title: Updating AirPods Max
keyPoints.explanation: Updating AirPods Max involves connecting them to a charged iPhone, iPad, or Mac via a Lightning or USB-C cable and waiting about 30 minutes for the firmware to update.

keyPoints.title: Checking Your AirPods Firmware Version
keyPoints.explanation: You can verify your AirPods firmware version on an iPhone or iPad through Bluetooth settings or on a Mac via System Settings and Bluetooth, to ensure they are up-to-date.

keyPoints.title: Latest AirPods Firmware Versions and Features
keyPoints.explanation: The newest firmware, like 8A356, introduces features such as Spatial Audio, Sleep Detection, Charging Reminders, and improvements in noise isolation, available on latest models.

title.rendered: Gym League codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Gym League Codes on October 01, 2026

Gym League turns every rep into muscle, meals, and a race toward the next gym. As you progress through the game, building enough strength to move forward can take a fair amount of time, especially when upgrades and new gyms start demanding more from your character. That’s where working codes can make a noticeable difference, giving you useful resources without forcing you to grind from zero every time you start a new session.

The right codes can provide free food and potions that help speed up your progress and make your training sessions more productive. Instead of spending all your time collecting resources, you can use these rewards to get a head start and focus on building your character’s strength.

All working Gym League codes

  • DIVINE: 20 minutes of 1.25x Muscle Gain Buff (NEW)
  • WORLD10: 20 minutes of 1.25x Cash Gain Buff (NEW)
  • ASCENSION: 500 Cash and 3 Breakfast of Champions (NEW)
  • FRESHSTART: 20 minutes of 1.25x Cash Gain Buff (NEW)
  • WELCOME BACK: 500 Cash and 3 Breakfast of Champions (NEW)
  • HERO: 300 Hero Tokens, 1x Power Potion, 1x Money Potion, 1x Stamina Potion (NEW)
  • SCLASS: 500 Hero Tokens and 2 Power Potions (NEW)
  • LIMITBREAKER: 500 Hero Tokens, 2x Money Potions, 2x Stamina Potions (NEW)
  • PRISON: 1x Power Potion, 1x Money Potion (NEW)
  • Update29: 3 Breakfast of champions, 3 Warriors lunch, and 3 Dinner of legends
  • halloweenpart2: 2 Pumpkin candy bag and 100 Candies
  • hauntedbalanced: 2 Breakfast of champions, 2 Warriors lunch, and 2 Dinner of legends
  • Halloweenpart1: 25 Blood Potions
  • SORRYFORBUGSAD: Free rewards

Expired Gym League codes

100KACTIVE, 10KLIKES, 10KVIEWS, 150KLIKES, 150MVISITS, 1MMEMBERS, 1MVISITS, 2.5MFAVS, 20MVISITS, 2XEVENT, 400MVISITS, 5KLIKES, 5XMUSCLE, 650KLIKES, ANCIENT, BALANCE, BATTLEPOTION, BETTERGAMEPLAY, BETTERTOGETHER, BLIZZARDEVENTFIX, BLOODMOON, BONUSGAINS, BRAINROT, BUGFIXES, CHRISTMASGAINS, CLANS, COMPSFIX, COSMICGAINS, DEFLATION, DIVINEMUSCLES, DUNGEONGYM, EASYGAINS, FEELINGLUCKY, FIRSTTRAINER, FLAMING, FOLLOWGYMLEAGUERBLX, FROZEN, FRUITPIRATE, GLCOMEBACK, GYMGAMES, HALLOWEEN, HIDDENFOOD, HOLIDAYSEASONS, HUGEUPDATESOON, JUNGLE, JUNGLEGAMES, KEEPGRINDING, LATEXMAS, LEAGUE, LEAGUEOVER, LEAGUES2, LIGHTNINGEVENT, LIGHTNINGQUEST, MIDUPD, MINERATIONS, NEWGEARS, OLYMPUS, PIRATEBUGFIX, PLAYER456, POWERLEVEL, POWERLIFTING, POWERUPQOL, PRISONBOUND, PUMPKING, QOL2, QUALITYOFLIFE, RELEASE, SEASON3PASS, SHADOWS, SOLOLEVELING, SORRY, SORRYFORDELAY, SPARTAN, STARLIFT, SUMMERBODY, SUMMERFUN, SUMMERVIBES, TRADE, TRADE PUMPKING, TRADINGPLAZA, TWILIGHT, UNDEAD, UPDATE2, UPDATE28, UPDATE29P2, UPDATE29P3, UPDATE30, UPDATE30P2, UPDATE31, UPDATE31BUGFIX, WEREBACK, ZEROG

How to redeem Gym League codes

You need to be inside the Roblox experience before the code menu appears.

  1. Open Gym League on Roblox.
  2. Load into a server.
  3. Tap the Codes button at the bottom-left of the screen.
  4. Paste a code into the box and tap Submit.

If the code works, the reward should appear in your inventory immediately.

Why Gym League codes may not work

  • The code has expired or was incorrectly marked active by an older tracker.
  • You already redeemed it on that Roblox account.
  • A capital letter, missing character, or extra space changed the code.
  • A recent update has not reached the server you joined. Leave, rejoin Gym League, and try again.
  • You have a Roblox connection problem rather than a code problem. If you cannot rejoin the game, use this guide to fix Roblox Error Code 279.

Where to find more Gym League codes

New codes usually appear around updates, bug fixes, seasonal events, or player milestones. Watch the official Gym League Roblox page and the 1v2 Studios Discord server, which is the developer’s main community hub for announcements and code drops. The developer also posts on X at @GYMLeagueRBLX.

I’ll keep this page focused on codes with clear status and reward information, so you don’t have to burn time testing every old string you find in search results. If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Stay Hard Run codes, Pressure codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: X and SpaceXAI ask court to drop Apple from antitrust lawsuit

content.rendered:
X Corp. and SpaceXAI LLC have asked a Texas federal judge to dismiss their antitrust claims against Apple with prejudice, while leaving their claims against OpenAI in place. Their September 14 motion says the plaintiffs have resolved their claims with Apple and that Apple does not oppose the request.

The motion asks for dismissal under Rule 41(a)(2), which requires a court order. Judge Mark Pittman must approve the request before Apple’s claims are formally dismissed. If granted, the dismissal with prejudice would prevent X and SpaceXAI from bringing the same claims against Apple again. The filing does not explain the resolution or identify any settlement terms.

OpenAI remains in the case

The motion explicitly keeps the claims against OpenAI Foundation, OpenAI, L.L.C., and OpenAI OpCo, LLC. X and xAI first sued Apple and OpenAI in August 2025, arguing that Apple’s ChatGPT integration with Siri and Apple Intelligence gave OpenAI an advantage over rivals such as Grok. Their original complaint also challenged Apple’s App Store visibility for competing apps.

Judge Pittman denied Apple and OpenAI’s first motions to dismiss in November 2025, allowing the case to move into discovery. The court’s order did not decide whether the antitrust allegations were true.

Until Pittman rules, both Apple and OpenAI remain defendants. If he grants the motion, Apple would leave the case while the claims against OpenAI continue without a ruling on their merits.

excerpt.rendered: The motion says Apple has resolved its part of the case and does not oppose dismissal. The antitrust claims against OpenAI would remain if the judge grants it.

title.rendered: Gentler Streak and The Outsiders add Siri AI support in iOS 27

content.rendered:
With iOS 27 now available, Gentler Streak 5.13 and The Outsiders 1.8 add support for Apple’s new Siri AI, letting users ask about workouts, training readiness, body metrics, and sleep without opening either app. Gentler Stories CEO Katarina Lotrič described the updates in a September 14 report from 9to5Mac.

Users should include the app’s name in a request, such as "Show today’s workouts in Gentler Streak." Gentler Streak can answer questions about activity status, Go Gentler suggestions, daily body metrics, and the previous night’s sleep. The Outsiders can also report training readiness, today’s workouts, body metrics, and sleep.

Siri can explain what’s on screen

With either app open, users can ask Siri to explain a workout summary, health chart, or another screen. Apple’s App Intents framework and View Annotations API let developers connect app content and actions to Siri, then give the assistant context about what’s visible.

The updates also add on-device AI workout-title suggestions, refreshed icons with a Liquid Glass look, and layouts that adjust to different screen sizes and window positions, including iPad windows and iPhone Duo.

Apple says Siri AI is rolling out in English and is limited to Apple Intelligence-compatible devices. Installing the app updates alone will not unlock the feature for every iPhone running iOS 27. If Siri AI has not appeared yet, check the device and rollout requirements.

excerpt.rendered: Ask Siri about workouts, sleep, and training readiness without opening either app. The updates add on-screen awareness, AI workout titles, and adaptive layouts.

title.rendered: GTA 6 Online release date: Everything we know

content.rendered:
There’s no denying that the hype surrounding GTA 6 is at an all-time high right now. In the last couple of weeks, we’ve seen new gameplay footage, screenshots, and plenty of other information about what players can expect to see in Leonida. While Rockstar has given the community a close look at what can be expected from the single-player experience, what fans really want to know about is the GTA 6 Online release date. 

Considering the money-printer GTA Online has proven to be for the developer, it would be surprising if GTA 6 doesn’t get its own online mode. However, the real question is when it is going to hit the shelves. 

So, does GTA 6 Online have a confirmed release date? Here’s everything we know.

When will GTA 6 Online release?

Let’s get this right out of the way first: GTA 6 Online does not have a confirmed release date yet. As of now, GTA 6 is all set ot drop on November 19, 2026, and Rockstar has described the game as a “single-player experience” at launch. What this means is that the online component won’t be available right out of the gate, and players will be focusing on Jason and Lucia’s story as they explore Leonida.

For newer fans, this might come as a surprise, but Rockstar has a history of releasing its online modes separately from the base game. For instance, GTA Online launched exactly two weeks after GTA 5. Similarly, Red Dead Online beta arrived more than a month after Red Dead Redemption 2. Now, some might think that GTA 6 Online’s launch might follow a similar path. However, Rockstar hasn’t uttered a word about its plans for the game yet, and there are several reasons why GTA 6 Online might take even longer.

If you haven’t been keeping up, Rockstar has recently collaborated with Nopixel to bring Nopixel V to GTA Online. Although it’s roleplaying content, it gives players a completely new way to experience Los Santos. The timing for this project is interesting considering that GTA 6 is less than 100 days away, and yet Rockstar is actively promoting GTA Online. If that wasn’t enough, players who pre-order GTA 6 are also getting one month of GTA+ for the current GTA Online.

Rockstar isn’t moving away from GTA Online, and that’s because it’s way too profitable. Even though it’s more than 13 years old, the game continues to make millions of dollars in annual revenue. You’ll be shocked to know, but according to a Forbes report, GTA Online in 2020 managed to make $744 million from microtransactions alone. In recent years, the game has continued to bring in around $400 million annually.

With GTA Online performing so well, Rockstar probably doesn’t want to immediately pull the plug. GTA 6 Online will be a completely new experience, and it will undoubtedly overshadow the existing game. Fans have been itching for something new, and even if they spend a second exploring GTA 6, it would be hard to convince them to return to GTA Online.

That’s not the only thing. When GTA Online and Red Dead Online made their debut, both of these games were bare-bones. It’s only after Rockstar spent years adding new missions, activities, weapons, and other content that they became the massive online experiences known today. This has raised the expectations for GTA 6 Online as well. It won’t be a simple “add-on” to the base game.

It’s clear as day that Rockstar is focusing all of its resources on the single-player side of GTA 6. With all the factors we’ve mentioned above, GTA 6 Online will probably take longer to develop and launch. There’s a good chance Rockstar wants to see how the game performs at launch, its impact on the existing GTA Online player base, and then fully shift its attention to GTA 6 Online. As a result, a GTA 6 Online launch window of six months to a year after the release of the base game sounds quite realistic.

Will GTA 6 Online support 32-player lobbies?

Neither Rockstar Games nor the GTA 6 leaks that surfaced online a while ago have given us any concrete details about what’s being planned for GTA 6 Online. However, recent information from some court documents suggests that Rockstar might have been experimenting with 32-player lobbies for the game mode.

A few months ago, Rockstar found itself in court against the Independent Workers’ Union of Great Britain due to allegations of union-busting. The studio claimed that several developers were fired after allegedly leaking sensitive information about its games on Discord.

As People Make Games reported, based on documents presented during the case, one Rockstar employee mentioned that running a “large session” was challenging with 32 players. Rockstar’s legal team argued that this was confidential information about an upcoming project.

Now, fresh documents from Rockstar’s employment tribunal have surfaced online, with The Herald reporting that the developer described an “online 32-player format” as a “highly confidential” feature.

Of course, this doesn’t confirm that GTA 6 Online will launch with 32-player lobbies. However, this gives an insight into what Rockstar may have been experimenting with during development. The lobby size could make its way to the final version, but there’s a chance that Rockstar might have changed its plans. Only time will tell us what’s in store for GTA 6 Online.

Rounding up

Even though GTA 6 is just around the corner, Rockstar still hasn’t revealed its plans for the GTA 6 Online release date. Considering the success of GTA Online and Rockstar’s current focus on the single-player experience, many speculate that the online mode could arrive anywhere from six months to a year after the debut of the base game.

title.rendered: I found the 6 best AirPods 5 cases for every style and budget

content.rendered:
If you’ve just ordered the new AirPods 5, getting a good case should probably be your next step. The shiny charging case may look sleek and durable, but it could sustain scratches, wear and tear, and even dents from regular use.

I’ve rounded up the best AirPods 5 cases, from rugged protection and clear designs to leather finishes and fun retro styles. Whether you want something slim and simple or a case that can handle a few drops, there’s an option here worth considering.

What should you look for when choosing a good AirPods 5 case?

I would not buy a case for my AirPods 5 solely based on its looks in the picture. The case may be extremely nice, but this does not guarantee comfortable use every day.

Here are the things I would check before buying.

  • Don’t make the case too bulky: As I take my AirPods everywhere I go, I would like them to be compact. It is necessary for a case to be protective enough, but at the same time not very bulky.
  • Seek quality protective cases: I like cases that provide shock absorption, have a scratch-resistant exterior, retain the lid well, and fit snugly. If you often drop your AirPods, a dual-layer case or hard-shell design makes more sense.
  • Ensure wireless charging works: This is especially relevant for AirPods 5 with wireless charging. I do not want to take my AirPods out of their case in order to charge them.
  • Check the lid fit: A surprisingly common annoyance with cheap AirPods cases is the lid. If the top section isn’t secured properly, it can come loose after repeated use.
  • Think about how you’ll carry your AirPods: If you carry your AirPods in a backpack or handbag, a case with a carabiner lets you clip them on. For pocket users, however, I would prioritize a slimmer case over a bulky attachment system.

Top 6 cases for AirPods 5 you can buy right now

Since the AirPods 4 and AirPods 5 charging cases are identical in size, a lot of AirPods 4 cases should work for AirPods 5 as well. But I’d recommend making sure in advance of the item’s compatibility with AirPods 5.

1. Spigen Rugged Armour: Best AirPods 5 case overall

If I were to pick a single case out of all the options on the list, I’d pick the Spigen Rugged Armor.

The design is classic Spigen: understated, black, a bit rugged, and practical rather than stylish. The case uses a dual-layer construction of TPU and PC and has a textured carbon-fibre exterior that provides a better gripping experience.

Also, the pre-applied adhesive tape on the top provides a secure, precise fit. It also includes a carabiner, so I can clip the AirPods to a backpack or bag rather than letting them disappear to the bottom.

Another thing I like is that the design doesn’t go overboard with protection. It still feels relatively pocket-friendly and supports wireless charging.

Pros

  • Slimmer than many rugged cases
  • Clean, understated design
  • Good grip
  • Carabiner included

Cons

  • Only really exciting if you like rugged designs
  • Black finish isn’t ideal if you want to show off the AirPods
  • Doesn’t provide extreme protection

Best for: Everyday protection, commuters, students, and anyone who wants one AirPods 5 case that simply works. I’d buy it for everyday use.

Check out on Amazon

2. Belemay Crazy Horse Leather Case: For a sophisticated look

If the Spigen is the practical choice, the Belemay leather case is the one to choose for its look. You get a vintage-inspired leather exterior that develops a patina over time.

Crazy Horse leather is particularly interesting because it uses full-grain, waxed leather, with handling marks as part of its appearance. Lightly rubbing the leather helps fade usage scratches. The texture also gives the charging case a much more premium feel in the hand.

Pros

  • Much more distinctive than generic silicone
  • Comfortable, grippy texture
  • Vintage aesthetic
  • Good choice for people who dislike plastic cases

Cons

  • Leather isn’t the best choice for maximum drop protection
  • More expensive than basic silicone cases
  • Leather can show scratches and marks

Best for: Leather lovers, minimalist wardrobes, and professionals who want an AirPods case with character.

Check out on Amazon

3. Elago Clear Case: Show off your AirPods 5

If you have made your AirPods 5 unique with engravings, I would suggest going for a clear case rather than hiding it. The elago Clear Case is a straightforward choice to protect your AirPods charging case while keeping its original look visible.

As the name suggests, the transparent design allows you to show off the Apple logo. The case uses flexible TPU with high-quality resin to provide everyday protection against scratches, bumps, and minor drops, while resisting yellowing.

You can attach your AirPods to a bag or backpack using the carabiner. Moreover, the internal microdot pattern prevents bubbles or a smudged appearance that can occur when a clear case sits tightly against a glossy charging case.

Pros

  • Transparent design preserves the AirPods look
  • TPU provides flexible shock protection
  • Microdot interior helps reduce smudging
  • Easy to clean

Cons

  • Clear cases can still show dirt and fingerprints
  • Transparent materials can change appearance with age
  • Less rugged than a heavy-duty protective case

Best for: Minimalists, Apple design fans, and people who got engraving on their charging case.

Check out on Amazon

4. CASETiFY Bounce Case: Give a cute look to your AirPods 5

CASETiFY is the option I’d look at if protection is important, but I also want my AirPods to have some personality. Instead of a subdued black finish, the Bounce collection is created in an eye-catching way and features cute illustrations and colours.

So you can choose something that matches your iPhone case, favourite character, artwork, or your individual style preferences. The matte finish ensures no scratches appear when using it on a daily basis, whereas the TPU hard-shell case with bumper rings protects against drops from up to 6.6ft.

The downside is the price. You’re paying as much for the design and customisation as for the physical protection.

Pros

  • Large selection of designs
  • Stronger personality than conventional cases
  • Everyday protection from scratches and drops
  • Good option for matching an iPhone case

Cons

  • More expensive than basic AirPods cases
  • Bumper ring can be bulky
  • Availability varies by design

My take: I’d choose CASETiFY when I don’t want my AirPods case to look like every other AirPods case. Best for designer looks, customisation, fandoms, and gifts.

Check out on Amazon

5. TRONWIN Silicone Retro Cover: Best fun case

Some tech accessories don’t need to take themselves seriously. The TRONWIN retro gaming case is one such product. Its design resembles a tiny retro handheld game console, giving the otherwise very minimal AirPods charging case a completely different personality.

The lightweight silicone construction will protect your AirPods from dust, scratches and light bumps and drops, whereas the additional carabiner will make it more convenient to carry. Wireless charging compatibility is also part of the appeal.

Pros

  • Unique retro gaming design
  • Multiple color options
  • Silicone construction provides grip
  • Carabiner included

Cons

  • More playful than premium
  • Adds more bulk than a minimalist case
  • Not the best choice for someone who wants a professional-looking accessory

My take: This is the case I’d give to someone who loves gaming. Also, ideal for retro-tech fans and teenagers.

Check out one Amazon

6. MOBOSI Hard Shell Case: Best for rugged protection

When I am searching for an AirPods 5 case that focuses on providing safety features but does not compromise on wireless charging, the MOBOSI hard shell case can be a good choice.

Its rugged design gives the charging case a more durable exterior. Moreover, toughened edges make the charging case more protected from scratches, shocks, and other potential damage. You can use the included cleaning kit to keep your AirPods in pristine condition.

I would go for this case only due to its special locking system, since many cases’ top covers become loose after some days. Additionally, MagSafe compatibility means I don’t have to remove my AirPods case every time I need to charge them.

Pros

  • Substantial protection compared to thin silicone cases
  • Beautiful color options
  • More understated than many fashion-focused AirPods cases
  • Good choice for travel

Cons

  • Bulkier than minimalist cases
  • Locking mechanism adds complexity
  • Not as elegant as a leather case

Best for: Travellers, gym users, outdoor use, commuters, and anyone who frequently drops their gadgets.

Check out on Amazon

Which AirPods 5 case should you choose?

I wouldn’t say there is one perfect AirPods 5 case for everyone. After comparing the six options, this is how I’d break it down:

Final thoughts

A good AirPods 5 case doesn’t have to be complicated.

You don’t need the biggest or most expensive case. Find the one that fits perfectly, does not interfere with charging, protects the charging case from damage, and suits your way of using your AirPods.

For most people, I’d pick the Spigen Rugged Armor. It is the best balance of protection, size, grip, portability, and everyday usability.

title.rendered: How to unlock the X-Ray, Onigiri, and Overshield Sprites in Fortnite

content.rendered:
Four brand-new sprites, X-Ray Sprite, Onigiri Sprite, Overshield Sprite, and Mega Man Sprite, along with their variants arrived with the Fortnite v42.10 update last week. Notably, the first two are fan-made sprites created by Avila215 and Enorull respectively and are among the first sprites of their kind to be added.

For those who want a revision, the X-Ray Sprite is the one that lets you occasionally detect enemy locations through walls and other map obstacles. Moreover, the Onigiri Sprite provides an Overdrive Effect for consuming a healing item. Lastly, the Overshield Sprite grants you Overshield that increases as the sprite levels up.

While we have previously covered all ways you can get the Mega Man Sprite, this guide will cover the different ways you can find the X-Ray, Onigiri, and Overshield sprites.

Ways to get X-Ray, Onigiri, Overshield Sprites in Fortnite

Using cheat codes

Cheat codes have become another go-to way of obtaining sprites in Fortnite since the launch of Chapter 7 Season 4. They are quite similar to chests, except the fact that they exclusively give a single sprite to the player.

The kind of sprite you will unlock heavily depends on the kind of cheat code you encounter and use. There are the blue cheat codes that usually offer a Rare sprite, the purple ones offer at least an Epic-tier sprite, the golden ones offer a Legendary sprite or above, and so on.

For the X-Ray sprite, your best bet is the Legendary cheat code, which is obviously among the hardest to find. Fortunately, the Onigiri and Overshield Sprites are of the rare tier and can be easily obtained from the blue cheat codes that are relatively widespread. As a result, these two sprites are also very commonly dropped by eliminated opponents.

To reveal the locations of nearby cheat codes, you may use the Cheat Code Locator. This item can be obtained for free by using certain Fortnite admin panel codes, including “FindItChat” and “SurviveTheNight.” Alternatively, it can also be bought using Sprite Dust at Extraction Sites.

Going on a chest-opening spree

Another straightforward way of joining the sprite hunt is scouring the map for chests and opening them. Although standard chests may not offer anything beyond weapons, items, and ammo, there are special chests such as the blue-colored Rare Chests that can drop a desirable sprite.

For maximizing the number of chests you stumble upon, it’s advisable to head to locations, such as the Pac-Man islands (based on Pac-Man, Blinky, and Pinky) near the northern and southern parts of the Fortnite Override map. More locations where chests are easily available are the Green Hill Zone, Stone Sanctum, and Reality’s Reign.

If specifically targeting the Rare Chests, you can check out regions such as Cluster Coast, The Battlewoods, and Golden Grove, in addition to Stone Sanctum and the Pac-Man islands. To make sure you don’t miss out on the chests there, it’s best to visit them as early in a match as you can. However, it’s also worth remembering to watch your back in those spots as there are usually several players there during those early stretches.

Indexing the sprite from another player

You don’t necessarily have to find a sprite yourself to be able to extract it and add it your collection. That’s because there is also a more collaborative option in which you can take the help of another player who has a sprite you want. To find such players, Fortnite’s official Discord is among the best places to visit.

For this method, you need to join a match with that player, borrow the sprite, and extract it. Once you have done that, the game will have indexed that particular sprite into your collection. You can then join another match with the same player and return the sprite to him. Afterwards, you can restore the sprite you returned, in the Sprites section of the Override tab, in exchange for some Sprite Dust.

Author’s note

This new lineup of sprites has significantly affected how matches play out in Fortnite Battle Royale. This is mainly due to the impact of X-Ray Sprite, which is also the most coveted among the new sprite additions.

The X-Ray Sprite’s benefit that lets you see targets through walls and map obstacles is a major help and can prove crucial in terms of how far you go in the match. In particular, during the late game phases, it aids you significantly in locating the final few enemies in the small circle, especially the campers who normally don’t leave cover.

Having such an advantage in the pivotal moments of a Fortnite match is undoubtedly a game-changer, making the X-Ray Sprite a highly sought-after item. It will be interesting to see if this sprite remains in demand throughout the rest of the Fortnite Override season, or if an even more powerful sprite enters the fray in subsequent updates and overtakes it in terms of popularity.

title.rendered: Download the official iPhone Duo wallpapers here

content.rendered:
Apple has finally entered the foldable phone race with the iPhone Duo, its first-ever foldable iPhone. And, similar to the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple has given it a fresh set of wallpapers to match the new design. The good news is that you don’t have to wait for the iPhone Duo to arrive to use them. I’ve already got my hands on the stock wallpapers.

Below are the official iPhone Duo wallpapers available for download in high resolution. Save your favorite one and give your current iPhone and iPad a little taste of Apple’s foldable experience.

Download the official iPhone Duo wallpapers

What I like about the new iPhone Duo wallpapers is that Apple hasn’t gone overboard with the design. Instead, the wallpapers feature a beautiful landscape with sweeping desert dunes, layered mountain peaks, and a soft sky.

The Light version has a warm, almost sunrise-like appearance. I particularly like how the pale blue sky transitions into golden tones above the mountains, giving it a bright and peaceful look.

The Dark version is my favorite of the two. Again, it is the same landscape but the dark blue sky, along with the purple colors and darker foreground dunes gives it an entirely different look.

For the best quality, don’t save the preview image from the page. Use the dedicated download button instead.

Download iPhone Duo wallpapers

Why I love the new iPhone Duo wallpaper

What makes this wallpaper memorable is its simplicity. There are no futuristic graphics, bright colors, or obvious references to a foldable phone. Instead, Apple has opted for an open nature landscape with the display taking center stage.

The layered mountains also create a fantastic sense of depth. When I look at the wallpaper, my eye naturally moves from the finely textured dunes in the foreground toward the distant mountain range.

Apple’s foldable has two displays, so the wallpaper collection works well on different screen layouts. The iPhone Duo has a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch outer display, with both screens designed to maintain visual continuity when you move between them. Thus, you can put either version on a regular iPhone or Android.

iPhone Duo launch date

Apple announced the iPhone Duo on September 9, 2026, marking its first step into the foldable iPhone category. It will come in two colors, namely the Star White and the Night Sky, which will hit the market from October 23.

Until then, the wallpaper is probably the easiest way to give your current phone a little iPhone Duo makeover.

So, which iPhone Duo wallpaper are you going to try first: the Light or Dark version? Share this wallpaper with your friends and fellow Apple fans so they can get the new look on their phones too!

title.rendered: Stay Hard Run codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Stay Hard Run Codes on October 05, 2026

Stay Hard Run turns endurance training into a Roblox progression loop: run farther, carry heavier objects, and unlock stronger characters. Points fund your early upgrades, while Miles and Rebirths help you tackle tougher content and climb the leaderboards.

The official codes below can help you skip some of the opening grind. Since the game is still in early development, check the in-game reward message in case a code’s reward changes after an update.

All working Stay Hard Run codes

  • UPDATE1.5: 4000 Points (NEW)
  • STAYHARD: 5 Rebirths (NEW)
  • FREEMILES: 200 Miles (NEW)
  • DONTBEAWIMP: 3 Rebirths
  • ENDLESSMODE: 15,000 Points
  • BECOMESOMETHING: 300 Miles

Expired Stay Hard Run codes

How to redeem Stay Hard Run codes

The code box is available from the main game screen.

  1. Open Stay Hard Run on Roblox.
  2. Click CODES in the top-right corner.
  3. Paste a code into the Enter code here box.
  4. Click REDEEM.

Why a Stay Hard Run code may not work

Check these common problems before assuming the whole code list is wrong:

  • Typo or wrong capitalization: Paste the code exactly as shown. These codes are case-sensitive.
  • Mode or world restriction: Reported extras may require Endless Mode, World 2, or an All Time Marathon server.
  • Already redeemed: A code may only work once per account.
  • Old code or game update: Stay Hard Run is still in early development, so the creator can remove or change codes after an update.

If Roblox itself refuses to load the experience, fix Roblox Error Code 279 before trying to redeem a code again.

Where to find more Stay Hard Run codes

Start with the creator’s Roblox game listing, since its description carries the clearest current code set. You can also follow the Heavy games community on Roblox. Recent code trackers link to a Stay Hard Run Discord server, but verify anything posted there in-game because current lists do not agree.

Bookmark this page if you would rather check one cleaned-up list than sort through old strings after every update. If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Build a Blue Lock Squad codes, Roblox Pressure codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

More like this:

  • Blue Lock Farm codes
  • Sell Ores codes

title.rendered: AirPods 5 vs AirPods 4: Which one should you buy?

content.rendered:
AirPods 5 are the better buy for most new shoppers, and the $149 model is the one I’d choose. Apple added Active Noise Cancellation to both models, reworked the acoustic design, and improved durability without changing the open-ear fit.

AirPods 4 still make sense if you find the standard model at a steep discount and don’t need ANC. AirPods 4 with ANC is harder to recommend when AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case costs $30 less at launch and lasts longer with ANC enabled.

AirPods 5 vs AirPods 4 at a glance

Apple sells two versions of each generation, so compare the variants rather than only the generation name. AirPods 4 prices below are their original U.S. list prices, and retailer discounts can change the value.

These figures come from Apple’s AirPods 5 technical specifications, AirPods 4 Tech Specs, and AirPods 4 with ANC Tech Specs.

ANC is the real AirPods 5 upgrade

AirPods 4 split noise cancellation into two products. The $129 model has no ANC, while the $179 version adds it. AirPods 5 removes that compromise because both models include ANC, Adaptive Audio, Transparency, and Conversation Awareness.

Apple says AirPods 5 reduce up to 50% more external noise than AirPods 4 with ANC. That should help on a commute, in a cafe, or during a flight, but open-ear ANC still has limits. Without silicone tips sealing your ear canal, AirPods 5 can’t block sound the way in-ear AirPods Pro 3 can.

If you dislike the plugged-in feeling of silicone tips, AirPods 5 are the more interesting choice. If you want stronger isolation for planes, gyms, or loud offices, look at the AirPods Pro 3 instead.

The fit barely changes

AirPods 5 and AirPods 4 use the same open-ear approach, and Apple lists the same 4.3-gram weight and 30.2 x 18.3 x 18.1mm dimensions for each earbud. AirPods 5 are an internal redesign rather than a new shape.

If AirPods 4 fit securely, AirPods 5 should feel familiar. If your AirPods 4 regularly loosen or fall out, the new model probably won’t solve that open-design problem. Don’t upgrade for comfort without trying them first.

Sound should improve, but wait for independent reviews

AirPods 5 introduce a multiport acoustic architecture and next-generation Adaptive EQ. Apple says the changes deliver richer, more detailed sound across a wider range of ear shapes. Both generations use the H2 chip, Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, and Voice Isolation.

The expected improvement is in tuning and processing, not a new chip or a completely different listening experience. AirPods 5 don’t reach stores until September 18, 2026, so treat Apple’s sound and ANC claims as promises until independent reviews test them.

The $149 model gets the useful extras

With ANC on, standard AirPods 5 match AirPods 4 with ANC at up to 4 hours per charge and 20 hours with the case. AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case increase that to 5 hours per charge and 22 hours with the case.

That $20 upgrade also adds Apple Watch and Qi charging, a speaker for Find My, and volume swipe on the stem. AirPods 4 with ANC already support wireless charging and Find My, but they don’t offer volume swipe and have the older IP54 rating.

The standard AirPods 4 still last longer on paper at 5 hours per charge and 30 hours with the case, but that figure is with noise control off. You get the longer battery by giving up ANC.

Software features are not a reason to upgrade by themselves

AirPods 5 and AirPods 4 with ANC both support Live Translation with current firmware when paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone running iOS 26 or later. Supported languages and regions vary, so AirPods 5 don’t have an exclusive advantage here.

New Siri AI also depends on compatible Apple hardware and iOS 27. If you already own AirPods 4, update their firmware before assuming you need new earbuds for software features. This AirPods firmware update guide explains how to check the version. The AirPods 5 feature breakdown covers the new software features in more detail.

Both generations work with non-Apple devices as Bluetooth earbuds, but some features are limited. You’ll get the best experience with a recent iPhone, iPad, or Mac running current software.

Price and availability

Apple announced AirPods 5 on September 9, 2026. Preorders are open now, and both models arrive in stores on September 18. The U.S. price is $129 for AirPods 5 and $149 for AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. In India, Apple lists them at ₹14,900 and ₹17,900, respectively.

AirPods 4 launched at $129, while AirPods 4 with ANC launched at $179. Retailer discounts can change the calculation, especially for the standard AirPods 4. If AirPods 4 with ANC drops well below $149, it becomes a reasonable deal. At similar prices, AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case is the better purchase. Apple doesn’t include a USB-C charging cable or power adapter with AirPods 5.

Which AirPods should you buy?

Choose AirPods 5 at $129 if you want ANC, prefer an open fit, and want to spend as little as possible on Apple’s newer features. It is the easiest model to recommend to a first-time buyer.

Choose AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case if you want wireless charging, on-stem volume control, a Find My speaker, or longer battery life. The extra $20 is well spent, making this my pick of the four.

Choose standard AirPods 4 only when it is substantially cheaper and you’re happy to listen without ANC. Its 30-hour case battery is useful, but it has fewer noise-control features.

Choose AirPods 4 with ANC only when a sale puts it clearly below AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. Otherwise, the newer model gives you better claimed ANC, IP57 resistance, longer ANC battery life, and volume swipe for less money at list price.

If you already own AirPods 4, keep them if they fit well and sound good. Upgrade from the standard model for ANC. Upgrade from AirPods 4 with ANC only if better noise reduction, durability, battery life, or stem volume control will make a noticeable difference in daily use.

AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case is the best overall buy. The $129 version is the value pick, while AirPods 4 is worth considering only when a retailer’s discount is large enough to outweigh its older features.

title.rendered: WhatsApp iPad app gets a Mac-like sidebar in gradual rollout

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is making its iPad app look more like its Mac version. According to WABetaInfo’s report, WhatsApp is gradually rolling out a new sidebar that replaces the bottom tab bar for some iPad users. The change appears in WhatsApp beta for iOS 26.36.10.17, and some people on the regular App Store version are seeing it too.

The layout makes better use of the iPad’s wider screen. Instead of sending users to a row of tabs at the bottom, WhatsApp keeps the main sections in a column on the left while the chat list and conversation stay visible beside it.

What the new iPad sidebar includes

The sidebar is visible by default and mirrors the navigation WhatsApp recently added to its Mac app. It includes Chats, Updates, Communities, Calls, and Meta AI. WABetaInfo also reports a More section for Locked, Archived, Starred, Status, and Favourites, along with a profile button at the bottom for opening Settings.

The change fits into WhatsApp’s wider Liquid Glass redesign, which is still arriving in pieces across the company’s Apple apps.

You can hide the sidebar when you need more space

WhatsApp does not force the three-column layout on you. Tap the control at the top right of the sidebar to hide it. The chat list and conversation then expand toward the center of the screen, while a tab bar appears at the top so you can still switch between the same sections. Tap the sidebar button there to bring the column back.

The rollout is not available to everyone yet

WABetaInfo says the sidebar is reaching some TestFlight users and some people on the stable App Store version, but access is still tied to WhatsApp’s gradual rollout. Updating the app may help, but it does not guarantee that the new layout will appear on your account.

Meta has not separately announced this sidebar. Its latest WhatsApp feature roundup confirms that people can now create an account directly on iPad, but it does not mention the redesigned navigation. The sidebar details currently come from WABetaInfo’s beta findings and reports from users who received the change.

WhatsApp’s Help Center explains that new features can take days or weeks to reach every account. If you have not set up the app yet, this WhatsApp on iPad guide covers both linking an existing account and creating one directly.

excerpt.rendered: WhatsApp’s iPad app is getting a Mac-like sidebar with more navigation options and a hide control, but access still varies because the rollout is gradual.

title.rendered: Craig Federighi says iPhone Duo could overlap with the iPad mini

content.rendered:
Apple’s Craig Federighi has acknowledged that iPhone Duo could overlap with some iPad use cases, with the iPad mini being the clearest example. In an interview with Marques Brownlee, Apple’s senior vice president of Software Engineering compared the choice to how people divide their time between an iPad and a Mac.

Federighi said users eventually settle into "very natural patterns" for each device. He then got specific about the iPad mini, saying that "for someone who maybe had an iPad mini or something, this device can often fill that space for them." That is an acknowledgment of overlapping use, not a statement that Apple plans to retire the iPad mini.

The Duo comes close to the iPad mini’s role

Apple’s iPhone Duo announcement says the phone opens to a 7.6-inch inner display, runs an iOS experience adapted to the foldable form factor, and will support Apple Pencil (USB-C) later this year. Apple’s iPad mini specifications list an 8.3-inch display and Apple Pencil support for the current model.

The mini still has more screen, but Duo adds a 5.4-inch outer display and the full phone experience. The 2026 iPad guide describes the iPad mini as Apple’s portability-focused tablet. Duo now invites the same question in a different way: would some people rather fold that larger-screen experience into their phone than carry a second device?

That size comparison is an inference from Apple’s specifications, not something Federighi said directly.

Apple says Duo was designed as its own thing

Federighi also said Apple built the Duo’s software around the new form factor instead of stretching or cramming another device experience into it. Apple’s release says iOS 27 includes split-screen multitasking and apps optimized for the Duo’s two displays. A full iPhone Duo breakdown covers the confirmed hardware and software details.

Apple has not said the iPad mini is going away, and Federighi did not claim that Duo replaces it. The two products also land in very different price brackets: Duo starts at $1,999 in the U.S. and goes on sale October 23, while the iPad mini remains a much cheaper tablet.

excerpt.rendered: Craig Federighi says iPhone Duo could fill some iPad mini use cases. The $1,999 foldable still has a different price, screen, and phone-first role in Apple’s lineup.

title.rendered: Apple may bring back dedicated Genius Bars in major Apple Store revamp

content.rendered:
Apple is reportedly preparing a broad redesign of its retail stores, including dedicated Genius Bars, new spaces for online order pickup and Today at Apple, and the removal of large video walls. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman outlined the plans in his September 13 Power On newsletter. Apple has not confirmed the changes, so the details and rollout timing remain unconfirmed.

What Apple reportedly plans

Gurman says Apple wants to accelerate store renovations over the coming years. The changes would center on the "Avenues," the sections along the sides of newer stores where Apple displays accessories and services.

The report says Apple would add two 10-foot "bays" for tasks that are usually spread across the store:

  • An online pickup bay with an all-wood build, secure drawers for orders, a subtle Apple logo, and a front table for employee handoffs.
  • A Today at Apple bay with a large display and secure drawers for instructors’ devices.

Apple could trade video walls for Genius Bars

Apple also reportedly plans to remove the giant video walls at the back of many stores. Those screens currently support Today at Apple sessions and marketing. In the planned layout, many of those spaces would become dedicated Genius Bars.

The reported bar design uses wood, two counter heights for accessibility, storage drawers, and large product posters. That would reverse part of the store concept Apple rolled out in 2016. In its official Union Square announcement, Apple described a tree-filled Genius Grove for support and a Forum built around a 6K video wall for Today at Apple.

Apple still lists those services

Apple’s current retail page still lists online order pickup, Genius Bar support, and Today at Apple sessions. The report is about moving and redesigning those functions, not ending them. If you need support now, this guide explains how to make a Genius Bar appointment.

For now, there is no official timeline, store list, or Apple confirmation for the reported changes.

title.rendered: Apple may launch two iPhone game controllers under the Beats brand

content.rendered:
Apple is reportedly working on game controllers for the iPhone, with Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman saying the accessories may be released under the Beats brand. The report adds a useful detail to code references found in macOS 26.7 earlier this month, but Apple has not announced a controller.

Gurman says Beats executives are leading the project. The reported goal is to compete with the third-party gamepads already available for the iPhone, including products from Backbone, Razer, and SteelSeries.

macOS code points to two controller profiles

The code trail began with a September 4 MacRumors forum post from pdfu, who found two Game Controller profiles in the first macOS 26.7 release candidate. They use the identifiers T6502 and T1057.

Both profiles look like what Apple calls an extended gamepad. That means a familiar layout with face buttons, a D-pad, two clickable thumbsticks, shoulder buttons, analog triggers, Home, and Menu controls. Apple’s extended gamepad documentation describes the same basic profile for physical and virtual controllers.

The two profiles differ in a few useful ways:

  • T6502 is listed with Apple USB connectivity, an Options button, and no exposed motion input. Its haptic system is split between the left and right handles.
  • T1057 is listed with Apple USB, Apple Bluetooth, and Beats USB identifiers. It adds an accelerometer and gyroscope, while its haptic system uses one whole-controller actuator and drops the Options button.

The Beats USB identifier may help explain why Gurman’s report points to a Beats-branded product. It still does not prove that T1057 is a finished Beats controller. The recovered profiles were removed from the second macOS 26.7 release candidate, which leaves open the possibility that they describe test hardware or a project Apple has changed.

Apple already supports plenty of controllers

Apple would be entering a crowded market. iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV users can already pair Xbox, PlayStation, and third-party controllers, as Apple’s Game Controller documentation explains. The best game controllers for iPhone and Apple TV guide shows how many options are already available, from full-size Bluetooth pads to controllers that hold the iPhone between two grips.

That makes the Beats angle plausible, but it also raises the obvious question: what would make Apple’s controller worth buying? The code mentions standard buttons, motion input, and haptics. It says nothing about a new form factor, special iPhone features, price, or a release window.

The timing fits Apple’s wider push to make gaming easier to find and use across its devices, but the code does not reveal how Apple would distinguish its hardware from existing options.

There is no launch date yet

For now, this is a report about a product in development, backed by code that appeared briefly in a macOS beta. Apple has not confirmed the controllers, Beats branding, pricing, or release timing. Until that changes, T6502 and T1057 are clues, not products you can pre-order.

excerpt.rendered: Bloomberg reports Apple is working on iPhone game controllers that may carry the Beats brand. macOS code points to two models, but no launch is confirmed.

title.rendered: Upcoming Apple Products in 2026: Full list of what to expect

content.rendered:
Apple’s 2026 product lineup has turned out to be much bigger than a typical iPhone refresh. After months of rumors, Apple has now officially unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, its first foldable iPhone Duo, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5.

That is only part of the story. Apple has already refreshed several Macs and iPads earlier this year, including MacBook Neo, MacBook Pro M5 Pro & M5 Max, MacBook Air M5, iPad Air M4, Mac mini M6 & M5 Pro, and Mac Studio M5 Max & M5 Ultra.

However, the list doesn’t end here. Here, I have shared all the upcoming Apple products that are still rumored or expected so you can quickly see what you should still wait for.

Apple products still expected later in 2026

Apple’s September event has already eliminated many of the biggest unknowns surrounding its 2026 lineup.

However, several products are still expected or rumored at the end of the year, from October to December, with no officially confirmed launch dates.

iPad mini with OLED

The next iPad mini is expected to move from an LCD panel to OLED, which would bring deeper blacks, better contrast, and improved HDR performance.

Apple could also upgrade the chip to a newer A19 Pro or A20 Pro processor, giving the compact tablet considerably more performance for Apple Intelligence and demanding apps.

Other rumored changes include improved water resistance and a vibration-based speaker system.

MacBook Pro with M6 Pro and M6 Max

Apple has already introduced the M6 chip in the Mac mini, so the next major step is bringing M6-class silicon to Apple’s professional laptops.

A redesigned MacBook Pro with M6 Pro and M6 Max chips is expected later in 2026. Reports have suggested a thinner, lightweight design, OLED displays, and potentially even a touchscreen, packed with next-gen features like cellular support.

If the redesigned MacBook Pro arrives this year, it could become one of Apple’s biggest Mac upgrades in several years.

iMac with M6

The next-gen 24-inch iMac is also expected to receive an M6 update with some new color options.

The main upgrade is likely to be internal rather than a dramatic redesign. Apple could use the M6 chip to deliver faster CPU, GPU, and AI performance while retaining the colorful all-in-one design that defines the current iMac.

A larger iMac or an OLED iMac remains a longer-term possibility rather than something I would count on for 2026.

iPad 12th Generation with Apple Intelligence

The Apple iPad 12th generation is expected to be Apple’s next entry-level tablet.

Rumors suggest it will feature a powerful A18 chip, which could enable Apple Intelligence AI features, Stage Manager 2, Wi-Fi 7, improved multitasking, and smoother everyday performance.

The device is also expected to include around 8GB of RAM, making it better suited for productivity, creative apps, and advanced iPadOS features.

While the overall design may remain similar to the current model, the new iPad could still offer an 11-inch Liquid Retina display, 12MP cameras, and Touch ID, along with improved efficiency.

Apple Home and Display Products

  • Apple Studio Display 2 with mini‑LED backlighting, ProMotion support (120Hz), Thunderbolt 5, and 5K resolution.
  • A new Apple TV 4K with A17 Pro chipset, built-in FaceTime camera, Wi-Fi 7, and 8GB RAM for Apple Intelligence, Siri AI support, and an updated Siri remote.
  • Home devices like HomePod mini 2 are also likely. It may have an S9 chip or newer with Siri AI, mesh extender support, UWB 2.0, Wi-Fi 7, better sound tuning, and new colors.
  • HomePod Smart Display (or Apple Home Hub) may arrive with a 7-inch display with a magnetic dock or stand, a built-in camera for FaceTime, an A18 chip for Apple Intelligence, and Siri AI integration.

Apple products that could arrive in 2027 or later

Not everything Apple is working on is necessarily coming in 2026. These products are strongly rumored but don’t yet have a clear launch quarter:

MacBook Ultra

The rumored MacBook Ultra might turn out to be the company’s most ambitious Mac laptop yet. Current design reports point to a thinner body, OLED display, and touchscreen support, potentially making it the first Mac with a touchscreen.

The laptop is also rumored to replace the familiar display notch with an iPhone-style Dynamic Island, while Apple could explore built-in cellular connectivity. Recent reports suggest the first model may use M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

The MacBook Ultra is expected to sit above the MacBook Pro in Apple’s lineup and be more expensive. The launch date is not clear, but according to current information, the product might be announced in late 2026 or early 2027.

AirPods Pro with Cameras

AirPods Pro with on-device cameras for visual AI features and improved spatial intelligence are expected to debut this year.

Apple is reportedly developing multiple versions of camera-equipped AirPods, including models identified by the codenames B790 and B798. A leaked video found in macOS Tahoe 26.7 appears to demonstrate the technology, showing a user looking at a book while Siri uses Visual Intelligence to recognize and remember it.

Apple Glasses / AR Wearables

Apple’s long-anticipated AR glasses may be unveiled, potentially late in 2026 or teased for a 2027 ship window.

AR and security devices

  • A first-party smart security camera and video doorbell with Face ID support.
  • Targeting a 2027 launch, Vision Air could serve as a lightweight and budget-friendly alternative to Vision Pro. It is expected to be ~40% lighter with a magnesium alloy or plastic frame and likely powered by an A-series chip.

Why 2026 is such an important year for Apple

Apple’s strategy in 2026 is shaping up to be more aggressive, category-expanding, and ecosystem-wide than in typical years. The combination of staple updates (like iPhones and Macs), breakthrough category bets (foldables, Apple Glasses, smart home hubs), and AI-oriented experiences places 2026 as a pivotal year for consumer hardware and Apple’s long-term vision.

Bookmark this article; we’ll keep it updated as more rumors and confirmations roll in. Got a favorite from the list? Let us know in the comments!
